book.notes: Playable in the side quest Never Ending Battle (v181) as God. 6 moves, cannot be defeated. Not part of the normal roster.
Playable in the side quest Never Ending Battle (v181) as Satan. 6 moves, cannot be defeated. Not part of the normal roster.

characters.name: Snavo
characters.title: Striker
characters.passive: Four Heads: below 40% HP the snakes go feral and Snavo gains +25% ATK every turn. He also hits Marked enemies 10% harder. They never turn on allies. Lash, Bite and Swarm all feed his Mark combo.
characters.ident: A four-headed striker who Marks the line, then bites the Marked, and goes feral when he is nearly dead.

skills.name: Serpent Lash
skills.desc: Two snakes strike one target. 2 hits at 0.75x.

skills.name: Four-Headed Bite
skills.desc: All four heads bite at once. 1.55x, ignores DEF, and Marks the target for 3 turns (+15% damage taken).

skills.name: Snake Swarm
skills.desc: Every snake attacks. 0.8x to all enemies, or 1.2x to ones already Marked, then Marks them (3 turns).

archive: Item FAL-0003 is to be kept in a reinforced cell with four separate feeding ports. Do not address the heads individually. Staff report that the left-most head watches the door.
null
null
When Snavo's containment was tested, the heads stopped arguing. It lasted eleven seconds. Nobody on site has asked it to happen again.
recruit: One of the doors that was never meant to open is hanging off its hinges. Something with four heads is standing in the corridor, and all four of them are looking at you.
Four heads rise out of the runoff, one after another. They have been following the noise you make for some time.

book.abilityPlus: Can spread the snakes when 1 dies

characters.name: Sna
characters.title: Symbiote Guard
characters.passive: Tough and self-healing. His symbiote can cover the whole party in armor, and while it does, enemies have to go through him: Shared Skin makes him Taunt. Constrict slows enemies down.
characters.ident: A self-healing symbiote tank who armours the whole party and slows the enemy with Constrict.

skills.name: Symbiote Claws
skills.desc: 1.1x. Heals Sna for 40% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Constrict
skills.desc: 0.7x and the target is Slowed (-40% SPD, 2 turns), so it acts later in the round. Sna wraps it up and Taunts for 1 turn.

skills.name: Shared Skin
skills.desc: The symbiote spreads over the whole party. Every ally gets +35% DEF for 3 turns, Sna Taunts for 2 turns (enemies must target him), and Sna heals 15% HP.

recruit: A subject is standing in the middle of the corridor with his arms out, between a row of open cells and everything coming the other way.
Somebody has dragged a grate across the tunnel and is holding it shut with his own back.

book.notes: V272 buff (balance test: one of the weakest): HP and DEF raised, Constrict and Shared Skin now Taunt, Symbiote Claws heals 50%.

characters.name: Bearer
characters.title: Burst Cannon
characters.passive: Nine demons: every Blade Arm or Stretch Arm adds one (max 9). Legion Unleashed spends them all.
characters.ident: Collects Demons with every arm strike, then spends the whole pile on one room-clearing Legion Unleashed.

skills.name: Blade Arm
skills.desc: A real lethal blade. 1.3x. +1 Demon.

skills.name: Stretch Arm
skills.desc: The arm stretches out and hits the target and the enemy next to it. 1.0x each. +1 Demon.

skills.name: Legion Unleashed
skills.desc: All nine fight at once. Hits ALL enemies for (0.8 + 0.25 per Demon)x. Costs 2% max HP per Demon. Resets Demons.

archive: Item FAL-0005 is held in Fal-125's first cell, where it was locked after being captured by the military. Containment Level: High. Scent: scorched rubber.

Ability: Demon Spawn. The subject has no soul; it is just a robot. Around nine demons are hosted inside its body, and it can use all of their power at once. One arm can stretch out. The other is just a blade, and a very lethal one. Threat Level: High.

Interviewer: Are the demons still trying to get out?
{n}: Yes.
Interviewer: Can they?
{n}: No.
Interviewer: How many are there?
{n}: Around nine.

The entity appeared very early. The government could not do anything for a while, and it slaughtered humans while the demons fought for control inside it. After a struggle with the military it was captured. Casualties: ██████.
The demons inside the subject fight for control of its body. The subject itself has no soul to take a side.
Nine demons are actively trying to break out. None of them can. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A subject in a yellow wristband is arguing with the empty air. The air seems to be answering.
Something in the water is talking in nine voices. The man standing over it is not surprised.

characters.name: Fuja
characters.title: Black Hole
characters.passive: Always hungry: every attack heals him, and Devour deletes weakened enemies for good.
characters.ident: A walking black hole that heals on every hit and deletes weakened enemies for good.

skills.name: Hungry Gnaw
skills.desc: 1.0x. Heals Fuja for 40% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Event Horizon
skills.desc: Pulls every enemy attack toward Fuja and halves damage taken for 2 turns.

skills.name: Devour
skills.desc: Enemy at 35% HP or less is destroyed outright (not bosses). Otherwise 1.7x. Heals Fuja either way.

archive: Item FAL-0006 is held in a standard cell. Containment Level: Low. The subject locked himself in and remains there by his own choice. Staff are advised that he could break out at any time and has not. Scent: unlit match heads.

Ability: Black Hole Stomach. The subject has a literal black hole in his stomach that can consume anything and destroy it permanently. Side effect: he is always hungry. Threat Level: High. Founder status: one of the two founders of Fal-125. The other founder is Radiant.

Interviewer: Why do you stay in the cell?
Fuja: No matter how much good you try to do, sometimes in the end it doesn't even matter.
Interviewer: You could leave whenever you want.
Fuja: I know.
Interview terminated. The subject did not move for the rest of the session.
The subject was deployed outside his cell. The objective was secured. The subject returned to his cell afterwards. Staff note that he was hungry the entire time.
The subject is one of the two founders of Fal-125 and ended up as the thing he wanted to contain. Related file: Item FAL-0007.
He could easily break out. He is too broken to do anything anymore. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A tray of food has vanished from the cafeteria cart. So has the cart. The wall behind it is humming.
The drain is pulling the wrong way. At the middle of it, something small and very hungry looks up.

book.abilityPlus: Complete erasure when having consumed something

characters.name: Radiant
characters.title: Battery Mage
characters.passive: Living Reactor: his core is never emptied. He starts every wave with at least 40 Rad and keeps up to 60 of what he had, so Radiation Beam is ready on his first turn. Every Rad adds +0.3% to his damage. At 60+ Rad radiation seeps off him and burns every enemy for 2% of their max HP at the start of his turn (3% at 80+). Radiation Beam only burns part of the core, and at 80+ Rad it scatters across the whole line. Keep him hot. It never hurts him.
characters.ident: A reactor that is never emptied: the hotter his core runs, the harder everything burns.

skills.name: Claw Slash
skills.desc: 1.2x. Soaks up +16 Rad.

skills.name: Soak Up Fallout
skills.desc: Pull radiation in and wrap it round himself. +40 Rad and +25% DEF for 2 turns. No self-damage.

skills.name: Radiation Beam
skills.desc: Burns 30 Rad (the core is NOT emptied): (1.1 + 0.009 per Rad)x, counted with the Rad he has when he fires. 50+ Rad irradiates the target. At 80+ Rad (OVERLOAD) it also scatters across the line: every other enemy takes 60% and is irradiated.

archive: Item FAL-0007 is to be kept in a sealed cell. Containment Level: High. Anything close to the subject is irradiated. Personnel entering the cell must wear full protective gear. Scent: bleached linen.
Ability: Radiation Storage. The subject stores radiation inside his own body. He can also fire it out and use it as a weapon. Large areas of his flesh have burned away. Threat Level: High.

Interviewer: How did the ability form?
Radiant: I saw Fuja go insane. I tried to find ways to turn him back.
Interviewer: And when those failed?
Radiant: Radioactive material. It was my final resort.
Interviewer: What happened to you?
Radiant: My flesh burned away. That's when the ability formed.
During the exercise the subject fired stored radiation at the target, confirming he can use it as a weapon. Result withheld.
The subject was the second person to help with Fal-125. He watched Fuja go insane. Related file: Item FAL-0006.
The radioactive material was the last method. There were no more after it. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.

book.abilityPlus: Anything close to him gets irradiated
book.notes: v199 buff: HP 90>100, ATK 13>15, DEF 5>6, SPD 9>10; Claw Slash 1.15x +14 Rad; Soak Up Fallout +40 Rad, +25% DEF.

characters.name: Eyianix
characters.title: Eye Spy
characters.passive: THE PULSE HEALER. Eye Spy: while he is alive, every enemy shows what it will do next. Regrowing eyes: once per wave, when he is downed he gets back up at 50% HP with Guard for 1 turn. Quick, repeatable heals: Watchful Eye is ready every turn and Infused Eyes every 3rd.
characters.ident: Sees what every enemy will do next, and gets back up at half HP once per wave when his eyes regrow.

skills.name: Eye Bolt
skills.desc: A floating eye fires a beam. 0.7x. Heals the most hurt ally for 50% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Watchful Eye
skills.desc: An eye hovers over one ally. Heals 30% max HP and gives +25% DEF for 2 turns. Ready again next turn.

skills.name: Infused Eyes
skills.desc: Eyes charged with energy burst out and fly back. 0.4x to all enemies and heals every ally for 18% max HP. Comes back every 3 turns.

archive: Item FAL-0008 is held in a standard cell. Containment Level: Medium. Assume the subject can see everything his floating eyes can see, at all times. Scent: cold glass.

Ability: Eye Spy. The eyes that float around the subject can be used as cameras, and he can see through them at all times. He can also deploy them as eye drones and turn them into weapons by infusing energy into them. Threat Level: High.

Interviewer: Can you see through the eyes?
{n}: At all times.
Interviewer: Can you send them away from you?
{n}: As drones.
Interviewer: Can you use them to fight?
{n}: With energy.
During the exercise the subject deployed his eyes as drones and infused them with energy, turning them into weapons. Result withheld.
Anything within sight of the floating eyes is within sight of the subject. Assume you are being watched.
The eyes can be destroyed. They usually heal extremely fast, and they can just revive themselves. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.

book.abilityPlus: Eye drones can heal/revive themselves
book.notes: v199 healer identity: PULSE healer. Watchful Eye 30% (every turn); Infused Eyes 18% every 3 turns; eyes regrow at 50% HP with Guard.

characters.name: Tulu
characters.title: Power Cord
characters.passive: The power cord around his neck keeps him stable: he cannot be Stunned or Slowed. Claw Rend and Cord Jump build Charge (max 4) for Fatal Surge.
characters.ident: Charges with every strike and cashes it in on Fatal Surge, and nothing can stun or slow him.

skills.name: Claw Rend
skills.desc: 1.1x. +1 Charge.

skills.name: Cord Jump
skills.desc: Vanish into the wires and step out of the target's device. 1.5x, ignores DEF, +2 Charge. Tulu takes half damage until his next turn.

skills.name: Fatal Surge
skills.desc: Spend ALL Charge: (1.4 + 0.4 per Charge)x. At 4 Charge the target is also Stunned (bosses are Slowed).

archive: Item FAL-0009 requires Air-Gapped Isolation. Containment Level: High. The subject can travel through electricity to another device and step out of it, as long as something that powers it is connected to it (for example, a phone charger). Scent: static electricity.
Ability: Power Cord. The subject can go through electricity and teleport to another device, then step out of it. He also has insane strength. The subject's jaw is held together. Threat Level: High.

Interviewer: What does the cord around your neck do?
{n}: It stabilizes me. It keeps me connected to the human world.
Interviewer: And if it didn't?
{n}: I'd get trapped in a power cord.
During the exercise the subject traveled through electricity, stepped out of a connected device and attacked with his insane strength. Staff describe the combination as fatal. Result withheld.
The power cord around the subject's neck acts as a stabilizer. It keeps him connected to the human world so he cannot get trapped in a power cord.
Strength like his, and a way through anything that is plugged in. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A single cord runs from the wall into the neck of a subject who will not sit still.
A frayed cable sparks in the shallows. Its other end is wrapped around a grinning stranger's throat.

book.abilityPlus: Immense Strength

characters.name: Vor
characters.title: Blood Mutation
characters.passive: Blood Mutation: each Blood (max 5) gives +10% DEF, +5% ATK, +6% SPD and makes him bigger. Any blood works: whenever ANY unit takes a big hit, Vor gains 1 Blood, so the more the party bleeds, the harder he is to kill. Shadow Rake Taunts, Crimson Feast Guards him. Resets every wave.
characters.ident: Bleeds with the party: every big hit anywhere feeds his Blood and makes him bigger and tougher.

skills.name: Blood Bite
skills.desc: 0.9x. Heals Vor for 35% of the damage dealt. +1 Blood.

skills.name: Shadow Rake
skills.desc: Vor plants himself in front of the party and rakes the target and the enemy next to it. 0.7x each. Taunt (2 turns). +1 Blood.

skills.name: Crimson Feast
skills.desc: 1.2x, heals Vor for 20% max HP and he hardens: Guard (half damage, 2 turns). +2 Blood if the target is under 50% HP, otherwise +1.

archive: Item FAL-0010 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject is to be kept away from blood of any kind. Scent: blood.
Ability: Blood Meter. The more blood the subject drinks, the more powerful he becomes: faster, stronger and bulkier. Any blood works. Threat Level: High.

Interviewer: Does it matter whose blood it is?
{n}: Any blood works.
Interviewer: What changes when you drink?
{n}: Speed. Strength. Bulk.
Interviewer: How much is enough?
{n}: There is a meter.
During the exercise the subject drank ██████ and grew faster, stronger and bulkier as the fight went on. Result withheld.
Any blood works, including the blood of personnel. Staff are advised to keep this in mind.
The more he drinks, the more powerful he becomes. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: Dried blood on every wall of the corridor, and none of it is his. He looks bigger than a minute ago.
The water runs red downstream. The man standing in it keeps getting taller.

characters.name: Renku
characters.title: Void Blade
characters.passive: Void edge: his blades slice through the air and through barriers. His attacks ignore Guard (Containment Field, Barrier, Event Horizon).
characters.ident: Void blades that cut straight through Guard and barriers.

skills.name: Void Slash
skills.desc: The blade cuts through the target and the enemy behind it. 1.1x and 0.7x. Ignores DEF.

skills.name: Air Cutter
skills.desc: Slices the air itself. 0.6x to ALL enemies. Ignores DEF.

skills.name: Dimension Sever
skills.desc: Cuts a seam in space. 2.3x, ignores DEF, and Marks the target (+30% damage taken, 2 turns).

archive: Item FAL-0011 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject's blades can slice through the air itself. Scent: unknown.
Ability: Void Slash. The subject can slice through air with its blades, and can slice through people as if they were nothing more than butter. Threat Level: High.

Interviewer: What do your blades cut?
{n}: Air.
Interviewer: And people?
{n}: Butter.
During the exercise the subject sliced through the air with its blades and through the target as if it were nothing more than butter. Result withheld.
The subject's blades are not limited to what it can touch. Reach: ██ m.
It can slice through the air. It can slice through people. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A subject stands in a doorway the Guards locked an hour ago. The lock is on the floor in two halves.
A seam of nothing hangs over the sewer water. The one holding the blade doesn't seem finished.

characters.name: Lovesick
characters.title: Dead Angel
characters.passive: A parasite wearing a dead angel. Every move builds Light (max 5, resets each wave): each Light makes his attacks 5% stronger and his healing 5% stronger. He heals AND hurts.
characters.ident: A parasite in a dead angel that heals and hurts with the same moves, stronger with every Light.

skills.name: Parasite Lash
skills.desc: The parasite strikes. 0.9x, and the most hurt ally is healed for 30% of the damage dealt. +1 Light.

skills.name: Takeover
skills.desc: The parasite takes over a body: 0.8x damage, and the target attacks its own allies on its next turn. Bosses resist: they are Marked and Slowed instead. +1 Light.

skills.name: Mend Hearts
skills.desc: Healing Light and Broken Hearts, stitched into one. Heals the whole party for 14% max HP, the most hurt ally for 18% more, and cleanses Slow, Irradiated, Stun and Mark. +2 Light.

archive: Item FAL-0012 is held at Containment Level: Medium. The subject is a dead angel with a core parasite attached to it. Scent: rotting corpse.
Ability: Takeover / Healing Light. Takeover: the parasite takes over someone's body. Healing Light: exactly what it says. The subject is a dead angel controlled by a parasite. Threat Level: Medium.

Interviewer: What are you?
{n}: The parasite is a core parasite.
Interviewer: Is that a strong parasite?
{n}: It is an extremely weak parasite race.
Interviewer: Then how did it take over an angel?
{n}: Nobody knows.
During the exercise the subject used Healing Light. It heals exactly as described. It also acts as a lure to get entities closer. Result withheld.
The Healing Light heals exactly as advertised. It also acts as a lure to get entities closer.
The parasite is extremely weak. The angel is dead. How the first took over the second is a miracle by itself. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A dead angel sits against the wall of cell 12, still breathing. Something under the wings is awake.
Feathers drift down the pipe, black with water. Whatever wears them pulls itself upright to meet you.

book.abilityPlus: Parasitism

characters.name: Void
characters.title: Hollow Weaver
characters.passive: Fused with a piece of Fuja's black hole. Every move builds Void (max 5, resets each wave): each Void = +6% damage. 15% of enemy attacks aimed at her are swallowed and do nothing.
characters.ident: Builds Void with every move and swallows a share of the attacks aimed at her.

skills.name: Hollow Touch
skills.desc: Her hair lashes out. 1.0x, ignores DEF. +1 Void.

skills.name: Gravity Well
skills.desc: The black hole inside her pulls everything in. 0.6x to ALL enemies and Slows them (2 turns). +2 Void.

skills.name: Erase
skills.desc: Spend ALL Void: (1.5 + 0.45 per Void)x, ignores DEF. At 5 Void the enemy next to the target takes half as much.

recruit: A hollow figure in the observation room weaves a thread out of nothing. The thread is looking for something to hold.
The tide turns in a small circle around her. Nothing lands. Nothing stays.

book.abilityPlus: Black Hole Fusion

characters.name: Sevalio
characters.title: Patchwork Medic
characters.passive: Triage: stitched together himself, he knows where it hurts. His healing is 25% stronger on allies under 40% HP.
characters.ident: Gives his own blood to stitch allies back together, and heals the nearly dead best of all.

skills.name: Kunai Slice
skills.desc: A quick cut with the thread-wrapped kunai. 1.0x.

skills.name: Transfusion Stitch
skills.desc: Sevalio gives some of his own blood while he stitches the wound shut: he pays 8% of his max HP (never below 1 HP). The ally is healed for 45% max HP, cleansed of Slow, Irradiated, Stun and Mark, and gets +25% ATK for 2 turns. On himself it only heals 24% and skips the HP cost.

skills.name: Thread Snare
skills.desc: The thread binds the target. 0.7x, Slows it (2 turns) and Marks it (+30% damage taken, 2 turns).

recruit: A medic in mismatched sleeves is stitching up a Guard. It is the Guard who tried to stop him.
A needle and thread hang from a pipe over the water. Somebody is sewing a tag back onto a body.

book.notes: Brought over from old universe, still good for this one, doesn't need a rework. V272 buff (balance test: one of the weakest): HP and DEF raised, heals stronger.

characters.name: Monstro
characters.title: Tentacle Host
characters.passive: Many eyes, many hands: nothing is wasted. When his healing would overheal an ally, half of the extra spills over onto the most hurt ally.
characters.ident: Nothing is wasted: healing that overflows spills onto the most hurt ally.

skills.name: Tentacle Sweep
skills.desc: Tentacles sweep the target and the enemy next to it. 0.8x each.

skills.name: Cocoon
skills.desc: Tentacles wrap one ally in a cocoon. Heals 22% max HP and halves the damage they take for 2 turns.

skills.name: Many Hands
skills.desc: Every tentacle reaches out at once. Heals the whole party for 13% max HP and gives everyone +20% ATK for 2 turns.

recruit: Tentacles curl out of a vent, tidying things nobody asked them to. There is a gentle voice behind them.
Something has been feeding the sewer rats. They are all unusually well. It looks up, every eye, politely.

book.notes: Brought over from old universe, still good for this one, doesn't need a rework.

characters.name: Wugang
characters.title: Blindspot
characters.passive: Observer's Burden: born blind and trained to sense everything. Anything he hits goes Blurred (-20% damage, -35% at 3+ Sin), friends feel nothing. Fist Full of Sin piles Sin on the enemy, the toxic spear glows brighter (Glow, max 5, resets each wave: +5% damage each) for every enemy it hits.
characters.ident: Piles Sin on his victims, blurs everything he hits, and sweeps the line with a glowing spear.

skills.name: Fist Full of Sin
skills.desc: Every punch brings the victim's guilt back. 1.0x, +8% for each Sin already on the target, then +1 Sin (max 5), +1 Glow. At 3+ Sin he throws a second punch (0.5x) for +1 more Glow. Anything he hits goes Blurred.

skills.name: Spear of Sinful Punishment
skills.desc: The toxic spear hits the target (1.1x) and the enemy next to it (0.7x), adds 1 Sin to each, and poisons them (4% max HP per turn, 3 turns). +1 Glow for every enemy it hits.

skills.name: Domain: Weight of Sin
skills.desc: His senses flood a 100 metre radius. Spends ALL Glow: every enemy takes (0.6 + 0.1 per Glow + 0.25 per Sin on it)x and its Sin is spent. All enemies are heavily Blurred (-35%). At 5 Glow they are also Stunned (bosses are Slowed).

recruit: A blind man stands exactly in the middle of the corridor, facing exactly the right way.
The pumps are off. A man stands where the water is deepest and hears every drop.

book.abilityPlus: Observer's Burden
book.notes: Brought over from old universe, still good for this one, doesn't need a rework.

characters.name: Anigari
characters.title: Bullseye Paradox
characters.passive: Instability: 20% of enemy attacks aimed at her pass straight through her body. Reconstruction: if she is downed while an ally holds a Piece of her (Feed a Piece), she incarnates in them and gets back up.
characters.ident: Marks targets with Bullseye, slips through attacks, and comes back through the ally holding her Piece.

skills.name: Consume
skills.desc: She bites a piece out of the target. 1.0x, ignores DEF, and Anigari heals for 30% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Bullseye Bite
skills.desc: Her eye locks on and she bites through the gap it opens. 1.7x, ignores DEF, and the target is Marked for 3 turns: it takes +30% damage, and 35% of every hit it takes is pulled onto the other enemies. Anigari gets +20% DEF for 2 turns. The enemy next to the target takes 0.6x.

skills.name: Feed a Piece
skills.desc: She tears off a part of herself and feeds it to an ally (costs her 10% max HP, never below 1). The ally heals 20% max HP and gets +20% ATK for 2 turns. If Anigari goes down while an ally holds a Piece, she incarnates in them and gets back up at 40% HP. (Fed to herself it only heals 15%.)

recruit: Someone is standing in the cell block with a target painted on her chest. It keeps moving off her.
She wades through the sewer, bullseye glowing. The water goes straight through her.

book.abilityPlus: Reconstruction of its own body
book.notes: Brought over from old universe, still good for this one, doesn't need a rework.

characters.name: Sadie & The Stray
characters.title: Good Girl
characters.passive: Trapped Inside: Sadie's voice still works through the Stray, and the two look out for each other. Her healing is 25% stronger on allies under 50% HP. Echo Location Bark finds every enemy at once while mending the whole party, and Scavenged Camouflage lets the Stray hide a friend in the scrap and patch them up.
characters.ident: A pure healer who mends the party from Echo Location Bark and heals the badly hurt even more.

skills.name: Good Girl Lure
skills.desc: Sadie's old voice calls out, soft and familiar. Heals 30% max HP and calms the ally — +25% DEF for 2 turns.

skills.name: Echo Location Bark
skills.desc: A low frequency growl maps the whole room. All enemies are Marked (+30% damage taken, 2 turns) — nothing can hide from it. Heals the party 12% max HP.

skills.name: Scavenged Camouflage
skills.desc: The Stray drags an ally into the scrap and trash and covers them until the danger passes. Heals 20% max HP and gives Guard (half damage, 2 turns).

recruit: A scruffy dog with a girl's voice somewhere inside it is guarding a door.
A wet stray trots down the pipe, a girl's voice in its throat, tail wagging.

book.abilityPlus: Sound cues / echolocation
book.notes: Brought over from old universe, still good for this one, doesn't need a rework. V272 buff (balance test: one of the weakest): HP and DEF raised, heals stronger.

characters.name: Flick
characters.title: The Flipside
characters.passive: Invisible Threat: Flick can't be seen or targeted by enemies until Flipside Transfer turns him active and Taunting. Eye Contact forces a look into his mouth — it stuns him too, so use it with care.
characters.ident: Untargetable until Flipside Transfer, then a Taunting retaliator who turns hits around.

skills.name: Flipside Transfer
skills.desc: Flick turns visible and active — Taunt for 2 turns — and anything that hits him gets transferred back onto the attacker at 40% of the damage.

skills.name: Eye Contact
skills.desc: Flick forces the target to look him in the eyes. 0.6x, and the target is Marked (+30% damage taken, 2 turns) — but the sight of itself Slows Flick for 1 turn.

skills.name: Mouthful
skills.desc: 1.2x, ignores DEF. Heals Flick for 25% of the damage dealt.

recruit: An empty corridor. A voice from nowhere: "Look at me." Nothing is there.
The water ripples in the shape of something standing in it. It is smiling.

book.abilityPlus: Reversal
book.notes: Brought over from old universe, still good for this one, doesn't need a rework.

characters.name: Hound Dog
characters.title: Human Protocol
characters.passive: The Hunt: Hound Dog locks onto whatever he bites. Every hit on the SAME enemy builds Hunt (max 4) and each Hunt is +8% damage on all his moves; switching to another enemy drops the Hunt. Finish the prey and the hunt carries on: half the Hunt stays with him, Pounce is ready again and Human Protocol comes back 2 turns sooner.
characters.ident: Hunts one enemy at a time and snowballs on it, then chains kill after kill.

skills.name: Protocol Bite
skills.desc: Sinks his teeth in and starts the hunt. 1.0x, Marks the target for 2 turns (+15% damage taken). +1 Hunt on that enemy (each Hunt is +8% damage on all his moves).

skills.name: Pounce
skills.desc: Runs a wounded animal down. 1.4x, +50% against a target under half HP. +1 Hunt. If it finishes the target, Pounce is ready again.

skills.name: Human Protocol
skills.desc: Locks onto the target and ends the hunt. 1.5x, up to +1.2x more the more hurt the target is, ignores DEF (Hunt still adds +8% each). Needs no setup. Finishing the target brings Human Protocol back 2 turns sooner.

recruit: Heavy breathing behind the vent grate. Something with a man's gait and a dog's patience is on your trail.
Tracks in the sewer mud, a man's and a dog's, both heading the same way: toward you.

book.abilityPlus: Hunger Meter
book.notes: Brought over from old universe, still good for this one, doesn't need a rework.

characters.name: Cloak
characters.title: Kinetic Blast
characters.passive: Kinetic Charge: nothing Cloak touches is ever finished with. Every touch leaves stored energy inside the enemy (it shows as Primed) and Kinetic Blast sets ALL of it off at once, on every Primed enemy, ignoring DEF. Spread it wide, let it build, then pop the whole line.
characters.ident: Plants stored energy inside every enemy, then sets all of it off at once.

skills.name: Charged Touch
skills.desc: A brush of the hand leaves kinetic energy behind. 0.8x now, and the target is Primed: it stores 1.0x of energy that Kinetic Blast will release later (max 5.0x stored per enemy).

skills.name: Grinding Palm
skills.desc: Drags a palm along the whole enemy line. 0.45x to EVERY enemy (ignores DEF), and every enemy is Primed with 0.7x of stored energy.

skills.name: Kinetic Blast
skills.desc: Every bit of stored energy goes off at once. Each Primed enemy takes its stored energy as damage (stored 1.0x = a 1.0x hit, ignores DEF), +8% for every OTHER Primed enemy caught in the blast. Spends all stored energy.

recruit: A figure in a long cloak taps every wall as it passes. The taps are stacking up.
The pump station trembles. A cloaked figure sits among the machines, touching each pipe once.

book.notes: Nothing it touches is ever finished with.

characters.name: Serpentine
characters.title: Drop of Sand
characters.passive: Pocket Dimensions: every time Serpentine sleeps its tongue grows another slither, letting it step into a new pocket dimension on waking. Peaceful here, but the dreamcore nightmares on the other side rarely let visitors go. In the Order's worlds she grows Drowsy each turn and sleeps through a turn when the pips fill: Waking Dream or Drop of Sand (or a turn under Guard) keeps her awake.
characters.ident: A sleepy medic whose dreams heal and slow the enemy, and who must be kept awake in the Order's worlds.

skills.name: Hooked Fang
skills.desc: A fang from the pocket dimension’s worst nightmare. 1.0x, heals Serpentine for 35% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Waking Dream
skills.desc: Pulls an ally into the peaceful side of the dream, if only for a moment. Heals one ally 32% max HP and cleanses Slow, Burn, Stun and Mark. Wakes Serpentine fully (Drowsy back to 0).

skills.name: Drop of Sand
skills.desc: The snake’s tongue grows another slither and the whole dream shifts. Heals the whole party 20% max HP and Slows every enemy 3 turns. Wakes Serpentine fully (Drowsy back to 0).

recruit: A trail of fine sand runs down the corridor. At the end, someone is asleep standing up.
Sand pours out of a broken pipe. A snake-tongued medic naps on top of it.

book.notes: Tongue grows another slither with every sleep. v199 buff: HP 100>112, ATK 10>11, DEF 6, SPD 9>10; Hooked Fang 1.0x, 35% leech; Waking Dream 32%; Drop of Sand 20% + Slow 3 turns. V272 buff (balance test: one of the weakest): HP and DEF raised, heals stronger.

characters.name: Felo de se
characters.title: Martyrdom
characters.passive: Despair (max 5, resets each wave): Whisper Blurs and Marks, The Urge turns enemies on their own side and Martyrdom spends the Despair to break the whole line. He wins by wearing minds down, not by hitting hard. The living body of suicide, struck a deal with the Devil two thousand years ago. Anyone within 100 meters feels the urge to end themselves by any means possible — Felo de se included, every time he calls on it.
characters.ident: A psychological warfare controller: Blurs, Marks and turns enemies on each other, paying his own HP to do it.

skills.name: Whisper
skills.desc: Says the quiet part out loud. 0.7x and Blurs the target for 2 turns (-20% damage). If it was already Blurred it is also Marked for 2 turns (+25% damage taken). +1 Despair.

skills.name: The Urge
skills.desc: Within 100 metres, the urge to end it all creeps in. 0.5x, then the target turns on its own side: a non-boss attacks one of its allies on its next turn, a boss is Marked and Slowed for 2 turns instead. Felo de se feels it too and pays 5% of his own max HP (never below 1). +2 Despair.

skills.name: Martyrdom
skills.desc: The Devil’s bargain: everyone in range feels it at once. Every enemy is Blurred, Slowed and Marked for 2 turns and takes (0.4 + 0.1 per Despair)x. A non-boss left under 20% HP breaks and falls. Needs 3 Despair, spends all of it. Felo de se pays 10% of his own max HP (never below 1).

recruit: Every Guard in this corridor has put down their weapon and is staring at their own hands. One man in the middle is not.
A line of dead rats leads to one man in the dark, smiling the way people smile before a long fall.

book.notes: Psychological warfare / control: Blurs, Marks and turns foes on each other (Despair); damage is secondary.

characters.name: Dragonfire
characters.title: Mech Circuit
characters.passive: Mech Circuit: a UK soldier who was dead, then revived inside a cyborg body he is slowly rotting in, and used as a puppet to erase the UK's filthy past. Controlled with a pad: triangle locks on, cross launches, circle fires. His chest eyes lock on from ten kilometres out and he can connect to and fire almost any weapon his body can carry, and upgrades easily. Lock On and Launch build Lock (max 5, +4% DEF and +3% ATK each, resets each wave). Fire spends all Lock; at 5 Lock both arms fire. At full charge he can blow up an entire ship.
characters.ident: A cyborg guardian who locks on, launches, and fires while covering the party.

skills.name: Lock On
skills.desc: △ Chest-mounted eyes lock on from ten kilometres out, precise enough to hit a coin. 0.8x, Marks the target 2 turns (+20% damage taken) and Dragonfire gains Guard for 1 turn. +1 Lock.

skills.name: Launch
skills.desc: ✕ Launches a slow, heavy round at the front line. 0.7x to the target and the enemy next to it, Slows both (-30% SPD, 2 turns). Dragonfire Taunts for 2 turns. +1 Lock.

skills.name: Fire
skills.desc: ○ Everything it has been aiming at, released. Needs 3 Lock, spends all. (1.2 + 0.25 per Lock)x, ignores DEF, from one arm cannon. At 5 Lock both arms connect: a second shot at 0.8x, also ignoring DEF. Dragonfire gains Guard for 1 turn.

recruit: A soldier's body is bolted into a cyborg frame in the vent shaft. His chest eyes find you from the far end.
A cyborg stands knee-deep in the current, turning slowly. A rusted flag is stitched to his arm.

book.notes: Dead soldier kept moving inside a cyborg shell.

characters.name: Abomination Devic
characters.title: Forced Fusion
characters.passive: Forced Fusion: forces things together to make something new, whether they want to merge or not. Fuse Together and Abomination bind allies to him: a Fused ally passes a share of every hit to Devic (softened by his DEF). He heals as he fuses and braces with +20% DEF, so he can hold the load.
characters.ident: Forces allies together so he takes a share of every hit they would take.

skills.name: Forced Claw
skills.desc: Two things that were never meant to touch, forced together anyway. 1.0x to the target and the enemy next to it. Devic gains 1 Fusion stack (max 5, resets each wave) and recovers 5% max HP as the pieces knit.

skills.name: Fuse Together
skills.desc: Welds an ally’s defenses into something sturdier. +25% DEF for 2 turns and Guard (half damage taken) for 1 turn. DAMAGE SHARING: the ally is Fused for 3 turns and Devic takes 40% (+4% per Fusion stack) of every hit they take, up to 60%. Devic gains Guard for 1 turn, +20% DEF for 3 turns, recovers 8% max HP and gains 1 Fusion stack.

skills.name: Abomination
skills.desc: Spends every stored Fusion stack to force the whole enemy line into something new and broken. (0.7 + 0.1 per Fusion)x to every enemy, Slows them 2 turns. The whole party is Fused for 2 turns: Devic takes 20% of the damage every other ally takes (was 25%). Devic gains Guard for 1 turn and recovers 10% max HP.

recruit: Two Guards and a guard dog have been stitched into one shape, arguing. The shape sees you.
A heap of mismatched subjects, welded by the water into a single thing. Several faces turn at once.

book.notes: Do not leave two objects unattended near it.

characters.name: Smiley
characters.title: Smiling Blight
characters.passive: Smiling Blight: once you've forgotten it, your vision blurs until you pass out. It drags you off before it slits your throat — and another Smiley appears near wherever the last one finished (an execution brings a second Smiley down on the next enemy in line: 0.7x and Marked). IDENTITY, execute: every hit deals +25% to enemies under 40% HP, Slit Throat kills non-bosses there outright and resets itself.
characters.ident: Wears enemies into execution range, kills non-bosses outright, and another Smiley appears for the next victim.

skills.name: Grab
skills.desc: Once you’ve forgotten Smiley, he’s already got you. 1.1x. A target left under 40% HP is Marked 2 turns.

skills.name: Smiling Blight
skills.desc: Vision blurs, then goes dark. 0.7x, Blurs the target 2 turns (-20% damage dealt), Marks it 2 turns and Blights it for 3 turns (4% max HP each turn) to drag it toward execution range.

skills.name: Slit Throat
skills.desc: The part that happens after you pass out. 2.1x, ignores DEF. EXECUTE: a non-boss target under 40% HP is killed outright, Smiley heals 10% max HP and Slit Throat is ready again, and ANOTHER SMILEY appears beside the next enemy in line: 0.7x and Marked 2 turns. Bosses take the 2.1x instead.

recruit: Nobody remembers meeting this man. The Guards remember a smile, and nothing after it.
A man smiles in the pump room. His reflection smiles a second later.

book.notes: Memory loss on exposure. Exposure log is incomplete.

characters.name: Iris
characters.title: Morphomane
characters.passive: Morphomane: naturally extremely strong and semi-immortal. Anything organic, dead or alive, can be consumed into her body, and enough of it becomes plating and weapons. Consume and Weaponize build Mass (max 5, +6% DEF and +3% ATK each, resets each wave). Semi-immortal: once per wave, when she would go down, she collapses into her small parasite form, reforms at 25% HP and gets Guard for 2 turns. Almost Immortal spends all Mass.
characters.ident: Eats anything to grow plating and weapons, and pulls herself back together once per wave.

skills.name: Consume
skills.desc: Anything organic, dead or alive, can be taken into the body. 0.8x, ignores DEF, heals Iris for 30% of the damage dealt. +1 Mass (max 5, resets each wave). Eating a kill gives +1 more Mass and heals 8% max HP.

skills.name: Weaponize
skills.desc: Eaten mass is shaped into blades and plating. (0.7 + 0.05 per Mass)x to the target and the enemy next to it. Iris TAUNTS for 2 turns and gains Guard for 1 turn. +1 Mass.

skills.name: Almost Immortal
skills.desc: Naturally extremely strong, and nearly impossible to put down for good. Needs 2 Mass, spends all. Heals Iris (14% + 4% per Mass) max HP; she gains Guard, +20% DEF and Taunt for 2 turns. At 5 Mass the rest of the party also gets Guard for 1 turn.

recruit: The cafeteria is empty. The tables are gone. Something in it is a lot larger than it was.
A heap of scrap and bone plating blocks the tunnel. It breathes.

book.notes: Semi-immortal; regenerates between incidents.

characters.name: Nero
characters.title: ChainLink
characters.passive: ChainLink: can summon chains at will and attack anything he wants with them — they extend up to 5 meters and change shape on command. His torso actually cooks, courtesy of an old accident. IDENTITY, the chain: his moves Link enemies, and any damage the party deals to a Linked enemy splashes onto every other Linked enemy (30%, 40% with three or more).
characters.ident: Chains enemies together so one blow is felt by every enemy on the chain.

skills.name: Chain Lash
skills.desc: Chains answer to will alone, reshaping themselves mid-swing. 1.0x to the target and 0.6x to the enemy next to it. Both are Linked for 3 turns: damage the party deals to a Linked enemy splashes onto every other Linked enemy (30%, 40% with three or more).

skills.name: Extend 5 Meters
skills.desc: The chain stretches to its full five-metre reach and drives straight through. 1.5x, ignores DEF. The target is Linked 3 turns, and the chain runs down the links: every other Linked enemy takes 0.6x, ignores DEF.

skills.name: Chainlink Snare
skills.desc: Wraps the target in links that tighten the harder they struggle. 0.8x, Slows and Marks the target 2 turns each, then binds EVERY enemy into the chain: all Linked for 3 turns.

recruit: Chains hang from the ceiling, ending in nothing. The man holding the other ends has a very warm chest.
A chain splashes out of the water, finds a pipe, and pulls. A man steps out behind it, steaming.

book.notes: Chains reach 5 m. Do not stand at 5 m.

characters.name: Kitsuna
characters.title: Fox Demon
characters.passive: Cold Hunt: a fast, agile hunter who loves snow. Its fur fades white through the winter, slowly getting its colour back by spring. IDENTITY, the hunt: an opening window in the first 2 rounds, then +30% damage to any Slowed target so it can run its prey down.
characters.ident: Opens hard in the first rounds, then runs down anything Slowed.

skills.name: Cold Hunt
skills.desc: Fast and agile, built for the hunt. 1.2x, 20% stronger in the first 2 rounds of a wave while the scent is freshest (the hunting window). PURSUIT: every hit deals +30% to a Slowed target.

skills.name: Claw Rake
skills.desc: Two quick rakes before the target can react. 1.0x hits twice.

skills.name: Snow Pounce
skills.desc: A full-body pounce through the snow, claws first. 1.9x, ignores DEF, Slows the target 2 turns.

recruit: A white fox looks out of a vent. It is the size of a man. It does not blink.
Snow in the sewer. A fox demon stands in it, breath misting, ears forward.

book.notes: Active in cold rooms. Keep cell above freezing.

characters.name: Lifewire
characters.title: Lifewire
characters.passive: Lifewire: wires across its body passively steal power and electricity from anything nearby, and every blow he takes earths into him as 1 Charge. He soaks it, stores it, and pays it back in a Discharge that also hardens him. Got caught in a tub of wires on a job site, which burned him into something unrecognizable.
characters.ident: Soaks power and life through his wires until Discharge turns it all outward.

skills.name: Wire Drain
skills.desc: The wires across his body steal whatever power they can find. 0.9x, heals Lifewire for 30% of the damage dealt and builds 1 Charge (max 4, resets each wave).

skills.name: Lightning Rod
skills.desc: He plants himself and lets every wire in the room point at him. +30% DEF for 2 turns, Taunts, recovers 8% max HP and builds 1 Charge.

skills.name: Discharge
skills.desc: Everything he’s stolen goes out at once. (0.5 + 0.08 per Charge)x to every enemy, then the current earths through his body: +(10% + 5% per Charge) DEF for 2 turns. Spends all Charge.

recruit: Every light in the corridor flickers once. Something in the walls is eating the power.
Wires float in the sewage like seaweed, tangled around a person-shaped burn.

book.notes: Drains nearby power; stores it for later.

characters.name: Cy
characters.title: Kinetic Burden
characters.passive: Kinetic Burden: can absorb, store and manipulate the physical concept of resistance. Every push against a force — heavy wind, a dragging punch, something heavy — becomes weight his body stores and can weaponize later. IDENTITY, burden: every enemy hit he takes builds 1 Burden (max 5, resets each wave), so the harder he is pressured the harder Downhill lands.
characters.ident: Turns every blow he takes into Burden, then releases it all at once in Downhill.

skills.name: Bouldering
skills.desc: Channels resistance straight into the fist. 1.35x, ignores DEF, builds 1 Burden stack (max 5, resets each wave).

skills.name: Incline
skills.desc: Projects stored weight outward into a brace that nothing gets through easily. +30% DEF for 2 turns, Taunts and he recovers 8% max HP. Every hit he takes while braced is weight he keeps: +1 Burden now, and each enemy hit on Cy builds 1 Burden too.

skills.name: Downhill
skills.desc: Releases everything at once, every ounce of struggle turned momentum. (1.5 + 0.2 per Burden)x, ignores DEF, spends all Burden.

archive: Item FAL-0031 lives isolated, mostly in the mountains. He barely eats, but likes to eat meat. Scent: Monster Noir by Voskanian Parfums. The subject sees everybody as something monstrous and is afraid of humans. He can attack immediately and calls it self-defense.

Ability: Kinetic Burden. The subject can absorb, store and manipulate the physical concept of resistance. Every time he pushes against a force (heavy winds, a punch, dragging something heavy, or battling his own mental state) his body stores that kinetic friction as burden. He can weaponize this weight and momentum in many ways.

Interviewer: How does the ability charge?
{n}: Every time I push against something.
Interviewer: What counts?
{n}: Wind. A punch. Something heavy. My own mind.
Interviewer: How do you see us?
{n}: I fear what is coming.

Known moves: He projects weight outward into a 20 ft radius; enemies face violent gravity changes and lose stamina. Boulder: channels energy into his fist or weapon for massive damage. Downhill: releases everything for 10 seconds, giving super speed for those 10 seconds. Anchor: floods the skeleton with weight, crushing from the inside. Sensory Overload: grinds weight into the ground or air to create shockwaves.
Because the ability needs struggle to charge, the subject is always stuck in a loop, enduring constant pain and exhaustion to reach his full potential. He trains with boulders, the heavy ones.
He fears humans and he strikes first. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A man pushes against a closed door that will not open, and does not stop pushing. He has been at it a long time.
A wall of water presses against a man who is not moving. He is smiling at it.

book.notes: Absorbs and stores resistance. v199 buff: HP 135>150, ATK 11>12, DEF 11, SPD 6>7; Bouldering 1.35x; Incline +30% DEF and heals 8%; Downhill 1.5x + 0.2 per Burden.

characters.name: Dia
characters.title: Frozen Clock
characters.passive: Frozen Clock: born at the freezing point of the earth, a top soldier for the Neico Clan. Basically just stops time for 5-10 seconds when it matters most. Every move makes him the one enemies have to deal with: Ice Edge hardens him, Cold Snap Taunts while the target is frozen, and Frozen Clock guards the whole party.
characters.ident: Controls the pace of the fight with cold: Taunts, Slows, and a Frozen Clock that stops the room.

skills.name: Ice Edge
skills.desc: A blade carried from the freezing point of the earth. 0.9x, and the cold hardens Dia: +15% DEF for 2 turns.

skills.name: Cold Snap
skills.desc: A fraction of a second, stolen from the target’s clock. 0.6x, Stuns the target 1 turn (bosses Slowed 2 turns instead). Dia steps forward: Taunt (2 turns).

skills.name: Frozen Clock
skills.desc: Basically just stops time for 5 to 10 seconds — long enough to matter. Slows every enemy 2 turns and hits each for 0.4x. While the world is frozen the whole party takes half damage (Guard, 1 turn) and Dia takes the lead: Guard + Taunt (2 turns).

recruit: The clock in the guard room has stopped. The soldier next to it hasn't blinked in a while.
A drip hangs in midair above the water. Beneath it stands a soldier of the Neico Clan, calm.

book.notes: Former Neico Clan soldier.

characters.name: Sunshine
characters.title: Killer Sunrise
characters.passive: Killer Sunrise: a quiet killer that strikes without warning, just like its namesake. IDENTITY, ambush: every hit deals +35% against an enemy that has not acted yet this round, and her opener can Slow or Stun it before it ever gets to move.
characters.ident: An ambusher who hits hardest against enemies that have not acted yet this round.

skills.name: Serrated Bite
skills.desc: A row of serrated teeth, closing fast. 1.2x. AMBUSH: against a target that has not acted this round it deals +35% and Slows the target 1 turn.

skills.name: Tail Whip
skills.desc: The armored tail sweeps wide. 0.9x to the target and the enemy next to it.

skills.name: Killer Sunrise
skills.desc: Strikes without warning, just like its namesake. 2.0x, ignores DEF. AMBUSH: against a target that has not acted this round it deals +35% and Stuns it for 1 turn (bosses are Slowed instead).

recruit: A quiet figure sits in the shaft of light from the only window. Nobody knows when she arrived.
A shaft of daylight falls through a manhole. A shadow stands in it, patient.

book.notes: Strikes at dawn. Night staff report no incidents.

characters.name: Akuna
characters.title: Thy Devourer
characters.passive: Containment Level: High. Every Maw Snap and Dread Gaze builds Hunger (max 5, resets each wave). Thy Devourer spends it all on one huge bite that heals him.
characters.ident: Builds Hunger with every bite and gaze, then devours one enemy and heals on it.

skills.name: Maw Snap
skills.desc: A mouth that was never meant to be contained. 1.1x. +1 Hunger.

skills.name: Dread Gaze
skills.desc: Two huge red eyes lock on and do not blink. 0.8x, Marks the target 3 turns (+25% damage taken). +1 Hunger.

skills.name: Thy Devourer
skills.desc: Containment failed. (1.5 + 0.3 per Hunger)x, heals Akuna for 25% of the damage dealt and spends all Hunger. Needs 3 Hunger.

recruit: A chained shape in Containment Level: High pulls at its restraints. One of them is already loose.
Something that was once held in a high-level cell has been living in the sewer. It has been eating well.

book.notes: Containment level confirmed High in game data.

characters.name: Kano
characters.title: Collared Beast
characters.passive: Spiked Hide: whoever hits him takes 15% of that damage back. Barbed Swipe and Hardened Hide grow his Spikes (max 5, +6% ATK each, resets each wave).
characters.ident: A thorned tank: whoever hits him takes damage back, and his Spikes make him hit harder.

skills.name: Barbed Swipe
skills.desc: Long claws, spiked all the way up the arm. 1.0x. +1 Spike.

skills.name: Hardened Hide
skills.desc: The spines flare and lock. Kano takes half damage for 1 turn, heals 8% max HP and grows 2 Spikes.

skills.name: Thousand Claws
skills.desc: Every claw at once. Three strikes of (0.6 + 0.08 per Spike)x each. Spends 2 Spikes.

recruit: A huge collared beast paces its cell, spikes bristling. The collar is Fal-125's.
Spikes scrape against a pipe and a collar clinks in the dark. The beast's eyes are wary.

book.notes: Reflects part of any damage dealt to it.

characters.name: Sleepy
characters.title: Sleep Powder
characters.passive: Sleep Powder: dust from her moth wings. Moth Rake heals the most hurt ally, Lullaby Scales mend and shield one friend, and Sleep Powder slows every enemy while the strongest one drops off to sleep.
characters.ident: Heals with moth dust while Sleep Powder slows the room and puts the strongest enemy to sleep.

skills.name: Moth Rake
skills.desc: Hooded claws, quick and quiet. 0.9x, and the most hurt ally is healed for 25% of the damage dealt.

skills.name: Lullaby Scales
skills.desc: Soft red scales settle on an ally. Heals one ally 26% max HP and gives them Guard for 1 turn.

skills.name: Sleep Powder
skills.desc: Dust from the moth wings drifts over the room. Slows every enemy 2 turns and the strongest one falls asleep (Stunned 1 turn, bosses Slowed 2 turns instead). The party breathes easier too: heals 6% max HP.

recruit: A drowsy girl with moth wings sits on a bunk, dust drifting off her. The Guards nearby are dozing.
Moth dust falls over the sewer like snow. The rats are asleep.

book.notes: Moth-wing dust causes sleep. Wear a mask.

characters.name: Spiral
characters.title: Spiral Gut
characters.passive: Spiral Gut: a spiral turns inside its stomach. Raking Claws and Hypnotic Spiral wind it up (max 5, +5% DEF each, resets each wave). IDENTITY, control attention and survive the punishment: while Spiral is Taunting, every hit on it heals it for 20% of the damage, winds the spiral +1 and Slows the attacker. Down the Drain spends it all on one crushing pull and heals it back.
characters.ident: Draws every attack into his spiral, healing from each punished hit, then drains the room.

skills.name: Raking Claws
skills.desc: Long black claws drag across the target. 1.0x. +1 Spiral.

skills.name: Hypnotic Spiral
skills.desc: The spiral in its gut starts to turn and nobody can look away. Slows every enemy 2 turns, Spiral Taunts for 2 turns and takes half damage for 1 turn. +2 Spiral. While Taunting, every hit it takes heals it for 20% of the damage, builds +1 Spiral and Slows the attacker.

skills.name: Down the Drain
skills.desc: Everything gets pulled into the middle. (1.3 + 0.3 per Spiral)x, ignores DEF, Marks the target 2 turns. At 5 Spiral the target is also Stunned (bosses Slowed). Spiral heals 6% max HP per Spiral spent. Spends all Spiral. Needs 3 Spiral.

recruit: A spiral turns slowly in the stomach of someone standing very still. It slows when you stare at it.
Water is swirling down the drain in a perfect spiral. Whatever causes it is waiting.

book.notes: Something turns inside it. Do not ask what.

characters.name: Nukasaurus
characters.title: Poison Nuke
characters.passive: Fal-125's attempt to make new life from old dinosaur DNA mixed with living entities. Every bite and nuke builds Fallout (max 5, +5% ATK each, resets each wave). IDENTITY, infection: an Irradiated enemy infects the enemies beside it at the start of its turn (each new infection is +1 Fallout), and Domain Expansion detonates every infected enemy at once: an unavoidable hit that spreads the infection further.
characters.ident: Infects one enemy and lets the sickness spread down the line, then sets every infection off at once.

skills.name: Toxic Maw
skills.desc: Dinosaur jaws dripping with something green. 1.0x and Irradiates the target 2 turns. +1 Fallout.

skills.name: Poison Nuke
skills.desc: A glowing green nuke, spat out of its eye. 1.3x, Irradiates the target 3 turns and INFECTS the enemy next to it (Irradiated 2 turns). +2 Fallout.

skills.name: Domain Expansion: Nuke Field
skills.desc: The infection goes critical. EVERY Irradiated enemy becomes a nuke site: (0.9 + 0.25 per Fallout)x, ignores DEF, Guard and cover, nothing can phase out of it. Each blast re-infects (Irradiated 3 turns) the enemies beside it. Clean enemies are untouched. Spends all Fallout. Needs 3 Fallout and at least one Irradiated enemy.

archive: Item FAL-0038 is Fal-125's attempt to create new life from old dinosaur DNA mixed with living entities, made as a new weapon.
Ability: Poison Nuke and Domain Expansion. The Nuke Field gives a 100% hit success rate and no way to escape.

Interviewer: What are you?
{n}: Fal-125's attempt to create new life.
Interviewer: Made from what?
{n}: Old dinosaur DNA mixed with living entities.
Interviewer: Why?
{n}: A new weapon.
Interviewer: Did it work?
{n}: Sort of.
Domain Expansion observed. Inside the Nuke Field every attack hits and there is no way to escape. Survivors: ██.
Once the Nuke Field is expanded there is no way out. Exposure log sealed.
It was meant to be a new weapon. It sort of worked, leading to this. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A lizard the size of a bus wears a Fal-125 tag. It sniffs you. The air turns greener.
The sewage glows green around something with a long tail and a tag. It is not happy to see you.

book.notes: Fal-125 experiment: dinosaur DNA fused with living entities.

characters.name: Moon
characters.title: Moonlit Singer
characters.passive: Containment Level: None. A singer who mixes pop and metal, with moon-based powers she refuses to use to hurt anyone. She sends her helper (Who's 6.6) to do the dirty work. THE PARTY-WIDE HEALER: every move heals or covers the whole party. Every move builds Phase (max 5, +4% healing each, resets each wave).
characters.ident: Sings the party stronger: every move builds Phase for bigger heals and a louder encore.

skills.name: Dirty Work
skills.desc: Moon never lifts a finger. She sends her helper, Who's 6.6, to do the dirty work. 0.7x, and a soft hum heals the whole party 4% max HP. +1 Phase.

skills.name: Metal Verse
skills.desc: Pop on the verse, metal on the chorus. Heals the whole party 14% max HP, clears Slow and Mark, and gives everyone +15% ATK for 2 turns. +1 Phase.

skills.name: Full Moon Encore
skills.desc: The moon answers the crowd. Heals the whole party (14% + 5% per Phase) max HP, cleanses Slow, Irradiated, Stun and Mark, and everyone takes half damage for 1 turn. Spends all Phase. Needs 3 Phase.

archive: Item FAL-0039 is a singer. Containment Level: None.
The subject is a singer who mixes pop and metal music. She also has moon-based powers.

Interviewer: Do you use your powers to harm?
{n}: No.
Interviewer: Then who does?
{n}: My helper.
The subject does not use her moon powers to harm anyone. She sends her helper (6.6) to do the dirty work. Helper file: sealed.
Containment Level: None. Helper designation: 6.6.
She never uses the moon to harm. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: Somebody is singing in the infirmary, half pop, half metal. The Guards are crying.
A song echoes down the pipes, far too beautiful for this place. A figure with a moon behind her is singing it.

book.notes: Containment level None per game data. v199 healer identity: PARTY-WIDE healer. Dirty Work heals party 4%; Metal Verse 14% + cleanse; Full Moon Encore 14% + 5% per Phase. V272 buff (balance test: one of the weakest): HP and DEF raised, heals stronger.

characters.name: Sinkhole
characters.title: Four Syringes
characters.passive: Containment Level: Medium. A huge masked brute that needs his four syringes to survive (Purple, Yellow, Blue, Red), each one mixed with his own blood and each with a price. Purple, Yellow and Blue build Dose (max 5, resets each wave): each Dose is +5% DEF and +4% ATK. The needles no longer have a downside; the Red Syringe still does. The Red Syringe, Final Mode, is only ever his Divine Ultimate and spends every Dose. He wants to quit, but can't. He has a daughter he misses.
characters.ident: Injects himself with syringes that each cost blood, trading health for power.

skills.name: Purple Syringe
skills.desc: Nightvision and enhanced senses: he sees every weak spot. 1.1x and Marks the target 2 turns (+25% damage taken). +1 Dose.

skills.name: Yellow Syringe
skills.desc: Regeneration and enhanced strength. Heals Sinkhole 18% max HP, +25% ATK for 2 turns, and Taunts all enemies for 2 turns. +1 Dose.

skills.name: Blue Syringe
skills.desc: Hyper speed and a freezing aura. 0.8x to every enemy, Slows them 2 turns, and gives Sinkhole +15% DEF for 2 turns. +2 Dose.

archive: Item FAL-0040 is held at Containment Level: Medium. The subject needs his drugs to survive. Without them he would die in 2 to 3 days.
Ability: 4 Drug System. The subject has 4 differently coloured syringes in his body. When he decides he needs a drug, he clicks it. Each syringe has 50 injections before it needs a refill.

Interviewer: Do you want to stop?
{n}: Yes.
Interviewer: Can you?
{n}: I literally can't.
Interviewer: Is there someone you miss?
{n}: My daughter.

Drug effects: Purple: nightvision and enhanced senses; weakness: hallucinations. Yellow: regeneration, enhanced strength and bone reinforcements; weakness: paralysis after use. Blue: hyper speed and a freezing aura; weakness: violent shaking after use. Red: final mode, enhanced body, enlarged bites, hyper speed and regeneration; weakness: shortens his life span and destroys his sanity.
The subject wants to quit drugs but literally can't. He has a daughter he misses.
Red shortens his life span and destroys his sanity. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A masked brute pulls a syringe out of his forearm and looks at you, as if choosing.
A needle floats in the sewer. A huge masked figure plucks it out of the water.

book.notes: Containment level Medium per game data.

characters.name: Intervein
characters.title: Gold Absorption
characters.passive: Containment Level: Medium. A 29-year-old man who absorbs gold from anything into his body, making it sturdier. Gold runs through him like veins and about 70% of his body is gold. He must purge it every 8 days (sacrificing most of it) and can pull in all the gold within 10 km. Every move builds Gold (max 5, +5% DEF each, resets each wave); Purge the Gold spends it all.
characters.ident: Absorbs Gold as he takes hits, getting sturdier, then purges it all in one blow.

skills.name: Gilded Claw
skills.desc: Gold-veined claws rake the target. 1.0x. Absorbs the gold it touches: +1 Gold and +1 coin.

skills.name: Gold Absorption
skills.desc: Drinks in all the gold in the room. Heals Intervein 12% max HP, he Taunts and takes half damage for 2 turns. +2 Gold and +3 coins.

skills.name: Purge the Gold
skills.desc: Swings the golden hammer and sheds the gold. (1.3 + 0.3 per Gold)x, ignores DEF, the whole party takes half damage for 1 turn, and +2 coins per Gold spent. Spends all Gold. Needs 3 Gold.

archive: Item FAL-0041: a 29 year old male. Containment Level: Medium. The subject absorbs all gold within a 10 km radius, which is how he has so much.

Ability: Gold Absorption. The subject can absorb gold from anything into his body and uses it to make his body sturdier. The gold spreads over his body like veins under his clothes. He has extra arms.

Interviewer: How old are you?
{n}: 29.
Interviewer: How much of you is gold?
{n}: 70%.
Interviewer: How do you get so much?
{n}: I absorb all the gold in a 10 km radius.
Every 8 days the subject needs a sacrifice, which gets 60% of the gold out of his body. Sacrifices to date: ██.
The subject needs to get rid of the gold on his body. All gold within 10 km is absorbed.
He is 70% gold. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: Gold flecks run through the walls toward one man. He glows a little along the veins.
Every coin in the sewer slides toward a man standing in the current, gold climbing his arms.

book.notes: Absorbs gold. Containment Medium per game data.

characters.name: Nose
characters.title: Fireworks
characters.passive: A clown with his own cut-off face stitched onto his face (not by himself). He does not finish enemies, he lights them. A lit enemy goes off on its own at the start of its turn: short fuses go off at once, longer fuses grow 25% stronger every turn they burn. Each blast splashes 40% onto the rest of the line, and an enemy that falls while lit goes up in the crowd for 60%.
characters.ident: Lights fuses on enemies and lets them go off on their own timers.

skills.name: Sparkler Jab
skills.desc: A lit sparkler shoved where it hurts. 0.9x, and lights a SHORT fuse on the target: it goes off at the start of that enemy's next turn for 0.8x. Lighting an enemy that is already lit adds power and shortens its fuse.

skills.name: Bottle Rocket
skills.desc: Launched at point blank. 1.0x, then lights a MEDIUM fuse (2 turns, 1.0x, +25% every turn it burns) on the target AND the enemy next to it.

skills.name: Grand Finale
skills.desc: The opening salvo hits every enemy for 0.4x, then EVERY enemy is lit with a LONG fuse (3 turns, 1.0x, +25% every turn it burns: 1.56x at the end). Already-lit enemies get 1.0x more power instead.

recruit: A clown wearing a second, cut-off face lights a match in the dark of the corridor.
A tiny spark drifts through the sewer gas. At the other end of it, a clown laughing at nothing.

book.notes: Wears a stitched-on copy of its own face.

characters.name: The Watcher
characters.title: Screech
characters.passive: One yellow eye, a mouth full of rows of teeth, and a scream nobody forgets. Gaze and Teeth build Echo (max 5, +6% SPD each, resets each wave). Screech spends it all to rattle every enemy at once.
characters.ident: Builds Echo with every glance, getting faster until one Screech rattles the whole line.

skills.name: Unblinking Gaze
skills.desc: The yellow eye never closes. 0.9x and Marks the target 2 turns. +1 Echo.

skills.name: Rows of Teeth
skills.desc: Far too many teeth. 1.4x, and The Watcher heals for 25% of the damage dealt. +1 Echo.

skills.name: Screech
skills.desc: A scream that rattles every skull. (0.7 + 0.2 per Echo)x to EVERY enemy and Blurs them 2 turns (they deal less damage). At 4+ Echo they are also Stunned 1 turn. Spends all Echo. Needs 3 Echo.

recruit: One yellow eye looks through a ventilation grate. Beneath it, a mouth full of rows of teeth.
A single yellow eye surfaces in the water and blinks. Teeth follow.

book.notes: Scream is not to be recorded.

characters.name: Maw
characters.title: Needy Spiral
characters.passive: Containment Level: High. Needy Spiral plants lies in people's heads, and most of them weaken over time because of it. Maw wants to be noticed: every time an enemy hits him he snaps right back (0.5x, or 0.85x while Spiteful) and finds a Banana Chip in his pocket (max 5, +5% ATK and +4% DEF each, +10% ATK more at a full bag, resets each wave). A Tank by nature: he wants every hit aimed at him, so he Taunts, shrugs hits off and punishes whoever swings. Banana Chip Feast eats the bag to heal him and fire him up. Banana chips are something he loves: they appear out of nowhere about 10 times a day. He loves taunting people and making them mad. He hates his enemy, The Hallwalker, and hits him 30% harder. Walker is his eternal enemy and the opposite of him: Maw never stops talking, so he cannot be Stunned, Slowed or Seamed, and Needy Spiral talks the buffs and Seams off its target. If they stand in the same party they cannot stand to be outdone: whenever one lands a kill, the other gets +15% ATK for 2 turns. Favorite food: banana chips.
characters.ident: Takes the hits on purpose, snaps back at every attacker, and eats the chips he earns.

skills.name: Crowbar Swing
skills.desc: His signature crowbar, swung with a grin. 0.9x. +1 Banana Chip, and 35% of the time a fresh bag appears out of nowhere (+1 more).

skills.name: Needy Spiral
skills.desc: Plants a lie in their head and mocks them for it. 0.7x, Blurs the target (-20% damage), weakens it over time (Venom) for 3 turns and talks away its ATK and DEF buffs and Seams. Then the whole room wants him: Maw Taunts, gains +20% DEF and turns SPITEFUL for 2 turns (takes 35% less damage, his counters hit for 0.85x instead of 0.5x). +1 Banana Chip.

skills.name: Banana Chip Feast
skills.desc: Eats the bag. Heals 8% max HP per Chip, and fires Maw up: +20% DEF and +20% ATK for 2 turns (+35% ATK with a full bag of 5). Spends all Chips. Needs 2 Banana Chips.

archive: Item FAL-0044 is held at Containment Level: High. Needy Spiral plants lies in the heads of people around the subject, and most people weaken over time because of it. Signature weapon: crowbar.

Abilities: Needy Spiral and Banana Chip. Banana chips appear out of nowhere around the subject about 10 times a day, like an entire bag full. They give him a straight boost, and he can use them as explosives.

Interviewer: What is your favorite food?
{n}: Banana chips.
Interviewer: Who do you hate?
{n}: Walker.
Interviewer: Why do you taunt people?
{n}: It makes them mad.
During the exercise the subject used banana chips as explosives and took a straight boost. Personnel nearby weakened over time. Result withheld.
The subject loves taunting people and making them mad. He hates his enemy, Walker.
Lies are planted in your head, and most people weaken over time. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A man pulls faces at the camera until it looks away. He wants you to look at him.
A figure on a floating pallet shouts at the passing rats. Banana chip bags drift around him.

book.notes: Tank since v140.2: Taunts, counters every hit, Banana Chips add ATK and DEF. Containment level High per game data.

characters.name: Back Shatter
characters.title: Mini Black Hole
characters.passive: His back gets destroyed, but it turns into a mini black hole sucking in everything around it, and he can still move normally while it is active. Nothing ever came back from it. Shatter Claws and Gravity Pull build Pull (max 5, +4% ATK each, resets each wave). Back Shatter spends it all, and anything it leaves nearly dead is pulled in for good.
characters.ident: Pulls enemies in with his mini black hole and smashes them apart.

skills.name: Shatter Claws
skills.desc: Spiked claws raked across one target. 1.0x. +1 Pull.

skills.name: Gravity Pull
skills.desc: The hole in his back drags the whole enemy line toward him. 0.5x to every enemy and Slows them 2 turns. +2 Pull.

skills.name: Back Shatter
skills.desc: His back shatters and becomes a mini black hole that sucks in everything around it (he can still move normally). (0.8 + 0.3 per Pull)x to every enemy, and any non-boss left under 20% HP is pulled in and never comes back. Bosses are Marked and Slowed instead. Costs 10% max HP, spends all Pull. Needs 3 Pull.

archive: Item FAL-0045 is observed in two states: normal, and active. While its ability is active the subject can still move normally.
Ability: Back Shatter. The subject's back gets destroyed, but it turns into a mini black hole that sucks everything around it into it. The subject can move normally while the ability is active.

Interviewer: What happens to your back?
{n}: It gets destroyed.
Interviewer: And then?
{n}: It turns into a black hole.
Interviewer: What happens to what goes in?
{n}: Nothing ever came back from it.
During the exercise the subject's back was destroyed and became a mini black hole, pulling everything around it in while the subject kept moving normally. Result withheld.
Nothing has ever come back from the black hole. Items lost: ██.
It sucks in everything around it. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A man with a hole where his back should be stands at the end of the corridor. Small things drift toward him.
The water spirals toward a man's back, where a tiny black hole spins and sucks at the sewer.

book.notes: Back collapsed into a mini black hole; still mobile.

characters.name: Weeping Angel
characters.title: Do Not Look Away
characters.passive: A black, many-toothed angel with a great weeping eye and wings that look soft until they close around you. Feather Slam and Weeping Veil build Sorrow (max 5, +5% DEF each, resets each wave). Do Not Look Away spends it all: every enemy is forced to look, then the Angel Taunts and Guards the party's front line. IDENTITY, protect one ally and punish whoever threatens them: Weeping Veil Wards an ally and every enemy that hits the Warded ally takes damage back and feeds the Angel's Sorrow.
characters.ident: Stands over one ally: anyone who hits them takes the damage back and feeds her Sorrow.

skills.name: Feather Slam
skills.desc: A heavy wing swung down on one target. 1.0x. +1 Sorrow.

skills.name: Weeping Veil
skills.desc: Wraps an ally in the dark wings. Heals them 10% max HP, +25% DEF for 2 turns and Guard (half damage) for 1 turn. +2 Sorrow. The ally is Warded for 3 turns: every enemy that hits them takes 30% of the damage back and gives the Angel +1 Sorrow.

skills.name: Do Not Look Away
skills.desc: The great eye opens and every enemy is made to look. (0.6 + 0.2 per Sorrow)x to every enemy (x1.5 against enemies that already looked at the Angel by hitting a Warded ally) and Marks them 2 turns; at 5 Sorrow they are Stunned too. The Angel then Taunts and Guards for 2 turns, and Warded allies are Guarded for 2 turns. Spends all Sorrow. Needs 2 Sorrow.

recruit: A statue in the chapel wing weeps. The tears are real. It wasn't there a minute ago.
A stone angel stands in the pump station, water running from its eye. It is closer than it was.

book.notes: Do not look away. Do not blink in the cell.

characters.name: Rue
characters.title: Devil's Bargain
characters.passive: A shy, hooded devil in a red hoodie with a spiked tail and a very tired look. THE BURST HEALER: Tail Lash and Fishnet Patch build Pact (max 5, +4% healing each, resets each wave). Fishnet Patch is the biggest single-target heal in the game, and Devil's Bargain heals and empowers the whole party for a price paid in his own blood.
characters.ident: Strikes devil's bargains that heal and empower the party at a cost of his own blood.

skills.name: Tail Lash
skills.desc: The spiked tail whips across one target. 0.7x, and the most hurt ally is healed for 45% of the damage dealt. +1 Pact.

skills.name: Fishnet Patch
skills.desc: Stitches a wound shut with a strip of fishnet. The BIG single-target heal: 38% max HP and Guard for 1 turn. +1 Pact.

skills.name: Devil's Bargain
skills.desc: A deal with the Devil, paid for in blood. Heals the whole party (14% + 5% per Pact) max HP and gives them +20% ATK for 2 turns. Costs Rue 8% max HP. Spends all Pact. Needs 2 Pact.

recruit: A hooded figure in a red hoodie sits in the corner of cell 9, tail twitching. They look tired.
A spiked tail trails in the water. A red hoodie stands behind it, hands in pockets.

book.notes: Shy. Wears a hood in all footage. v199 healer identity: BURST healer. Fishnet Patch 38% single heal; Devil's Bargain 14% + 5% per Pact.

characters.name: Marrow
characters.title: Fallen Scribe
characters.passive: Chipping In: a former angel who grew sick of humans. His book stores the info of every victim, and he only needs to take one piece of bone from each. He grinds the fragments into weapons and armour and stitches them onto his own body. THE BOOK lasts the whole run: every enemy he kills has its name written in it, and every kind of enemy already in the Book takes 45% more damage from him. Every kill takes a bone, and so does a Bone Nib that leaves an enemy under half HP (max 12 a run). Each bone is +2% ATK and +2% DEF. He starts every run weak and ends it strong. Death Toll reads the Book aloud: it hits every enemy and Marks the ones already written down.
characters.ident: Writes every kill into a Book that lasts the whole run, and hits anything already in it much harder. Weak early, strong late.

skills.name: Name in the Book
skills.desc: Writes a name and the body follows. 1.2x. If this kind of enemy is already in the Book, he knows how it dies: +45% damage (this counts for all his moves). A kill writes the name in for the rest of the run and takes a bone.

skills.name: Bone Nib
skills.desc: Writes with a sliver of bone. 0.8x, Marks the target AND the enemy beside it for 2 turns (+15% damage taken). If the target is left under half HP, he takes a bone from it without waiting for it to die (once per enemy).

skills.name: Death Toll
skills.desc: He reads the Book aloud. 0.85x to every enemy. Every enemy whose name is already written is also Marked for 2 turns, and takes the Book’s +45% like always.

archive: Item FAL-0048 is to be kept away from bone fragments of any person. The subject needs only a bone piece from a victim to store their information in its book.

Ability: Chipping In. The subject's book stores the information of all its victims; it just needs to take a bone piece from them. The amount of fragments it holds decides how many weapons and how much armor it can create. Its skin is ripped apart, with plushies stitched to it. It has wings.

Interviewer: What does the book hold?
{n}: The information of all my victims.
Interviewer: What do you need from them?
{n}: A bone piece.
Interviewer: What do you make from the fragments?
{n}: Weapons. Armor.
Interviewer: How much?
{n}: It depends how many fragments I have.
During the exercise the subject used bone fragments to create weapons and armor and stitched them to the body. The amount of fragments decided how much it made. Result withheld.
The book stores the information of every victim. Entries: ██████.
The white cracks along the armor are fragments of bone. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A man with a book stands in the Warden's records room. He has taken a rib from the filing cabinet.
A bone glints in the sewer. A scribe in a torn halo is sorting through the remains.

book.notes: Fallen angel. Resents humans. V240 REWORK: the Book replaces Toll. It lasts the whole run: every kill writes the enemy kind in (+45% damage to known kinds) and takes a bone (max 12, +2% ATK and DEF each); Bone Nib also takes a bone from an enemy left under half HP. Weak early, strong late.

characters.name: Seam
characters.title: Missing Texture
characters.passive: Somewhere, her real model failed to load. What's left is only ever half-rendered, patched over in the same magenta-and-black error checker that should have been skin. THE TRIAGE HEALER: the more of herself goes missing, the better she remembers how to fix what's broken in someone else. Re-Render heals the worst-hurt ally the most and every cast builds Missing Texture for Full Reload.
characters.ident: Re-renders the party while her missing pieces teach her to fix more.

skills.name: Re-Render
skills.desc: Forces a corrupted patch of an ally to redraw itself. TRIAGE: heals 18% max HP, plus up to 22% more the more hurt the ally is (40% on a nearly-dead ally). Leaves 1 Missing Texture on herself.

skills.name: Checker Lash
skills.desc: A strip of magenta-and-black error texture lashes out. 1.0x and leaves 1 Missing Texture on herself (max 5, resets each wave; each stack is +4% healing).

skills.name: Full Reload
skills.desc: Forces the whole party to reload at once. Heals everyone for (16 + 5 per Missing Texture)% max HP and clears her stacks.

recruit: In the corner of the cell block, a patch of wall is magenta and black. A girl is standing in the patch.
The sewer water has a missing texture. She stands in the middle of it, flickering.

book.notes: Her real model failed to load. v199 healer identity: TRIAGE healer. Re-Render heals 18% + up to 22% by missing HP and builds Missing Texture; Full Reload 16% + 5% per stack. V272 buff (balance test: one of the weakest): HP and DEF raised, heals stronger.

characters.name: Glitch
characters.title: Digital Death
characters.passive: Containment Level: Unknown. It grows a size and a head taller every time it's provoked, hardening as it goes — and nobody has seen what it looks like once it stops growing. IDENTITY, grow as enemies hit it and unleash the Chaos: every enemy hit on Glitch builds +1 Chaos (max 5) and a little DEF, and Digital Death cashes all of it out.
characters.ident: Grows every time he is provoked, storing the damage for Digital Death.

skills.name: Chaos Pulse
skills.desc: 1.0x and builds 1 Chaos (max 5, resets each wave).

skills.name: Widening Eye
skills.desc: The eye widens and something looks back. 0.9x, ignores DEF, +1 Chaos. Glitch gains +15% DEF for 2 turns.
