skills.name: Digital Death
skills.desc: Spends ALL Chaos. Taunts for 2 turns and hits every enemy for (0.5 + 0.18 per Chaos)x. At 5 Chaos it ignores DEF.

recruit: The camera feed jumps. In the frame, something is a head taller each time it cuts back.
Static in the water. A shape that doesn't stay one size.

book.notes: Containment level Unknown per game data.

characters.name: Thorn
characters.title: Hidden Eye
characters.passive: Something behind her hair is always watching her friends as much as her enemies. She doesn't speak much, but she notices who's hurting first. THE THORN HEALER. THORNS: Hidden Eye and Claw Guard cover allies in thorns for 2 turns. Every enemy that hits a thorned ally takes 35% of the damage back, and the ally heals 7% max HP each time. SIGNATURE PASSIVE, Eye on the Door: once per wave, when an ally would go down, her hidden eye spots it first. That ally stays up at 25% max HP with Guard for 2 turns (Thorn must be alive and it can't be herself). She heals less than the others: her allies get their health back out of whatever hits them.
characters.ident: Covers the party in thorns that hurt whoever hits them and heal the one who was hit, and saves a falling ally once per wave.

skills.name: Raking Swipe
skills.desc: A quick warning swipe, just to keep enemies honest. 0.8x.

skills.name: Hidden Eye
skills.desc: The eye behind her hair watches over one ally. Heals 18% max HP, gives Guard (half damage) for 1 turn, and covers them in thorns for 2 turns: every enemy that hits them takes 35% of the damage back, and they heal 7% max HP each time.

skills.name: Claw Guard
skills.desc: Claws pull back to cover the whole party. Everyone heals 8% max HP and gets +30% DEF and thorns for 2 turns: every enemy that hits them takes 35% of the damage back, and they heal 7% max HP each time.

recruit: A girl with her hair over half her face stands in the shadow of a door. Something behind the hair is looking at you.
A quiet girl stands in the water. Through the strands of her hair, an eye.

book.notes: Watches allies as closely as enemies. v199 healer identity: SHIELD healer. Hidden Eye gives Guard + DEF; Claw Guard +30% DEF 2 turns; Eye on the Door saves at 25% with 2-turn Guard. V271 rework (thorns): Hidden Eye and Claw Guard give thorns for 2 turns (35% of the damage back, the ally heals 7% each hit).

characters.name: Goodbye
characters.title: Last Face You See
characters.passive: No one remembers meeting it. Its smile is stitched on and never changes — by the time you notice, it's already waving goodbye. IDENTITY, forgetting: once each round the first enemy attack aimed at another ally forgets who it was after and hits Goodbye instead (at 80%), and any enemy that hits Goodbye forgets why it came: Blurred for 1 turn (-20% damage).
characters.ident: Nobody remembers it: attacks forget who they were aiming at and the attackers forget why they came.

skills.name: Empty Stare
skills.desc: The grin never changes. 0.8x, Slows the target (-25% SPD, 2 turns) and Goodbye gains Guard for 1 turn.

skills.name: Closer Smile
skills.desc: Teeth close in before you can look away. 1.1x, ignores DEF, Marks the target 2 turns (+15% damage taken). Goodbye Taunts 2 turns and gains +20% DEF for 2 turns.

skills.name: Say Goodbye
skills.desc: Every face it ever wore waves goodbye at once. Taunts and Guards itself for 2 turns, gives the rest of the party Guard for 1 turn, then hits every enemy for 0.6x.

recruit: Nobody in the corridor can remember how the smiling figure got there. It waves.
A figure waves at you from across the water. You didn't see it arrive. You are certain you've met.

book.notes: No one remembers meeting it.

characters.name: Eye of Sin
characters.title: Sight Seeing
characters.passive: A towering black-furred watcher with a grin full of orange teeth and eyes everywhere, some of them floating. He sees the past and the future at once. Foresight and Eye Burst build Sight (max 5, +4% DEF and +3% ATK each, resets each wave). His eyes are his explosives: each one blows up, then flies back to him and regrows. Past and Future spends all Sight. IDENTITY, read intents and predict attacks: his eyes always show what every enemy will do next, and any enemy he has Foreseen deals less damage and gets answered with a counter that feeds his Sight.
characters.ident: Sees the past and the future at once: enemies' attacks land weaker and he answers each one.

skills.name: Foresight
skills.desc: He already saw the hit land. 0.9x on one target. +1 Sight. The target is Foreseen for 2 turns: its attacks deal 35% less and Eye of Sin answers each one with a 0.5x counter and +1 Sight.

skills.name: Eye Burst
skills.desc: Plucks an eye and throws it. It explodes for 1.1x on the target and 0.4x on every other enemy, then flies back to him and grows again. +1 Sight. The main target is Foreseen for 2 turns.

skills.name: Past and Future
skills.desc: Every eye opens at once and he sees what already happened and what is about to. Needs 3 Sight, spends all. (0.5 + 0.15 per Sight)x to every enemy and Slows them 2 turns; the party gets +15% DEF for 2 turns because it knows what is coming. Every enemy is Foreseen for 2 turns. At 5 Sight he also Taunts for 2 turns.

archive: Item FAL-0053 can see the future and the past at once. Assume the subject knows what personnel will do before they do it.
Ability: Sight Seeing. The subject can see the future and the past at once. He can also use his eyes as explosives. After exploding, the eyes fly back to him and regenerate.

Interviewer: What do you see?
{n}: The future and the past. At once.
Interviewer: What are your eyes for?
{n}: Seeing. And exploding.
Interviewer: What happens after?
{n}: They fly back to me and regenerate.
During the exercise the subject's eyes exploded on the target, then flew back to him and regenerated. Result withheld.
The subject sees the future and the past at once. Sealed by order of O5-██.
His eyes explode, fly back and regenerate. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A towering furred watcher fills the end of the corridor. Many of its eyes are floating.
Eyes bob like buoys in the sewer, all pointing at one mound of black fur.

book.notes: Many eyes, some of them floating.

characters.name: Envival
characters.title: Borrowed Body
characters.passive: Envious Monstrosity: his body was destroyed, and he killed his friends out of envy because they still had theirs. Now most of him is made of their parts. Whenever anyone falls (an enemy, or one of his own allies), he takes a part: he heals 10% max HP and gets +12% DEF for 3 turns. If it was an ally he envied, it is 20% max HP and +25% DEF for 4 turns.
characters.ident: Takes a part of everyone who falls, friend or foe, and grows from it.

skills.name: Borrowed Claws
skills.desc: Claws that used to belong to someone else. 1.0x, or 1.2x against an enemy that is already Marked.

skills.name: Wing Mantle
skills.desc: The orange wings spread wide over the whole party. Envival Taunts and Guards himself for 2 turns (+15% DEF), and every other ally is Guarded (half damage) for 1 turn.

skills.name: Take What's Theirs
skills.desc: Envival tears a piece off the target and keeps it. 1.3x, Marks the target (2 turns), Envival heals 12% max HP and gets +15% DEF for 2 turns.

archive: Item FAL-0054 is held in a standard cell. Personnel are advised that the subject envies anyone who still has their whole body.

Ability: Envious Monstrosity. After having his body destroyed, the subject went on a rampage and killed his friends out of envy, because they still had their body parts and he didn't. He has now replaced most of his body with their parts.

Interviewer: What happened to your body?
{n}: It was destroyed.
Interviewer: And your friends?
{n}: They still had theirs.
Interviewer: What did you do?
{n}: I took it.
The subject went on a rampage and killed his friends. Reason given: they still had their body parts and he didn't. Casualties: his friends.
Most of the subject's body is now made of his friends' parts. Original parts remaining: ██.
He killed them out of envy. Now he wears them. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A body assembled out of other people's pieces. Each piece waves, a little late.
A fused thing in the shallows, heavy with parts. It reaches for your hand.

book.notes: Killed his friends out of envy; wears borrowed bodies.

characters.name: Inkating
characters.title: Leeching Ink
characters.passive: Stepping right out of a 1930's cartoon, inked straight onto paper in black line and old grey wash. He can fix anything, as long as it's drawn on paper — and as far as he's concerned, that's everything. THE ERASER. Ink Siphon drains the colour out of whatever he bites, feeds it back to himself, and rubs one buff off the enemy. Redraw draws an ally back the way they were: the more they have just been hurt, the more it gives back. Fresh Page turns the page on the whole fight: every bad status is rubbed off his friends, and every buff is rubbed off the enemy, like pencil marks under an eraser.
characters.ident: The eraser: rubs buffs off enemies, draws a hurt ally back the way they were, and turns to a fresh page that wipes every bad status off the party.

skills.name: Ink Siphon
skills.desc: Grinning teeth scrawled in ink bite down and drain the colour out. 0.85x, heals Inkating for 25% of the damage dealt, and rubs one buff off the target (ATK up, DEF up, Guard, Taunt, Reflect or Haste).

skills.name: Redraw
skills.desc: Erases the wound and draws the ally back the way they were: heals 18% max HP plus 40% of the HP they lost since their own last turn (40% of their max HP at most). Cleanses Slow, Irradiated, Stun and Mark. The fresh lines hold: +12% DEF for 2 turns.

skills.name: Fresh Page
skills.desc: Turns to a fresh page: the whole party heals 18% max HP and every bad status is rubbed off them, and every buff is rubbed off every enemy (ATK up, DEF up, Guard, Taunt, Reflect, Haste).

recruit: A cartoon man is drawn onto a cell wall in black line and grey wash. He steps off it and tips his hat.
Ink runs through the sewage. A cartoon medic steps out of it, dripping.

book.notes: Cartoon from the 1930s, drawn in black and grey wash. V271 rework (the eraser): Ink Siphon strips an enemy buff, Redraw gives back recent damage, Fresh Page wipes bad statuses off the party and buffs off the enemy.

characters.name: Ruckus
characters.title: Stampede
characters.passive: A round little horror with huge wide eyes, a jagged grin, flaming horns and claws far too long for his arms. He is never quiet and never alone for long: everything he does starts a commotion. Stampede: whenever Ruckus finishes off an enemy his horns flare, giving him +25% ATK for 3 turns and healing 6% max HP. Horn Ram Slows, and Jagged Chomp bites much harder into anything that is Slowed.
characters.ident: Every kill makes his horns flare, and the stampede builds.

skills.name: Claw Rake
skills.desc: Three quick swipes of his far-too-long claws. 3 hits at 0.4x.

skills.name: Horn Ram
skills.desc: Lowers the flaming horns and charges. 1.5x and the target is Slowed (-30% SPD, 2 turns). The recoil costs Ruckus 6% max HP.

skills.name: Jagged Chomp
skills.desc: The whole zigzag grin closes at once. 1.9x, ignores DEF, and 35% more against a Slowed target (Horn Ram sets them up).

recruit: Something small and loud is bouncing off the walls. Its horns are on fire. It is grinning.
Splashing, giggling, flame-lit water. The little horror is having the best time of its life.

book.notes: Horns flare after every kill.

characters.name: Ox
characters.title: Red Rooms
characters.passive: A towering red-hooded horror with two huge white-ringed eyes and a grin stitched ear to ear, claws hanging off his ragged cuffs. He doesn't fight where anyone can watch: he just drags someone out of the line. Drag Under and Lock the Door build Dread (max 5, resets each wave): each Dread is +5% ATK. Red Room spends it all dragging one enemy somewhere else entirely, ignoring DEF — and whoever doesn't come back leaves half the Dread behind, heals Ox, and opens the door again right away.
characters.ident: Marks and locks a target away from the fight, then spends it all dragging them into the Red Room for good.

skills.name: Drag Under
skills.desc: Grabs an enemy by the collar and drags them half out of the fight before letting go. 0.9x and Marks the target for 2 turns (+15% damage taken). +1 Dread.

skills.name: Lock the Door
skills.desc: A door appears out of nowhere and slams shut on the target. 1.3x, ignores Guard, and tightens the Mark to +25% damage taken for 2 turns. +1 Dread.

skills.name: Red Room
skills.desc: Needs 4 Dread (Mythic: 2), spends the cost. Drags one enemy into the Red Room: (1.5 + 0.25 per Dread)x, ignores DEF. If it ends them, half the Dread comes right back, Ox heals 15% max HP, the door swings open again immediately, and the party gets +15% ATK for 2 turns.

archive: null
Ability: Red Rooms. Details withheld.
null
null
null
null
recruit: A red hood in the dark. Doors close behind you, one by one.
A grin stitched ear to ear in the dark of a tunnel. Somewhere, a door shuts.

book.notes: Red-hooded; stitched grin. Do not enter the red room.

characters.name: Corridor Stalker
characters.title: Neverland
characters.passive: A 7.3 ft pale figure with huge black runny eyes, a stretching red neck and claw-fringed arms. He owns three kinds of corridor. Dark Zone: night vision, he sees you perfectly (+20% ATK). Icy Zone: everything is slowed, him too, and the cold frostbites. Red Zone: he hears you standing in it and chases (+30% SPD). Neck Reach and Dying Voice build Stalk (max 5, resets each wave, +4% ATK each) and carry the Zone onto enemies. Neverland spends it all: the touched enemy is teleported into an empty yellow maze while the chase starts outside.
characters.ident: Rules three corridors at once, Dark, Icy and Red, and spends his Stalk to throw one enemy into the Neverland maze.

skills.name: Neck Reach
skills.desc: The red neck stretches, but not far. 0.9x on the target and 0.45x on the enemy beside it. +1 Stalk. The current Zone rides along on the target: Dark Blurs it, Icy frostbites and Slows it, Red Marks it.

skills.name: Dying Voice
skills.desc: Lets out a sound like someone dying, instantly. 0.35x to every enemy and the corridor shifts to the NEXT Zone (Dark, then Icy, then Red, then Dark again), which hits every enemy: Dark Blurs 2 turns, Icy Slows and frostbites 2 turns, Red Marks 2 turns. +1 Stalk.

skills.name: Neverland
skills.desc: Needs 3 Stalk (Mythic: 2), spends all of it. The touched enemy is teleported into an empty yellow maze: (1.2 + 0.3 per Stalk)x ignoring DEF, +15% for each of Frostbite, Mark, Slow or Blur it already has. It is lost in the maze and Stunned 1 turn (bosses Slowed), Marked 2 turns. Then the chase begins: the corridor turns Red and Corridor Stalker gets +25% ATK for 2 turns.

archive: Item FAL-0058 stands 7.3 ft tall and can extend its neck, but not far. Anyone touched by the entity is transported into its domain. Do not allow contact.

Ability: Neverland. When touched by the entity, you are transported to an empty yellow maze with a buzzing sound. The space is a Domain that extends 10 km in each direction, and grows with how big the Domain is cast. The subject can also let out noises that sound like someone dying, and can mute itself instantly.

Interviewer: What is the goal inside the Neverland?
{n}: Find an exit. Avoid me.
Interviewer: What happens if you are seen?
{n}: I chase you until you are caught.
Interviewer: And if you are caught?
{n}: Death.
Interviewer: And if you find the exit?
{n}: The final showdown.

Exit procedure: whoever finds the exit is teleported to the final showdown, where the subject always sees them and chases them until they reach the exit. The run is at minimum 10 km, same as before. Every minute inside is 0.1 seconds in real life, and this counts across the entire Domain. Survivors: ██.

Zones: Dark zones give the subject night vision and let him see you, with pupils appearing; they cause illusions. Icy zones slow you down but also slow him down, and can cause frostbite. Red zones, like the Red Rooms: if you stand in one he hears it, gets aggressive and chases you. The main level has different zones too.
Caught means death. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: At the end of the long corridor, something very tall bends its neck. A moment later it is much closer.
A pale figure in the tunnel stretches its neck. The cold has already started to creep in.

book.notes: Stands 7.3 ft. Neck stretches.

characters.name: Haz-225
characters.title: Containment
characters.passive: A pale-orange containment trooper in a sealed hazmat rig, gas mask grille hissing, one lens a cracked spiral of blue light. He doesn't fight a crowd: he carries his own AR-0225 and his own quiet. Suppression Fire and Pressure Canister vent Toxin from his tanks (max 5, resets each wave, +5% ATK each). The Room spends it all: white walls drop around one enemy, sealing it in alone with him. While it holds, he is the only thing that can really reach it — he ignores its Guard and hits it harder — and everything left outside comes looking for him instead.
characters.ident: Vents Toxin from his tanks, then seals one enemy alone with him in a white containment room only he can truly reach.

skills.name: Suppression Fire
skills.desc: A controlled burst from the AR-0225. 0.85x. If the target is already Sealed in the Containment Room, the burst catches up with it for 0.3x more, ignoring DEF. +1 Toxin.

skills.name: Pressure Canister
skills.desc: Cracks a canister on the target: 1.1x and Marks it for 2 turns (+20% damage taken). The gas drifts down the line: every other enemy is Blurred for 1 turn (-20% damage). +1 Toxin.

skills.name: The Room
skills.desc: Needs 3 Toxin (Mythic: 2), spends it all. White walls seal the target away alone with him: (1.3 + 0.3 per Toxin)x, ignores DEF, and it is Sealed for 2 turns. While it holds, only Haz-225 can really reach it (he ignores its Guard and deals +15% to it) — and with its ally gone, everything left outside the room aims for him: he is Guarded and Taunts for 2 turns.

recruit: A sealed hazmat trooper aims an AR-0225. His own breathing is the loudest thing in the corridor.
A hazmat trooper rises out of the sewage, mask hissing, one lens a spiral of blue light.

book.notes: Sealed hazmat trooper.

characters.name: Haz-378
characters.title: Ability: Charge
characters.passive: A red hazmat carrier with one spiral eye, one crossed eye, a grilled mask and blue 378 straps wrapped over everything. The K-0378 blade is lit from the inside. Every move builds Charge (max 4, +4% damage AND +4% healing each). Positive Charge heals one ally and puts a +ATK charge on them, K-0378 Slash heals the most hurt ally off its own damage, and Ability Charge spends it all to heal and power up the whole party at once.
characters.ident: Builds Charge with every move, then spends it to heal the party and charge everyone's damage up.

skills.name: K-0378 Slash
skills.desc: The red-lit K-0378 blade. 1.0x, heals the most hurt ally for 25% of the damage dealt. +1 Charge.

skills.name: Positive Charge
skills.desc: Pushes a clean positive charge through one ally. Heals 24% max HP and gives +20% ATK for 2 turns (+30% if Haz-378 has 3+ Charge). +1 Charge.

skills.name: Ability Charge
skills.desc: Needs 2 Charge, spends all of it. Discharges into the whole party: heals everyone (10% + 5% per Charge) max HP and gives +(10% + 5% per Charge) ATK for 2 turns. At 4 Charge it also cleanses Slow, Irradiated, Stun and Mark.

recruit: A red-suited carrier with a lit blade stands in the dark. Blue 378 straps glow across its chest.
A crimson hazmat figure steps out of the sewer pipe, blade humming.

book.notes: Carries charge for the team.

characters.name: Claire
characters.title: Not Here To Be Loved
characters.passive: A glossy yellow rubber-duck head glued back together over and over, black button eyes sewn on, a patchwork body stuffed in the dark of a closet. Nobody ever came to get her. Squeak (max 5, resets each wave): every move builds it and so does every hit she takes, and each Squeak makes her hit 4% harder. The Razor's Apple Marks, Closet drags an enemy into the dark, and We're Not Here to Be Loved spends it all on the whole line.
characters.ident: Squeaks louder every time she is hit, then spends it all on the whole enemy line.

skills.name: The Razor's Apple
skills.desc: Offers the apple. 1.0x and Marks the target for 2 turns (+15% damage taken). +1 Squeak.

skills.name: Closet
skills.desc: Drags the target into the dark for a turn. 1.1x ignoring DEF, the target is Slowed (-25% SPD) and Blurred (-20% damage) for 2 turns, and Claire gains Guard for 1 turn. +2 Squeak.

skills.name: We're Not Here to Be Loved
skills.desc: Needs 3 Squeak, spends all of it. The whole line is hit for (0.8 + 0.25 per Squeak)x. At 5 Squeak every enemy is also Slowed and Marked for 2 turns.

recruit: A rubber-duck head sits on a tiny patchwork body inside a locked closet. It squeaks.
A squeak floats over the water. A patchwork duck stands on a drifting door.

book.notes: Glued back together many times.

characters.name: Still-06
characters.title: Stillborn Superstar
characters.passive: A pale, button-eyed baby doll in a filthy mint onesie, clutching a bent star microphone, with two knotted umbilical cords dragging behind him. Born silent, he still plays every show. Cord (max 5, resets each wave): every move builds it and each Cord makes his heals 4% stronger. Feedback screams into an enemy and heals the most hurt ally, Cord Tether ties an enemy to that ally so the party's damage heals them, and Encore spends it all to heal the party, Mark the line and Stun everything still tied to him. If he falls, the cords snap and Stun every Corded enemy.
characters.ident: Ties enemies to wounded allies with his cords so the party's damage heals them, then takes a bow that heals, Marks and Stuns.

skills.name: Feedback
skills.desc: Screams the star microphone into the target. 0.85x, heals the most hurt ally for 20% of the damage dealt. +1 Cord.

skills.name: Cord Tether
skills.desc: Ties the target to the most hurt ally with an umbilical cord. 0.7x, the target is Corded for 3 turns (35% of all damage the party deals to it heals that ally) and Slowed for 2 turns. +1 Cord.

skills.name: Encore
skills.desc: Needs 3 Cord, spends all of it. The crowd roars: heals the whole party (8% + 4% per Cord) max HP, Marks every enemy for 2 turns (+15% damage taken) and Stuns every Corded enemy for 1 turn.

recruit: A pale doll in a mint onesie holds a bent star microphone. Nothing comes out. It still plays the show.
A bent star glows on the wet floor. A small shape in a onesie drags two knotted cords across it.

book.notes: Two knotted cords. Do not cut them. V272 buff (balance test: one of the weakest): HP and DEF raised, heals stronger.

characters.name: Creep
characters.title: It Takes 2 To Kill Me
characters.passive: A gaunt grey-green punk puppet with a mop of spiky lime hair, a scar across his forehead, a green stone pendant and the widest grin in the room. He wants you to hit him. Grin (max 5, resets each wave): every hit he takes widens it and each Grin cuts the damage he takes by 4%. Cheap Shot builds it, Takes 2 To Kill Me Taunts, Guards and Reflects, and Exit Strategy spends it all on the whole enemy line.
characters.ident: Wants to be hit: every blow widens his grin and thickens his skin, then he spends it all tearing through the whole enemy line.

skills.name: Cheap Shot
skills.desc: Swings first and grins about it. 0.9x. +1 Grin.

skills.name: Takes 2 To Kill Me
skills.desc: Dares the room to try. Taunts for 2 turns, Guard for 1 turn and Reflects 30% of the damage taken back at attackers for 2 turns. +1 Grin.

skills.name: Exit Strategy
skills.desc: Needs 3 Grin, spends all of it. Tears through the whole enemy line for (0.7 + 0.2 per Grin)x and Slows every enemy for 2 turns. Creep gains Guard for 1 turn and heals 10% max HP.

recruit: A lime-haired puppet leans against the wall, grinning. He wants you to hit him.
A punk puppet with a green pendant sits on a pipe, swinging his legs.

book.notes: Takes two to kill.

characters.name: Sunburst
characters.title: Flaming Core
characters.passive: A grinning, many-eyed monster with a flaming head, long claws and a dark hooded suit built to contain the fire inside him. Flaming Core: while the suit holds, his flames stay in check. Ablaze Claws and Burning Shockwave Scorch enemies (3% max HP per turn, 2 turns). Suit Breach rips the suit open for 2 turns: without it his flames are 60% stronger (+60% ATK) and Scorch burns twice as hard, but the heat costs him 8% max HP.
characters.ident: Wears a suit to hold his flames in: he Scorches the whole line, then rips the suit open for 60% more fire.

skills.name: Ablaze Claws
skills.desc: Sets his aura and his claws on fire. 2 hits at 0.6x, and 25% harder on the enemy at the front of the line (he can fight at range, but prefers close combat). Scorches the target for 2 turns (3% max HP per turn, 6% while the suit is breached).

skills.name: Burning Shockwave
skills.desc: A burning shockwave rolls out from his core and hits everything around him. 0.8x to every enemy, and Scorches them for 2 turns (3% max HP per turn, 6% while the suit is breached).

skills.name: Suit Breach
skills.desc: Tears the containment suit open and lets the flames out. For 2 turns Sunburst deals 60% more damage and his Scorch burns twice as hard (6% max HP per turn). The heat costs him 8% max HP.

book.notes: Suit is built to contain the fire inside.

characters.name: Umbra
characters.title: Looming Mass
characters.passive: A glossy purple orb of a head with one black socket, one glowing red eye and a yellow-toothed grin, long black hair trailing down its back, and fists wrapped in red-banded purple armour. It doesn't dodge. Wrath (max 5, resets each wave): every hit it takes and every move it makes builds Wrath, and each Wrath is +5% damage. Long Reach rakes the target and the enemy beside it, Looming Shadow Taunts and hardens it, and Crushing Grasp spends all Wrath to crush one enemy and Stun it.
characters.ident: Takes every blow standing, gets angrier with each one, then closes a claw on a single enemy and does not let go.

skills.name: Long Reach
skills.desc: The huge arm swings out and rakes the line. 1.0x to the target and 0.5x to the enemy next to it. +1 Wrath.

skills.name: Looming Shadow
skills.desc: Rises to full height and fills the room. Taunts for 2 turns and gives +40% DEF for 2 turns. +1 Wrath.

skills.name: Crushing Grasp
skills.desc: Needs 3 Wrath, spends all of it. The claw closes. (1.6x + 0.25x per Wrath) ignoring DEF, and the target is Stunned for 1 turn (bosses are Slowed instead).

book.notes: Looming mass. Red eye glows when watched.

characters.name: Mushroom
characters.title: Host Body
characters.passive: A pale, bandaged boy with a black bowl-cut, huge unblinking eyes and a mouth packed solid with mushrooms. They grow from his hair, his shoulders and his hands, and they decided a long time ago who was in charge. Host Mind: the mushrooms act on their own, so at the start of his turn one random Sporing enemy bursts for 0.4x and he gains +1 Bloom. Bloom (max 5, resets each wave): every move builds it and each Bloom makes his heals stronger. Spore Cough poisons an enemy, and every tick feeds the most hurt ally. Cap Bloom heals one ally, and Fruiting Body spends it all to Spore and Slow the whole line while healing the party.
characters.ident: The mushrooms run his body: they pop on their own, eat enemies from the inside, and feed every spore back to the party as healing.

skills.name: Spore Cough
skills.desc: The mushrooms in his mouth cough up a cloud. 0.8x, and the target is Sporing for 3 turns (3% max HP per turn, and each tick heals the most hurt ally for half of it). +1 Bloom.

skills.name: Cap Bloom
skills.desc: A cluster of caps blooms over an ally and knits the wound shut. Heals 22% max HP (+3% per Bloom) and gives +12% DEF for 2 turns. +1 Bloom.

skills.name: Fruiting Body
skills.desc: Needs 3 Bloom, spends all of it. The mushrooms take over completely: every enemy is Sporing for 3 turns (4% max HP per turn) and Slowed for 2 turns, and the whole party heals 8% max HP (+3% per Bloom).

book.notes: Mouth packed solid with mushrooms. V272 buff (balance test: one of the weakest): HP and DEF raised, heals stronger.

characters.name: Smiley.wires
characters.title: Power Outage
characters.passive: A grinning white sketch of a body held together with red error scribbles: FATAL ERROR down one arm, SYSTEM UNRESPONSIVE down the other, every ability reading 0%. Born August 20th 2024. Creator: [REDACTED]. He heals and hacks at the same time. Load (max 5, resets each wave): every move builds it and each Load is +4% damage and healing. Packet Burst hits Hacked enemies 25% harder. Hotfix heals an ally over time and Hacks the strongest enemy (Hacked enemies deal 20% less damage). Cyberspace Hacks the whole line and heals the party, doubled for allies below half HP.
characters.ident: Patches allies over time while hacking the strongest enemy, then drops a zone that weakens the line and heals the party.

skills.name: Packet Burst
skills.desc: A short burst of hostile packets down the wire. 3 hits at 0.4x. +1 Load (each Load is +4% damage and healing; resets each wave). Hits Hacked enemies 25% harder.

skills.name: Hotfix
skills.desc: Patches an ally: heals 8% max HP (+2% per Load) right away, then 6% max HP at the start of each of their next 3 turns. The same patch Hacks the strongest enemy for 2 turns (-20% damage). +1 Load.

skills.name: Cyberspace
skills.desc: Throws down a zone of live wire. Every enemy is Hacked for 2 turns (-20% damage) and the whole party heals 8% max HP (+2% per Load), doubled for allies below half HP. +1 Load.

book.notes: Held together by error scribbles.

characters.name: Walker
characters.title: Stitched Pursuer
characters.passive: A hooded figure in a stitched blue parka, black fur bristling off every seam, a purple light showing through the coat. His face is split down the middle: one half white, with a torn-open black mouth and a single red eye, the other half dark red and sewn shut. His ability is listed as ???. He is Maw's eternal enemy and the opposite of him: he is Deaf to lies (immune to Blur and Venom), and Tear the Seam and Stitch Shut cut Taunt, Spite, Guard and Reflect off whatever they hit. Steps (max 5, resets each wave): he never stops walking, so he gains +1 Step at the start of every turn, and each Step is +4% damage. Tear the Seam cuts an enemy and Seams it. Stitch Shut Seams and Stuns it and hardens his parka. Long Walk spends all his Steps to run one enemy through and drag the rest of the Seamed enemies along behind him. Seamed enemies deal 15% less and take 20% more from him.
characters.ident: Never stops walking and cuts through every lie, taunt and shield in his way: Maw's eternal enemy.

skills.name: Tear the Seam
skills.desc: Rips along the nearest seam. 2 hits at 0.6x, cuts Taunt, Spite, Guard and Reflect off the target, and Seams it for 3 turns (deals 15% less damage, and Walker hits it 20% harder).

skills.name: Stitch Shut
skills.desc: Sews the mouth shut. 1.0x, cuts every Taunt, Spite, Guard and Reflect off the target, Seams it for 3 turns and Stuns it for 1 turn (bosses are Slowed instead). The parka hardens: +25% DEF for 2 turns.

skills.name: Long Walk
skills.desc: Needs 3 Steps, spends all of them. He just keeps walking, through the target and out the other side. (1.5x + 0.3x per Step) ignoring DEF to the target, and 0.5x to every other Seamed enemy.

archive: Item FAL-0068 is held at Containment Level: Medium. The subject does not stay in the cell. Staff are advised not to wait up. Ability: ???.

Description: a hooded figure in a stitched blue parka with black fur along every seam and a purple light under the coat. His face is split down the middle: one half white with a torn-open black mouth and one red eye, the other half dark red and sewn shut.
null
null
The subject is the sworn enemy of Maw, and the feeling is returned.
null

book.notes: Stitched parka, split face, never stops walking. Maw's eternal enemy.

characters.name: Xekna
characters.title: Grinning Wall
characters.passive: A hulking red demon: curved horns, swept-back spikes, black visor eyes, a grin of needle teeth, a stitched jacket studded with yellow rivets. His ability is listed as ???. He lives on the edge of losing himself, like a man with too much chrome. Psychosis (max 5, resets each wave): every hit he takes and every Gnash raises it, each point is +6% damage, and his spikes lash back at attackers for 0.25x (+0.05x per point). At 5 he goes GONE for 2 turns: +50% ATK, but Gnash becomes three unaimed bites at random enemies (never his allies), and when it ends he crashes (loses 12% max HP, is Stunned 1 turn, drops to 2 Psychosis). Hold It Together pulls him back while he still can. Break Down spends 3 Psychosis on purpose to hit the whole line.
characters.ident: Gets stronger with every hit he takes and a little less himself, until he is Gone and the party has to hope he comes back.

skills.name: Gnash
skills.desc: Needle teeth close on the target. 1.0x and Marks it for 2 turns (+15% damage taken). +1 Psychosis. While GONE: three unaimed bites at random enemies (1.0x each). The rampage never touches his allies.

skills.name: Hold It Together
skills.desc: The inhibitor, the breathing, the count. Removes 2 Psychosis (3 if it was already low), heals 10% max HP, Taunts for 2 turns and gives +30% DEF for 2 turns. Cannot be used while GONE.

skills.name: Break Down
skills.desc: Needs 3 Psychosis, spends 3. He lets go on purpose. Hits EVERY enemy for (0.8x + 0.2x per Psychosis) ignoring DEF and Slows them 2 turns, but the strain costs him 6% max HP.

archive: Item FAL-0069 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject does not resist containment. The subject grins throughout. Ability: ???.

Description: a hulking red demon with curved horns, swept-back spikes and a grin of needle teeth behind black visor eyes. Wears a stitched red jacket with yellow rivets and biohazard marks. Drawn August 16th 2026.

book.notes: Red demon, spikes, needle-tooth grin. Cyberpsychosis-style kit. Drawn Aug 16th 2026.

characters.name: Ronin
characters.title: Contracted Merc
characters.passive: A tired-looking swordsman in a heavy black hood, brown hair in a bun, one blue eye and one orange eye, long white claws on both hands. He is a Contracted Goblin Devil host: the green growing through his coat and across his face is the goblin coming through. A Fal-125 contracted merc, he fights demons with his katana and grenades. His ability is listed as ???. Goblin (max 5, resets each wave): every move lets more of the goblin through, each Goblin is +4% damage and mends him 1% max HP at the start of his turn. Iaido hits Demons for 1.3x. Frag Grenade blasts the target and its neighbours and sets the target Burning. Goblin Takes the Wheel spends all his Goblin: for 2 turns the goblin drives (+40% ATK, Iaido strikes twice) and the contract costs him 6% max HP.
characters.ident: A contracted merc with a goblin under his skin: katana for demons, grenades for the rest, and the green takes the wheel when he lets it.

skills.name: Iaido
skills.desc: The katana leaves the sheath. 1.0x, or 1.3x against Demons (contract work). While the goblin has the wheel it strikes twice. +1 Goblin.

skills.name: Frag Grenade
skills.desc: Pin out, throw, duck. 0.8x to the target and 0.5x to the enemies next to it, and the target is Burning for 2 turns (3% max HP per turn). Demons take it for 1.3x. +1 Goblin.

skills.name: Goblin Takes the Wheel
skills.desc: Needs 3 Goblin, spends all of it. The contract is paid in full: for 2 turns the goblin drives (+40% ATK, Iaido strikes twice), and Ronin heals 10% max HP now but loses 6% max HP to the contract.

archive: Item FAL-0070 is held at Containment Level: Medium. The subject sits where he is put and does not ask why. Ability: ???.

Description: a contracted Fal-125 merc, a Goblin Devil host, in a heavy black hood, brown hair in a bun, one blue eye and one orange eye. Half his face is scarred. Long white claws on both hands. The green growing through him is a goblin devil under contract. Drawn May 22nd 2026.

book.notes: Name picked by Claude (sheet had none). Contracted Goblin Devil host, Fal-125 merc: katana and grenades. Drawn May 22nd 2026.

characters.name: Hollowpoint
characters.title: Leeching Void
characters.passive: A hunched white entity with a black, tooth-lined face, one white-ringed eye and one red-ringed void eye, a red compass sigil on its throat, red-stained claws and a shotgun that is almost an extension of its arm. Its name is on no sheet, so the game calls it Hollowpoint. Ability: Leeching Void. He shoots enemies and leeches off them to heal himself and everyone else. Buckshot Taps its target and feeds two people at once: himself and the most wounded ally. While an enemy is Tapped, every hero who hits it heals for a share of the damage, so the whole party drinks from whatever he has shot. Transfusion fires at a Tapped enemy and pours it into the ally you pick. Void Shot fires every Shell he has loaded, drains a Tapped target into the whole party and erases what it leaves almost dead. Shells (max 5, resets each wave): every move loads one, each is +3% damage. The Wound at his weak spot tears a little every turn (2% max HP), and every kill closes it. A Healer whose healing is the damage he deals.
characters.ident: A shotgun that heals: everything he shoots is leeched back, into himself or into the ally you choose.

skills.name: Buckshot
skills.desc: Point blank. 1.0x on the target and 0.5x on the enemy beside it. The target is Tapped for 3 turns (every hero who hits it heals for a share of the damage). Leech: Hollowpoint heals for 35% of the damage dealt and the most wounded other ally heals for 35% (each at most 8% of their max HP, before healer bonuses). +1 Shell.

skills.name: Transfusion
skills.desc: You pick the ally. Hollowpoint shoots a Tapped enemy if there is one (otherwise the front enemy) for 1.0x, Taps it for 3 turns, and pours what he took straight into the chosen ally: they heal 80% of the damage dealt (at most 14% of their max HP, before healer bonuses). +1 Shell.

skills.name: Void Shot
skills.desc: Fires every loaded Shell as an empty void: (1.2 + 0.2 per Shell)x ignoring DEF. If the target is Tapped, the line is drained: the whole party heals 8% max HP. A non-boss left under 25% HP is sucked in and disappears, healing the whole party 6% max HP more. A boss is Marked and Slowed for 2 turns instead. The most wounded ally also heals for 30% of the damage dealt (at most 10% of their max HP), and for 2 turns every hit a hero lands heals them for 12% of the damage dealt.

archive: Item FAL-0071 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject has no recorded name and answers to none; the Foundation files it as Hollowpoint. Ability: Leeching Void.

Description: a hunched white entity with a black, tooth-lined face, one white-ringed eye and one red-ringed void eye, and a red compass sigil on its throat. Red-stained claws. A shotgun that appears to be part of the arm. Concept sheets dated Oct 27th 2023 and 2025.
null

Leech: it feeds on every kill it makes, and the feeding closes the Wound at its weak spot for a short while. The Wound opens a little more every five hours. If nothing is done for two days it kills the entity. If nothing is done for longer, the skull breaks away.

Void Shot: the shells are not shells. Fired, each one becomes a small empty void that pulls in whatever it touches and erases it. Nothing has been recovered. The gun is the one the subject once turned on itself. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
null

book.abilityPlus: Void Shot
book.notes: Working name (the sheet has none). Healer: everything he shoots is leeched into healing, into himself (Buckshot) or into the ally you pick (Transfusion). Leech + Void Shot, built around his shotgun. From the 2025 art and the Oct 27th 2023 concept. V238 rework: Buckshot Taps its target and heals himself and the most wounded ally; every hero who hits a Tapped enemy heals for a share of the damage; Transfusion (was Mercy Slug) fires at a Tapped enemy; Void Shot no longer needs Shells and drains a Tapped target into the whole party; the Wound costs 2% a turn (was 3%).

characters.name: Ghost
characters.title: Save File
characters.passive: A quiet chibi figure with lime-green hair that bleeds through hot pink into violet, huge black eyes with violet pupils, a pale skull-like face with a purple tear running from the nose, and a black fur-trimmed hoodie with a stitched purple X-eyed grin on the chest. Abilities: Save file, Dead media manipulation. Tapes (max 5, resets each wave): every move records one, and each Tape makes her heals 4% stronger. Save File writes a Save on an ally: the next time they would fall they load it instead and stand back up. Dead Air plays a dead channel at an enemy and records it: for 2 turns, every fighter that enemy hits heals afterwards. Dead Media rewinds the tape on one ally and plays it back: they are cleansed and use their last move again, for free. Autosave: if nobody holds a Save she spends a Tape to Save the most wounded ally on her own.
characters.ident: Writes a Save on an ally so they stand back up when they would fall, records enemies so their hits heal you, and rewinds the tape so an ally does their last move again.

skills.name: Dead Air
skills.desc: Plays a dead channel at the target and records it. 0.9x, and the target is Recorded for 2 turns: every time it hits one of your fighters, the tape plays the hit back wrong and that fighter heals 8% max HP (+4% per Tape). +1 Tape.

skills.name: Save File
skills.desc: Writes a Save on an ally and heals them 18% max HP (+4% per Tape). The next time that ally would fall, they load the Save instead: they stand back up at the HP they had when saved (at least 35% max HP) with their debuffs gone. One Save at a time; it lasts until used or the wave ends. +1 Tape.

skills.name: Dead Media
skills.desc: Dead media manipulation: she rewinds the tape on one ally and plays it back. Needs 2 Tapes, spends all of them. That ally is cleansed of Slow, Mark, Burning, Venom, Soak, Blur and Frostbite and uses their last move again, for free, at (50% + 10% per Tape) power. If they have not moved yet this wave, they heal 15% max HP instead.

archive: Item FAL-0072 is held at Containment Level: Medium. The subject is quiet, polite and never asks for anything. Ability: Save file. Dead media manipulation.

Description: a chibi figure with lime-green hair bleeding through hot pink into violet, large black eyes with violet pupils, a pale skull-like face with a purple tear running from the nose, and a black fur-trimmed hoodie with a stitched purple X-eyed grin on the chest. Grey trousers with violet stitching. Drawn May 2026.
null

Save file: the subject can write a copy of a person. If that person is about to die, the copy is loaded and they stand back up exactly as they were when it was written. Nobody remembers falling. The subject keeps the tapes.

Dead media manipulation: old tapes, discs and dead screens obey the subject. Played backwards they mend the wounded; played at a hostile, they show it a channel that is not there. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
null

book.abilityPlus: Dead media manipulation
book.notes: Name from the sheet (Ghost, ID 0072). Healer: Save file puts a Save on an ally so they stand back up when they would fall; Dead media manipulation rewinds her Tapes into a party heal and cleanse. Drawn May 2026. Containment, Threat and Scent are my draft. V271 rework: Dead Air records an enemy (fighters it hits heal 8%); Dead Media replays one ally's last move.

characters.name: Voltage 77
characters.title: Adrenaline Spike
characters.passive: A grinning punk with a tall teal mohawk, black shades, a lightning-split face (half of it red) and a blue jacket bristling with purple spikes, over red shorts, grey armoured legs and violet claws. Abilities: Adrenaline Spike, Sound Spikes. Adrenaline (max 5, resets each wave): every hit he takes kicks it in, and each Adrenaline is +6% damage and +8% SPD. Spike Jab uses a spike as a melee weapon. Sound Spike rips a spike off his body and launches it as a shock wave through the whole enemy line (the spike is easily replaced, it costs him 3% max HP). Spike Frenzy spends the adrenaline on three fast strikes and a burst of ATK.
characters.ident: Gets faster and hits harder every time he is hit, then tears spikes off his own body and throws them as shock waves.

skills.name: Spike Jab
skills.desc: Stabs with a spike as a melee weapon. 1.25x. The spike nicks him for 1% max HP and he gets +1 Adrenaline.

skills.name: Sound Spike
skills.desc: Rips a spike off his body and launches it as a huge shock wave (costs 2% max HP, it grows back). The target takes 1.3x, every other enemy 0.7x, and every enemy is Slowed for 1 turn. With 3 or more Adrenaline the wave hits 25% harder. +1 Adrenaline.

skills.name: Spike Frenzy
skills.desc: Needs 3 Adrenaline, spends all of them. The adrenaline kicks in: he strikes the target 3 times with spikes at (0.8 + 0.1 per Adrenaline)x each, and gains +30% ATK for 2 turns. He recovers HP equal to 15% of the damage dealt.

archive: Item FAL-0073 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject cannot be kept quiet and does not try. Ability: Adrenaline Spike. Sound Spikes.

Description: a punk humanoid with a tall teal mohawk, black shades, a white face split by a red lightning mark, a blue spiked jacket, red shorts, grey armoured legs and violet claws. Drawn Oct 22 2025.
null
Adrenaline Spike: anything that strikes the subject sets off an adrenaline surge. Speed and strength both rise sharply, and personnel who hit it twice are not asked to hit it a third time.

Sound Spikes: shock waves can be launched from the body, and their power is raised by tearing off one of the spikes. The spikes grow back within hours. They are also used as close-range weapons. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
null

book.abilityPlus: Sound Spikes
book.notes: Name from the sheet (Voltage 77). ID 0073 is the next free number (the sheet has none). Adrenaline Spike: being hit raises his speed and damage; Sound Spikes: shock waves from his body, boosted by tearing off a replaceable spike, and spikes as melee weapons. Drawn Oct 22 2025. Containment, Threat and Scent are my draft.

characters.name: Mindbender
characters.title: Warped Room
characters.passive: A long-limbed black thing on all fours, bristling with quills, one huge magenta eye ringed by six small coloured ones, a curled tail and limbs banded red, green, purple and pink, ending in black claws. Abilities: Hide, Psycho Shift, Tel Port, Wonder Room. It protects by making the fight go wrong for the other side. Focus (max 5, resets each wave): every move builds it and each Focus is +4% damage. Psycho Shift rips every debuff off the party and puts the worst of them on an enemy. Tel Port sends an enemy away for a turn and he steps into its place with Taunt. Wonder Room spends Focus to swap every enemy's ATK and DEF for 3 turns, and Hides the most wounded ally.
characters.ident: Hides allies, shifts the party’s debuffs onto the enemy, teleports threats away and swaps what the enemy is good at.

skills.name: Psycho Shift
skills.desc: 0.8x on the target. Then every debuff on the party (Slow, Mark, Irradiated, Scorch, Venom, Soak, Blur, Frostbite, Seamed, Spore, Stun) is torn off and the 3 worst land on the target for at least 2 turns. Nothing to shift: it is Slowed instead. +1 Focus.

skills.name: Tel Port
skills.desc: Sends the target out of the fight: it is Stunned for 1 turn (a boss is Slowed instead) and comes back Marked for 2 turns. Mindbender takes its place: Taunt for 2 turns and Guard for 1. +1 Focus.

skills.name: Wonder Room
skills.desc: Needs 3 Focus, spends all of it. For 3 turns (2 on bosses) every enemy has its ATK and DEF swapped: a glass cannon hits like paper, a wall hits like a wall. Mindbender gets +15% DEF for 2 turns, and the most wounded ally is Hidden for 2 turns (enemies cannot single them out while anyone else is visible, only area attacks reach them) and heals 6% max HP.

archive: Item FAL-0074 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject does not speak and is never asked to. Everyone who stands near it simply understands what it wants. The Foundation files it as Mindbender. Abilities: Hide. Psycho Shift. Tel Port. Wonder Room.

Description: a long-limbed black quadruped covered in dense, bristling quills. One enormous magenta eye ringed by six small coloured eyes (red, green and purple). A long curled tail. Every limb and the tail are banded in red, green, purple and pink, and every limb ends in curved black claws. Drawn May 9th 2024.
null
Hide: the subject can fold a person out of sight. Observers describe the person as still being in the room and just no longer a thing that can be looked at on purpose. Large events still find them.
Psycho Shift: a wound, a burn or a curse on one person can be taken off them and set down on someone else. The wound is the same size. It does not care whose it is.
Tel Port: the subject sends things somewhere else and stands where they were. Nothing sent has been recovered in the same mood.
Wonder Room: for a short time the room is wrong. What was strong in it becomes soft, and what was soft becomes strong. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
null

book.abilityPlus: Psycho Shift, Tel Port, Wonder Room
book.notes: Name and abilities from the sheet (Mindbender). ID 0074 is the next free number (the sheet has none). Tank: Psycho Shift moves the party debuffs onto an enemy, Tel Port sends an enemy away for a turn, Wonder Room swaps every enemy ATK and DEF and hides the most wounded ally (Hide is folded into it, v149: 3 moves). Drawn May 9th 2024. Containment, Threat and Scent are my draft.

characters.name: Bonesaw
characters.title: Spiral Eye
characters.passive: A huge grey-armoured figure stitched shut across the face, one big red spiral eye, the other side of the head torn open into a mass of red-streaked spines and teeth, a glowing red spine sigil on its chest, black tendrils whipping off its back, and a spiked grey buzzsaw for an arm with a red crosshair in the middle. Beside it walks its Demon friend (a crowned white skull with huge black eyes and mouths in its hands), and it carries an uzi. Rev (max 5, resets each wave): every move builds it, every bite the Demon friend lands builds it, and each Rev is +5% damage. Saw Arm cuts two enemies, puts the crosshair on the target (Marked) and sprays two uzi bursts at random enemies. Demon Friend lets the friend out for 3 turns: it Marks an enemy, then attacks on its own at the start of his turn, lunges in on every Saw Arm to bite the target and Mark a second enemy, and joins Spin Up. He gets Guard while it is out. Spin Up spends 3 Rev on a spinning buzzsaw storm that Slows every enemy.
characters.ident: A buzzsaw arm, an uzi and a Demon friend in his coat: the friend marks, bites and hunts on its own, and the rev builds into a spinning storm.

skills.name: Saw Arm
skills.desc: The buzzsaw arm and the Weapon. 1.0x on the target and 0.5x on the enemy beside it, and the red crosshair Marks the target for 2 turns (+15% damage taken). Then the uzi fires 2 quick bursts of 0.2x at random enemies. With the Demon friend out it lunges at the target too (an extra bite) and Marks a second enemy. +1 Rev.

skills.name: Demon Friend
skills.desc: Lets the Demon friend out for 3 turns. It Marks a random enemy straight away, then every turn Bonesaw takes it attacks on its own first: a bite (0.4x) at a Marked enemy, Marking it if it was not (builds Rev). It also joins every Saw Arm and Spin Up. Bonesaw gets Guard while it is out and heals 8% max HP. +1 Rev.

skills.name: Spin Up
skills.desc: Needs 3 Rev, spends all of it. The buzzsaw spins up: every enemy takes (0.6 + 0.15 per Rev)x and is Slowed for 2 turns, and a random enemy takes the crosshair (Marked for 2 turns). With the Demon friend out it bites every Marked enemy as well (0.3x).

archive: Item FAL-0075 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject is escorted by a second entity, which the Foundation files separately as its Demon friend. The two are never to be held in different cells. Ability: unknown. Weapon: uzi.

Description: a huge, grey-armoured figure, stitched shut across the face. One large red spiral eye. The other side of the head is torn open into a mass of red-streaked spines and teeth. A glowing red spine sigil on the chest, black tendrils moving without wind, and a spiked grey buzzsaw in place of one arm, with a red crosshair at its centre. Drawn Feb 16 2025.
null

The Demon friend: a white, crowned skull with two enormous black eyes, a mouth of needle teeth, and a second mouth in each hand. It rides inside the subject's coat. It does not speak. When it is let out it chooses its own targets, and the subject's crosshair is always already on them.
The Weapon: a standard-issue uzi. Nobody knows where it was issued. The subject never reloads it.
The saw: when the subject spins it up, the room slows down. The crosshair in the middle has always been pointed at someone in the room. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
null

book.abilityPlus: Buzzsaw arm, Weapon (uzi), Demon friend
book.notes: Working name (the sheet has none). ID 0075 is the next free number. Tank (Retaliator): spiked buzzsaw arm with a crosshair, spiral red eye, an uzi marked Weapon, and a crowned Demon friend that bites back at everything that hits him. Drawn Feb 16 2025. Containment, Threat and Scent are my draft.

characters.name: Kaleido
characters.title: Wide Grin
characters.passive: A grinning red thing ringed by black quills: a huge crescent of needle teeth, one red spiral eye and one prismatic eye with a pentagram in it, and a black box of a chest with two kaleidoscope eyes and a second mouth full of teeth, standing on long black legs. Dec 2024, the sheet has no name, so the game calls it Kaleido. It heals by making the fight pretty and confusing. Trance (max 5, resets each wave): every move builds it, and each Trance makes its heals 4% stronger. Spiral Gaze hits an enemy, Blurs it and heals the most hurt ally. Kaleidoscope heals one ally and cleanses them. Chest Maw spends 3 Trance on a bite that ignores DEF, feeds the damage back to the party as healing and Slows every enemy with the grin.
characters.ident: Gazes, grins and bites: weakens the enemy side while the damage and the prism light feed the party back up.

skills.name: Spiral Gaze
skills.desc: The red spiral eye. 0.8x on the target, which is Blurred for 2 turns (deals 20% less damage), and the most wounded ally heals 6% max HP. +1 Trance.

skills.name: Kaleidoscope
skills.desc: You pick the ally. The prism eye turns and they heal 20% max HP (+4% per Trance) and are cleansed of Slow, Mark, Burning, Venom, Soak, Blur and Frostbite. +1 Trance.

skills.name: Chest Maw
skills.desc: Needs 3 Trance, spends all of it. The mouth in the chest bites the target for (1.2 + 0.2 per Trance)x ignoring DEF, and the whole party heals for 40% of the damage dealt (at most 12% of their max HP, before healer bonuses). The grin splits wider: every enemy is Slowed for 2 turns.

archive: Item FAL-0076 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject is cooperative as long as it is being looked at. The sheet has no name and the Foundation files it as Kaleido. Observers who look away report a strong feeling of having been rude.

Description: a red, quill-ringed entity with a huge crescent grin of needle teeth. One red spiral eye, one prismatic eye with a pentagram in it. A black box of a chest holding two kaleidoscope eyes and a second mouth full of teeth, on long black legs. Drawn Dec 2024.
null
Spiral Gaze: an observer who meets the red eye reports the next few minutes as slow and slightly embarrassing. Their hands shake less afterwards.
Kaleidoscope: the prism eye turns and whatever was wrong with the person near it is put back into a colour. The subject says this is not a heal. The subject is wrong.
Chest Maw: the second mouth is fed by the first one's work. What it bites it does not keep. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
null

book.abilityPlus: Spiral Gaze, Kaleidoscope, Wide Grin, Chest Maw
book.notes: Working name (the sheet has none). ID 0076 is the next free number. Healer (Debuffer): red spiral eye Blurs and heals, prism eye heals and cleanses, the chest mouth bites, feeds the party and the grin Slows everyone (Wide Grin is folded into Chest Maw, v149: 3 moves). Drawn Dec 2024. Containment, Threat and Scent are my draft.

characters.name: Pyrelash
characters.title: Six Lashes
characters.passive: A hulking brown body cracked open with glowing orange wounds, a smooth dome of a head with one slanted orange eye and a grin of needle teeth, and six huge curved orange blades that move like tentacles. May 14th 2024, the sheet has no name, so the game calls it Pyrelash. SIX LASHES: he has exactly six, and they stay wrapped around whatever he hits. Every lash in an enemy makes it deal 5% less damage, and with 2 or more it is Slowed. Lash cuts two enemies and wraps one more lash around the target. Whirl sends every free lash out, spreading them over the enemies that hold the fewest. Strangle squeezes all of them at once: 0.34x per lash in each enemy, and any enemy holding 3 or more is Interrupted. When an enemy dies, its lashes come back. Lock one big enemy down, or weaken the whole line.
characters.ident: Six orange lashes stay wrapped around whatever they hit, weakening it, until a Strangle squeezes all of them at once.

skills.name: Lash
skills.desc: One of the six lashes. 1.0x on the target and 0.5x on the enemy beside it, and the lash stays wrapped around the target (each lash in an enemy: it deals 5% less damage; 2 or more: Slowed). If all six are already out, he pulls one back from wherever it is.

skills.name: Whirl
skills.desc: Every free lash goes out at once: 0.35x to every enemy, then the free lashes are wrapped one at a time around whichever enemies hold the fewest, so the whole line is weakened.

skills.name: Strangle
skills.desc: Every lash that is out pulls tight at once: each enemy takes 0.34x per lash wrapped around it, ignoring DEF. An enemy with 3 or more lashes in it is Interrupted and Stunned for 1 turn (bosses are Slowed). The lashes stay where they are.

archive: Item FAL-0077 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject is warm to the touch from several metres away. The sheet has no name and the Foundation files it as Pyrelash. The cell is rebuilt every few weeks, and nobody who has tried to leave it in a hurry has managed to.

Description: a broad, brown, cracked body glowing orange through every crack. A smooth dome of a head with one slanted orange eye and a mouth of needle teeth. Six huge curved orange blades grow from its back and shoulders and move like tentacles. Drawn May 14th 2024.
null

The lashes: six, always six. They are not bone and not flame. Sixty seconds after being cut off they are back. They do not strike so much as hold: staff report being unable to finish a sentence once one has closed around them.
The cracks: when the subject is calm they are closed. When it is not, the whole body opens at once and the room is no longer the same temperature. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
null

book.abilityPlus: Lash, Coil, Whirl, Eruption
book.notes: Working name (the sheet has none). ID 0077 is the next free number. Damage (Sweeper): six orange blades that sweep the whole line, building Blaze until the cracked body splits open for Eruption. Drawn May 14th 2024. Containment, Threat and Scent are my draft. V240 REWORK: Six Lashes replace Grip. Lashes stay wrapped around enemies (each: -5% damage dealt, 2+: Slowed); Lash wraps one, Whirl spreads the free ones, Strangle squeezes all (0.34x per lash, 3+ Interrupts). Lashes return when the enemy dies.

characters.name: Outbreak
characters.title: Biohazard
characters.passive: A many-eyed mass of black quills and yellow hazard stripes: a mouth full of teeth across the middle, small yellow eyes scattered over the body, a biohazard sign for a heart, six fat yellow limbs scrawled over with warnings, and long hazard-striped legs. December 21st 2024, the sheet has no name, so the game calls it Outbreak. It protects the way a quarantine does: by being very sure who is sick, and standing in the door. Spread (max 5, resets each wave): every move builds it, and each Spread makes its heals 4% stronger. Every Venomed enemy makes its heals 6% stronger too (up to 4 enemies). Toxic Spit hits an enemy and the one beside it, Venoms both and mends itself for every sick enemy. Antidote cleanses one ally, heals them a little and Guards them. Biohazard Burst spends 3 Spread, pays back the party for every sick enemy, Slows every enemy, Guards the party and puts Outbreak in the doorway with Taunt and extra DEF.
characters.ident: A poisonous wall: Venoms the enemy line, Guards and cleanses your side, and locks the room down with Taunt.

skills.name: Toxic Spit
skills.desc: 0.8x on the target, which is Venomed for 3 turns (4% max HP per turn). The spit splashes the enemy beside it for 0.4x and Venoms it too (3% max HP per turn). He is the one who gets the stink on him: Outbreak heals 2% max HP for every Venomed enemy afterwards (up to 4 counted, so at most 8%). +1 Spread.

skills.name: Antidote
skills.desc: You pick the ally (he can pick himself). They heal 10% max HP and are cleansed of Slow, Mark, Burning, Venom, Soak, Blur and Frostbite, then gain Guard for 2 turns. Stronger with Spread and with every Venomed enemy. +1 Spread.

skills.name: Biohazard Burst
skills.desc: Needs 3 Spread, spends all of it. Every enemy takes (0.4 + 0.1 per Spread)x, and the whole party heals 3% max HP for every Venomed enemy (up to 4 counted), plus 2% per Spread. The room is sealed: every enemy is Slowed for 2 turns, the whole party gains Guard for 1 turn, and Outbreak takes Taunt for 2 turns and +15% DEF for 2 turns.

archive: Item FAL-0078 is held at Containment Level: Extreme. The subject is not hostile. It is thorough. The sheet has no name and the Foundation files it as Outbreak. Staff are asked not to thank it.

Description: a many-eyed mass of black quills and yellow hazard stripes. A wide mouth of needle teeth across the middle, small yellow eyes scattered over the body, a biohazard sign where a heart would be, six swollen yellow limbs covered in handwritten warnings, and long hazard-striped legs. Drawn December 21st 2024.
null
Quarantine: within a minute of the subject entering a room, every door in it is locked from the outside. Nobody has found the lock.
Antidote: the subject can cure what it has just caused, and does, in that order. The cure is always slightly larger than the harm.
Biohazard Burst: the biohazard sign opens. What comes out is counted, and the count is paid back to whoever was in the room with it. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
null

book.abilityPlus: Toxic Spit, Antidote, Quarantine, Biohazard Burst
book.notes: Working name (the sheet has none). ID 0078 is the next free number. Tank (Debuffer): a bulky poison wall. Toxic Spit Venoms two enemies and mends him, Antidote cleanses and Guards an ally, Biohazard Burst Slows the room, Guards the party and puts him in the doorway with Taunt and DEF. Moved from Healer to Tank in v150. Drawn December 21st 2024. Containment, Threat and Scent are my draft.

characters.name: C-Ruin
characters.title: Gravity Ruin
characters.passive: A purple-and-grey horned Demon with one yellow barred eye and one huge red eye, a red grin of needle teeth, a hand of red-tipped black fingers reaching out from behind its head, yellow-padded shoulders, a clawed, blood-soaked purple arm with white spikes, blue horns at the hips and white claws on every foot. Drawn April 21st 2025. Abilities on the sheet: Gravitational Manipulation, Side Swap, Slowing Time. Gravity (max 5, resets each wave): each Gravity makes its damage 4% stronger. Gravity Well hits two enemies and Slows the target. Side Swap drags the target to the other end of the enemy line (changing who stands next to whom), Marks it, Slows the enemy it displaced and Guards C-Ruin. Slowing Time spends 3 Gravity, hits and Slows every enemy, and at 5 Gravity the Slow lasts 3 turns and the whole party gets Haste for a turn.
characters.ident: A gravity-bending Tank: drags enemies around the line with Side Swap, then slows the whole room to a crawl.

skills.name: Gravity Well
skills.desc: The air around the target gets heavy: 1.0x, and 0.5x on the enemy beside it. The target is Slowed for 1 turn. +1 Gravity.

skills.name: Side Swap
skills.desc: Up becomes sideways. The target trades places with the front enemy (or the last one, if it is already in front), takes 0.6x and is Marked for 2 turns. The enemy it displaced is Slowed for 1 turn, and C-Ruin steps in between and takes Guard for 1 turn. +1 Gravity.

skills.name: Slowing Time
skills.desc: Needs 3 Gravity, spends all of it. Every enemy takes (0.6 + 0.14 per Gravity)x and is Slowed for 2 turns. C-Ruin gets Guard for 1 turn and +25% DEF for 2 turns. At 5 Gravity the Slow lasts 3 turns and the whole party gets Haste for 1 turn.

archive: Item FAL-0079 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject is filed as C-Ruin, the name on its sheet. The sheet is dated April 21st 2025. Items dropped in its cell do not fall straight down, and staff are told to stop dropping them.

Description: a purple-and-grey horned Demon with one yellow barred eye and one huge red eye, a wide red grin of needle teeth, yellow-padded shoulders and white claws on every foot. A hand of red-tipped black fingers reaches out from behind its head. The right arm ends in a purple claw that is always wet. The Foundation has stopped cleaning it.
null
Gravitational Manipulation: the cell has a floor, a ceiling and two walls that count as the floor on different days. Staff are issued boots for all of them.
Side Swap: do not stand next to the subject when it is bored. Two members of staff have been found on opposite sides of the room with no memory of crossing it.
Slowing Time: the clock in the observation room runs late. It was replaced three times. It is still late.
null

book.notes: Drawn April 21st 2025 (the old ID on the sheet is ignored; ID 0079 is the game's). Playable since V175. Tank (Disruptor): purple-and-grey horned Demon, blood-soaked claw arm, hand of red-tipped fingers. Gravity meter (max 5, resets each wave, +4% damage per Gravity). Gravity Well: hits two enemies, Slows the target. Side Swap: moves the target to the other end of the enemy line, Marks it, Slows the displaced enemy, Guards C-Ruin. Slowing Time: spends 3 Gravity, Slows every enemy 2 turns (3 at 5 Gravity, party gets Haste). Containment, Threat and Scent are still drafts.

characters.name: Shamoon
characters.title: Light Eater
characters.passive: A hulking black-and-gold figure in a mane of white wisps, with one gold spiral eye, one red spiral eye, a wide gold-toothed grin stitched at the corners, a gold heart on its chest above bone ribs, grey plated arms and legs, gold claws on every limb and a gold sword with a chain on its back. Drawn April 21st 2025; the sheet marks it Sinister 7, 1/7, the first of seven. Abilities on the sheet: Absorbing Light, Shadow Puppeteering, Shadow Sword, Umbra Claw, Shadow Armour. Light (max 5, resets each wave): each Light makes its damage 5% stronger. Shadow Sword cuts two enemies. Umbra Claw ignores DEF hard and heals it. Shadow Puppeteering spends 3 Light, hits and Marks every enemy (and Slows them at 5 Light), and Shadow Armour wraps Shamoon in Guard and +15% DEF afterwards.
characters.ident: A shadow duelist that drinks the light off its targets, then pulls every enemy's shadow tight and Marks the whole line.

skills.name: Shadow Sword
skills.desc: A blade of shadow from the gold hilt on its back: 1.0x on the target and 0.5x on the enemy beside it. +1 Light.

skills.name: Umbra Claw
skills.desc: The gold claw drinks the light off the target: 1.2x ignoring DEF, and Shamoon recovers 3% max HP. +1 Light.

skills.name: Shadow Puppeteering
skills.desc: Needs 3 Light, spends all of it. Every enemy takes (0.6 + 0.18 per Light)x and is Marked for 2 turns: their shadows now move first. At 5 Light the shadows are pulled tight and every enemy is also Slowed for 1 turn. Shadow Armour: Shamoon gets Guard for 1 turn and +15% DEF for 2 turns.

archive: Item FAL-0080 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject is filed as Shamoon, the name on its sheet. The sheet is dated April 21st 2025 and is marked Sinister 7, 1/7. The Foundation has not been shown 2/7 and would like to keep it that way.

Description: a hulking black-and-gold figure in a mane of white wisps, with one gold spiral eye and one red spiral eye. The grin is gold, wide and stitched at the corners. A gold heart sits on its chest above a set of bone ribs, and a gold sword on a chain hangs on its back. Every limb ends in gold claws.
null
Absorbing Light: lamps in the cell are replaced weekly. The replacements do not come on. The subject is never seen eating.
Shadow Puppeteering: staff shadows in the observation room have been observed to wave. Staff have been asked not to wave back.
Shadow Sword, Umbra Claw: both are the same shape as the subject's own shadow. The Foundation does not recommend standing in it.
Shadow Armour: when the cell lights are switched back on it is already wearing it.
null

book.abilityPlus: Shadow Puppeteering, Shadow Sword, Umbra Claw, Shadow Armour

Damage (Duelist): black-and-gold armoured figure, red spiral eye, white wisp mane. Light meter (max 5, resets each wave, +5% damage per Light). Shadow Sword: hits two enemies. Umbra Claw: ignores DEF, recovers HP. Shadow Puppeteering: spends 3 Light, hits and Marks every enemy (Slows at 5 Light); Shadow Armour is the Guard and DEF boost it gives afterwards. Containment, Threat and Scent are still drafts.

characters.name: Triggerfinger
characters.title: Minelayer
characters.passive: A hulking grey war-frame with a stitched, hollow face, green lamps on both shoulders, ribbed chest plates, torn white trousers and long curved claws, with a huge black soul shaped like a crow clinging to its back and watching with one red eye. Drawn April 2025 (abilities on the sheet: Beacon of the Lost Soul, Landmine Eruption, Speed Dash). REAL MINES: mines sit under specific enemies until they go off. The first time a mined enemy attacks on its turn, it steps forward and a mine goes off under it. Speed Dash cuts through two enemies and leaves a mine under the target. Beacon of the Lost Soul Marks one enemy and makes EVERY mine on the field crawl under it. Landmine Eruption sets off every mine at once, and each mine also hurts the enemies beside it.
characters.ident: Leaves real mines under enemies that go off when they attack, calls every mine to one target with the crow on its back, then sets the whole floor off.

skills.name: Speed Dash
skills.desc: He is already behind you. 1.0x on the target and 0.5x on the enemy beside it, and a Mine is left under the target. The first time a mined enemy attacks on its turn, it steps forward and a mine goes off under it (1.0x, ignoring DEF).

skills.name: Beacon of the Lost Soul
skills.desc: The soul on his back screams at the target: 0.6x, Marked for 3 turns and Slowed for 1 turn, and EVERY mine on the field crawls under it, plus one more. Then a Landmine Eruption on that one enemy is enormous.

skills.name: Landmine Eruption
skills.desc: Every mine on the field goes off now: each enemy takes 0.9x per mine under it, ignoring DEF, and the enemies beside it take 0.25x per mine there.

archive: Item FAL-0081 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject does not run from the Foundation. It runs ahead of it. The sheet is dated April 2025 and the Foundation files it as Triggerfinger. Do not follow it onto a clean floor.

Description: a hulking grey war-frame with a stitched, hollow face and green lamps on both shoulders. Ribbed chest plates, torn white trousers, long curved claws. A huge black soul in the shape of a crow clings to its back and watches with one red eye. The crow is not part of the frame. The frame is part of the crow.
null
Speed Dash: the subject is where you were. A small, round, heavy thing is left on the floor where it passed. Staff are asked not to pick it up.
Beacon of the Lost Soul: the crow screams once. Everything that hears it is, for a while, very easy to find.
Landmine Eruption: every small, round, heavy thing goes off at the same time. The count is always right.
null

book.abilityPlus: Landmine Eruption, Speed Dash

V240 REWORK: real mines replace the Mines counter. Mines sit under enemies; the first attack an enemy makes on its turn sets one off (1.0x). Speed Dash lays one, Beacon pulls every mine under its target, Landmine Eruption sets all off (0.9x per mine, splash beside).

characters.name: Nane
characters.title: Seeing Sound
characters.passive: A long-haired child in a black-and-white striped coat, hair so wild it hides the whole face, blue bandages wrapped around both feet, orange cuffs and a gold ring on the chest. Drawn April 6th 2025, the sheet says Name Nane, so the game uses it (abilities: Sound Blast, Energy Punch, Sound Breathing, Seeing Sound). She sees sound, and fights and heals with it: the party's offensive healer. Seeing Sound (passive): at the start of her turn she hears the enemy line and gains +1 Sound if any enemy is Slowed, and she hits Slowed enemies for +15%. Sound (max 5, resets each wave): each Sound makes her healing 5% stronger and her damage 4% stronger. Sound Blast hits two enemies and Slows one. Sound Breathing heals and cleanses one ally and hands them +20% ATK. Energy Punch spends 3 Sound on one hard punch that ignores DEF, shakes the enemy beside it, and heals the party a little.
characters.ident: The party’s offensive healer: Slows enemies with sound, hits the Slowed harder, and spends stored Sound on a punch that ignores armor and rattles the enemy beside it.

skills.name: Sound Blast
skills.desc: A shout you can see. 1.0x on the target and 0.5x on the enemy beside it, and the target is Slowed for 1 turn (she hits Slowed enemies harder). +1 Sound.

skills.name: Sound Breathing
skills.desc: You pick the ally (she can pick herself). They heal 20% max HP, are cleansed of Slow, Mark, Burning, Venom, Soak, Blur and Frostbite, and get +20% ATK for 2 turns. Stronger with Sound. +1 Sound.

skills.name: Energy Punch
skills.desc: Needs 3 Sound, spends all of it. (1.5 + 0.3 per Sound)x on the target, ignores DEF, and the shockwave hits the enemy beside it for 0.5x as hard. The whole party heals (3% + 1.5% per Sound) max HP.

archive: Item FAL-0082 is held at Containment Level: Moderate. The subject is a child with very long hair and is polite. The sheet gave it a longer name once, dated April 6th 2025. It prefers to be called Nane.

Description: a child in a black-and-white striped coat, hair so wild it hides the entire face, blue bandages wrapped around both feet, orange cuffs and a gold ring at the chest. An alternate costume in red and white stripes and a beta costume with purple sleeves are on file. The face is on file separately. The eyes are red.
null
Sound Blast: the shout is visible for about a second. Staff standing in it report that it was less loud than it looked.
Sound Breathing: the subject breathes in time with the injured. The injured, in time, stop being injured.
Seeing Sound: the subject can see sound. A quiet room is, to it, an empty room. Staff are asked to hum.
null

book.abilityPlus: Sound Blast, Energy Punch, Sound Breathing
