characters.name: Reflux
characters.title: Vampire Lord
characters.passive: A hunched vampire with a spiked red mane and wide red eyes, a grin full of needle teeth, a green ribbed coat of claws and vines, orange-banded knees and huge green claws, followed by his spirit The Lasher. Drawn March 1st 2024. Abilities on the sheet: Time Stop (10 sec), Blood Sucking, Blood Freezing, Ultra Strength, Vampire Regeneration. Arrogant and tactical, views himself as a god, loves toying with victims. Vampire Regeneration (passive): at the start of his turn he mends 2% max HP, +1% per Blood. Blood (max 5, resets each wave): he only gains it by draining. Blood Sucking bites and drinks back a share of the damage (25% + 8% per Blood) and gives 1 Blood, or 2 if the enemy is Slowed. Blood Freezing Slows one enemy and the one beside it (no Blood, but it doubles the next bite). Time Stop spends 3 Blood, hits and Slows every enemy, rewinds his body to how it was a turn ago and hastes him. He has no Taunt or Guard: he lives off regeneration and drain.
characters.ident: A time-bending vampire: drinks from frozen enemies, regenerates every turn, and stops time to rewind his wounds.

skills.name: Blood Sucking
skills.desc: Fangs in. 1.0x on the target, and Reflux drinks back (25% + 8% per Blood) of the damage dealt as HP. +1 Blood, or +2 if the target is Slowed (frozen blood is easy to drink).

skills.name: Blood Freezing
skills.desc: The blood in the target turns to ice: 0.7x, Slowed for 2 turns, and 0.4x on the enemy beside it. It does not build Blood by itself, but a Slowed enemy is worth double to his next bite.

skills.name: Time Stop
skills.desc: Needs 3 Blood, spends all of it. Ten seconds, all his. Every enemy takes (0.4 + 0.12 per Blood)x and is Slowed for 2 turns. Reflux rewinds his body to how it was at the start of his last turn (heals the HP he has lost since, up to 30% max HP), and gets +25% ATK and Haste (+30% SPD) for 2 turns.

archive: Item FAL-0083 is held at Containment Level: Extreme. The subject is courteous and considers the cell a guest room. The sheet is dated March 1st 2024 and the Foundation files it as Reflux. Staff are asked to stop clocks nearby.

Description: a hunched vampire with a spiked red mane, wide red eyes and a grin of needle teeth. A ribbed green coat of claws and vines, orange-banded knees, long green claws. A second shape, the spirit The Lasher, is filed with it: a black-mouthed green husk on spider legs that is never more than a room away.
null
Blood Sucking: the bite is slow, deliberate and apologised for afterwards, by no one.
Blood Freezing: what the subject takes it can also lock. The blood stops. The person does not notice for some time.

Time Stop: ten seconds. Staff report the subject always finishes what it started in them, and that afterwards it looks as it did a minute ago. Vampire Regeneration: wounds on the subject close on their own, a little more each time it has fed.
null

book.abilityPlus: Blood Sucking, Blood Freezing, Ultra Strength, Vampire Regeneration, spirit The Lasher
book.notes: Drawn March 1st 2024. Arrogant, tactical, views himself as a god. Tank (Bruiser): Blood meter.

characters.name: Kasugu
characters.title: Dark Thunder
characters.passive: A 22-year-old, 5'2" Japanese-American in a huge spiked blue-and-purple mane, black coat with a gold collar, orange-ruffled cuffs and yellow lightning at the sides, with a calm face and a very angry second face. Drawn March 1st 2025. Abilities on the sheet: Digital Manipulation, Overload Anger, Demon Speed Dash, Thunder Spike Slash, Dark Thunder Breathing. Anger (max 5, resets each wave): each Anger +5% damage, and at 5 Anger he Overloads for +10% more. Thunder Spike Slash cuts two enemies. Demon Speed Dash ignores DEF. Dark Thunder Breathing spends 3 Anger on every enemy and Marks them all when Overloaded. Digital Manipulation is folded into the Overload: at 5 Anger the breath also cuts every light and screen in the room, so the Slow lasts 2 turns instead of 1.
characters.ident: A thunder duelist: slashes and dashes to build Anger, then breathes dark lightning across every enemy.

skills.name: Thunder Spike Slash
skills.desc: 1.0x on the target and 0.5x on the enemy beside it. +1 Anger.

skills.name: Demon Speed Dash
skills.desc: He crosses the room before the sound does: 0.9x ignoring DEF. +1 Anger.

skills.name: Dark Thunder Breathing
skills.desc: Needs 3 Anger, spends all of it. Every enemy takes (0.7 + 0.2 per Anger)x and is Slowed for 1 turn. At 5 Anger (Overload) every enemy is also Marked for 2 turns, and Digital Manipulation switches the lights off for good: the Slow lasts 2 turns instead of 1.

archive: Item FAL-0084 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject is 22, 5'2" and Japanese-American on the sheet. It has two faces and is polite in one of them. The sheet is dated March 1st 2025 and the Foundation files it as Kasugu.

Description: a huge spiked blue-and-purple mane, a black coat with a gold collar, orange-ruffled cuffs and yellow lightning along the sides. The usual face is calm with pink eyes. The chasing face is red-eyed and very angry. Do not make the usual face go away.
null
Digital Manipulation: screens in the cell change channel when the subject is bored. They have begun to change channel when it is not.
Demon Speed Dash: the cell has been measured twice. The measurement is wrong the second time.
Dark Thunder Breathing: the subject breathes in. Every light in the building goes out. Then it breathes out.

book.notes: Drawn March 1st 2025. Age 22, 5'2", Japanese/American. Handwriting could also read Kasuqu. Damage (Duelist): Anger meter.

characters.name: Conquer
characters.title: Brutal Fighter
characters.passive: A hulking mass of dark-red, bristled fur with one huge black eye with a purple pupil, a maw of needle teeth, purple armour plates on the shoulders, stitched blue legs, chains hanging from the arms and long dangling claws. Drawn March 12th 2023. Abilities on the sheet: Claw Swipe, Chain of Torment, Touch of Paralysis. Brutal fighter with extreme strength, vengeful and cunning. Weakness: slow, so SPD is very low. V172: he is a Bruiser Tank, the front-line bully who hits back. Torment (max 5, resets each wave): each Torment makes his damage 5% stronger and his DEF 4% higher. Claw Swipe cuts two enemies. Chain of Torment Marks and Slows one enemy, hits harder when he is below half HP, and makes the enemy line fight him (Taunt). Touch of Paralysis spends 3 Torment, ignores DEF and Stuns.
characters.ident: A slow, brutal bruiser Tank: swipes and chains build Torment (damage and DEF), the chains pull every enemy onto him, then one touch paralyzes the target.

skills.name: Claw Swipe
skills.desc: Extreme strength. 1.1x on the target and 0.65x on the enemy beside it. +1 Torment.

skills.name: Chain of Torment
skills.desc: The chains on his arms lash out: 0.7x, the target is Marked for 3 turns and Slowed for 2 turns. Vengeful: if Conquer is below half HP, +0.3x. The chains hold the enemy line to him: he takes Taunt for 2 turns and Guard for 1 turn. +1 Torment.

skills.name: Touch of Paralysis
skills.desc: Needs 3 Torment, spends all of it. (1.3 + 0.25 per Torment)x on the target, ignores DEF, and the target is Stunned for 1 turn (bosses are Slowed for 2 turns instead). The target is then Marked for 2 turns.

archive: Item FAL-0085 is held at Containment Level: Extreme. The subject is slow, and has always been slow, and is never late. The sheet is dated March 12th 2023 and the Foundation files it as Conquer. It is vengeful. Staff are asked to keep a list of what they have done to it.

Description: a hulking mass of dark-red bristled fur, one huge black eye with a purple pupil, a maw of needle teeth and purple plates on the shoulders. Stitched blue legs, chains hanging from the arms, long dangling claws. Strengths: extreme strength. Weaknesses: slow.
null
Claw Swipe: the claw is not fast. The distance is simply not there any more by the time you notice.
Chain of Torment: the chains have been on it longer than the fur. They remember where you were.
Touch of Paralysis: a single finger. Staff report being fully awake for the remainder.
null

book.abilityPlus: Claw Swipe, Chain of Torment, Touch of Paralysis

characters.name: Tearwing
characters.title: Bleeding Angel
characters.passive: A tall red-and-black bleeding angel with a bandaged body, two black eyes with blue stripes above them, a long red beak like a plague mask, a purple X on the chest, grey spiked wings folded round the head and red feather-blades down both arms. Drawn March 12th 2023, filed as Weeping Angel, renamed Tearwing. SHE WEEPS FOR HER FRIENDS. Tears (max 5, resets each wave) are not made by her moves: she gains 1 Tear every time an ally takes a hit worth 8% or more of their max HP, and 2 when an ally falls. At the start of each of her turns her Tears fall on the most hurt ally (3% max HP for each Tear; the Tears are not used up), and each Tear makes all her healing 5% stronger, as does every Bleeding enemy (+3%). Bleeding Tear is her attack: it makes an enemy Bleed. Bandage Wrap heals and cleanses one ally (Bleeding too), and the suffering she takes off them becomes a Tear. Sorrow Flood spends 3 Tears, Slows every enemy, makes them all Bleed and heals the whole party, more for every enemy already Bleeding. The harder the fight is on her friends, the more she has to give.
characters.ident: A bleeding Angel who weeps when her friends are hurt: every big hit on an ally is a Tear, her Tears fall on the weakest ally every turn, and when the sorrow is full she floods the room with blood and mending.

skills.name: Bleeding Tear
skills.desc: 0.8x on the target, which Bleeds for 3 turns (3% max HP per turn). Every Bleeding enemy makes all her healing 3% stronger.

skills.name: Bandage Wrap
skills.desc: You pick the ally (she can pick herself). They heal 22% max HP (stronger with Tears and Bleeding enemies) and are cleansed of Slow, Mark, Burning, Venom, Bleeding, Soak, Blur and Frostbite. She absorbs the suffering: if anything was cleansed, she gains +1 Tear.

skills.name: Sorrow Flood
skills.desc: Needs 3 Tears, spends all of it. Every enemy takes (0.3 + 0.1 per Tear)x, is Slowed for 1 turn and Bleeds for 3 turns (3% max HP per turn). The whole party heals (8% + 3% per Tear) max HP, plus 2% for every enemy that was already Bleeding.

archive: Item FAL-0086 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject cries, and the cell is, as a result, always a little wet. The sheet is dated March 12th 2023 and was filed under Weeping Angel; the Foundation re-files it as Tearwing to avoid confusion with an earlier, quieter, entirely unrelated Item.

Description: a tall red-and-black bleeding angel, bandaged, with two black eyes under blue stripes, a long red beak like a plague mask and a purple X on the chest. Grey spiked wings fold around the head. Red feather-blades run down both arms. A Dutch note on the sheet says the colour was removed by accident and this is the saved version. Do not edit.
null
Bleeding Tear: where one lands, the nearest wound closes. The subject does not choose which.
Bandage Wrap: the bandages are the subject's. It gives them away and grows more.
Sorrow Flood: the room fills. Only the people who meant harm are out of their depth.
null

book.abilityPlus: Bleeding Tear, Bandage Wrap, Sorrow Flood
book.notes: Drawn March 12th 2023, filed as Weeping Angel, renamed Tearwing (an earlier Weeping Angel, ID 46, already exists). Healer (Weeping Medic): Tears meter. Sheet has a Dutch note: colour was removed by accident, this is the saved copy. Do not edit. V271 rework: Tears now come from allies being hurt (+1 per big hit, +2 when one falls) and fall on the most hurt ally every turn; Bleeding Tear is a plain Bleed attack.

characters.name: Stitchheart
characters.title: Heart Guardian
characters.passive: A horned, purple-furred Demon with long stitched hair, one huge pink eye with a red pupil and one dark X-shaped eye, a mouth of needle teeth, a torn bandaged right arm ending in black blades and a long pink tail that ends in a stitched heart. The sheet has no name, so the game calls it Stitchheart. Heartbeat (max 5, resets each wave): each Heartbeat makes its damage and healing 4% stronger. V172: it is the damage-sharing Tank. Heart Tether ties it to one ally for 3 turns: 35% of every hit that ally would take goes to Stitchheart instead, which builds Heartbeat and stores Pain. Stitch Lash hits and mends it, and the shared pulse mends the tethered ally too. Cardiac Arrest spends 3 Heartbeat, hits and Slows every enemy, releases the stored Pain on all of them, and takes Taunt, DEF and a heal.
characters.ident: A stitched Demon tank: ties its heart to one ally and takes a share of every hit they suffer, then releases the stored pain when the beat gets loud.

skills.name: Stitch Lash
skills.desc: The torn arm lashes out: 0.9x on the target, and Stitchheart heals 6% max HP. If an ally is tethered to him, the shared pulse heals them for half of that too. +1 Heartbeat.

skills.name: Heart Tether
skills.desc: The heart on the tail ties to one other ally for 3 turns. While tethered, 35% of all damage that ally would take goes to Stitchheart instead (reduced by his DEF). The first hit he absorbs each round gives +1 Heartbeat, and the damage is stored as Pain for Cardiac Arrest. Stitchheart braces for the shared pain: +20% DEF for the length of the tie. No Guard, no Taunt, no heal on the ally: the connection is the protection. Tethering a new ally cuts the old tie.

skills.name: Cardiac Arrest
skills.desc: Needs 3 Heartbeat, spends all of it. Every enemy takes (0.5 + 0.12 per Heartbeat)x and is Slowed for 1 turn, and the Pain the tether has stored is released: every enemy also takes 40% of it. Stitchheart takes Taunt for 2 turns, +25% DEF for 2 turns and heals 6% max HP (+2% per Heartbeat).

archive: Item FAL-0087 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject is unnamed on its sheet and the Foundation files it as Stitchheart. It is gentle with staff. It is not gentle with anything that is gentle with staff.

Description: a horned, purple-furred figure with long stitched hair, one huge pink eye with a red pupil and one dark eye marked with an X. A mouth of needle teeth, a torn, bandaged right arm ending in black blades. A long pink tail ends in a stitched heart that beats on its own.
null
Stitch Lash: the arm closes the wound it makes. The subject calls this manners.
Heart Tether: the tail heart ties to a person. The person's pulse becomes, for a minute, the subject's.
Cardiac Arrest: the subject's heart stops. Everything in earshot is briefly reminded that it has one.
null

book.abilityPlus: Stitch Lash, Heart Tether, Cardiac Arrest
book.notes: Unnamed sheet, named by the game. Horned purple stitched Demon with a heart on its tail. Tank (Heartbound, V172): Heartbeat meter, tethers one ally and shares their damage.

characters.name: Bloodspike
characters.title: Quill Brute
characters.passive: A hunched black brute covered in spikes, with a blue-striped dome of a head, one pink eye and a huge black grin, a red eye in the chest, a toothy maw in the belly, a thicket of scribbled black quills on the back and rainbow claws on every foot. Drawn March 26th 2025, the sheet only has the name Bloodspike, so its moves are the game's. Quills (max 5, resets each wave): each Quill makes its damage 5% stronger. V172: a single-target executioner. Spike Jab and Rainbow Quills stack Bleed on one enemy (max 5 stacks, 1.5% max HP per turn each); Rainbow Quills spill onto the neighbour once the target is full. Impale spends 3 Quills, ignores DEF, hits harder per Bleed stack, pays out the rest of the bleed at once and executes a weakened non-boss.
characters.ident: A spiked brute: stacks bleed on one enemy with jabs and rainbow quills, then impales it to cash the whole bleed in and finish it.

skills.name: Spike Jab
skills.desc: 1.0x on the target, which gains 1 Bleed stack (each stack: 1.5% max HP per turn for 3 turns, max 5). +1 Quill.

skills.name: Rainbow Quills
skills.desc: Three quills, 0.4x each, every one adding a Bleed stack. Once the target is at 5 stacks the rest spill onto the enemy beside it. +1 Quill.

skills.name: Impale
skills.desc: Needs 3 Quills, spends all of it. Cashes in the target's Bleed: (1.0 + 0.25 per Quill + 0.3 per Bleed stack)x, ignores DEF, then the rest of the bleed is paid out at once (up to 30% of its max HP) and the Bleed ends. A non-boss left under (15% + 4% per stack) max HP is Executed. Single target: no splash.

archive: Item FAL-0088 is held at Containment Level: Extreme. The subject is a brute and has never needed to be anything else. The sheet is dated March 26th 2025 and names it Bloodspike. No abilities are listed. The Foundation did not need them to be.

Description: a hunched black mass of spikes. A blue-striped dome of a head, one pink eye and a wide black grin. A red eye in the chest, a toothy mouth in the belly, a thicket of black quills along the back and rainbow claws on every foot. The cell is repainted every month.
null
Spike Jab: the wound stays open. The subject finds this very funny.
Rainbow Quills: the back stands up and every colour leaves at once. Staff report the afterimages are worse.
Impale: a single point. The rest of the body follows it.
null

book.abilityPlus: Spike Jab, Rainbow Quills, Impale
book.notes: Drawn March 26th 2025. Sheet has only the name; moves are the game's. Damage (Impaler, V172): Quills meter, single-target Bleed stacks.

characters.name: Naginata
characters.title: Soul Eater
characters.passive: A hovering dark-red horror with a black dome of a head, one cyan spiral eye, a round cyan-toothed maw, two huge cyan-edged scythe arms and a braided tail. Per the sheet it kidnaps two people a day and throws them off buildings, believes humans can fly because of the oil in their bodies, has 153 known victims, 7 assassination attempts and a presumed 2004 more. Abilities: Paralyzing Spore, Slicing Blade, Soul Eater. Souls (max 5, resets each wave): each Soul makes its damage 5% stronger. Slicing Blade ignores DEF. Paralyzing Spore hits and Slows every enemy. Soul Eater spends 3 Souls, ignores DEF and heals it.
characters.ident: Slices through armor, fills the room with paralyzing spores, and eats a soul to heal.

skills.name: Slicing Blade
skills.desc: The blade hands sharpen to ten times their edge: 1.2x on the target, ignores DEF. +1 Soul.

skills.name: Paralyzing Spore
skills.desc: Orange spores fill the air: 0.4x to every enemy, and every enemy is Slowed for 2 turns (anything that can resist them still feels them). +1 Soul.

skills.name: Soul Eater
skills.desc: Needs 3 Souls, spends all of it. (1.4 + 0.25 per Soul)x on the target, ignores DEF, and Naginata heals (12% + 4% per Soul) max HP, to live a little longer.

archive: Item FAL-0089 is held at Containment Level: Extreme. The subject kidnaps two people a day and throws them off buildings. It believes humans can fly because of the oil in their bodies. Known victims: 153. Assassination attempts: 7. Presumed victims: 2004. The Foundation files it as Naginata.
Description: a hovering dark-red horror with a black dome of a head, one cyan spiral eye and a round, cyan-toothed maw. Two huge cyan-edged scythe arms. A braided tail trails below.
null
Paralyzing Spore: it exhales orange spores that paralyze anything within a metre. Anything that resists is thrown into the victim instead.
Slicing Blade: the subject increases the sharpness of its blade hands tenfold. It does not say what it sharpened them on.
Soul Eater: it eats the souls of its victims for its own lifespan. The lifespan is, by now, extensive.
null

book.abilityPlus: Paralyzing Spore, Slicing Blade
book.notes: From the sheet: kidnaps 2 people a day and throws them off buildings; believes humans can fly because of the oil in their bodies. 153 known victims, 7 assassination attempts, 2004 presumed. Damage (Reaper): Souls meter.

characters.name: Uquna
characters.title: Monochrome Hell
characters.passive: A tall white-furred creature with a hooded mane, one glowing blue eye, a wide red mouth of needle teeth, grey armoured forearms, long ice-blue claws, bloody red spikes and guts hanging from its stomach that are real and used as a capture weapon. ID 5506, Containment Level EXTREME, drawn Nov 24th 2025. It lives 70 metres underground, needs daily feeding (three to five dead cows) and attacks the walls 24/7. Ability: Monochrome Hell. Hunger (max 5, resets each wave): each Hunger makes its damage 4% stronger. V172: the capture is now real. Gut Whip hits two enemies and CAPTURES one: while held it deals 30% less damage (20% for bosses) and is Slowed, and Uquna gains Hunger every turn he holds it. Monochrome Hell hits every enemy, renews the capture and puts him in front with Taunt and Guard. Feeding Time spends 3 Hunger, ignores DEF and heals him, and if the target is his captive it is eaten for +50% damage and double healing.
characters.ident: A starving Containment wall: captures one enemy in its guts (it hits far softer while held), drains the room to monochrome, then eats the captive.

skills.name: Gut Whip
skills.desc: The guts hanging from the stomach are real and used as a capture weapon: 0.8x on the target and 0.4x on the enemy beside it. The target is CAPTURED for 3 turns: it deals 30% less damage (20% for bosses) and is Slowed for 2 turns. Uquna holds one captive at a time; a new capture lets the old one go. While he holds a captive, he gains +1 Hunger at the start of his own turn. +1 Hunger.

skills.name: Monochrome Hell
skills.desc: The room drains of colour and fills with black liquid: 0.5x to every enemy, and the captive is pulled tight (the capture is renewed to full length). Uquna takes Taunt for 2 turns and Guard for 1 turn. +1 Hunger.

skills.name: Feeding Time
skills.desc: Needs 3 Hunger, spends all of it. (1.2 + 0.25 per Hunger)x on the target, ignores DEF, and Uquna heals (8% + 4% per Hunger) max HP and gains +15% DEF for 2 turns. If the target is his CAPTIVE it is eaten: +50% damage, double the healing, and the capture ends.

archive: Item 5506 is held at Containment Level: EXTREME, seventy metres underground. The subject can only be seen when someone willingly goes down the elevator. It needs feeding daily (three to five dead cows usually cover it) and, even fed, attacks the walls 24/7 hoping to get out. The Foundation files it as Uquna.

Description: a tall white-furred creature with a hooded mane, one glowing blue eye, a wide red mouth of needle teeth, grey armoured forearms and long ice-blue claws. The cell is made of very thick metal, and is dented, with black liquid everywhere. The guts hanging from its stomach are real and used as a capture weapon. Most of its skin is fur.
null
Gut Whip: the guts are not trailing. They are aimed.
Monochrome Hell: when it is angry every colour in the room is lost. Staff have stopped asking for the colours back.
Feeding Time: daily. Nothing in the cell is allowed to be larger than the subject.
null

book.abilityPlus: Gut Whip, Feeding Time
book.notes: Sheet ID 5506, drawn Nov 24th 2025. Alienish creature 70 metres underground, needs daily feeding (3-5 dead cows), attacks the walls 24/7. Guts are a capture weapon. Tank (Containment): Hunger meter. Game ID 0090. V172: Gut Whip now CAPTURES one enemy (it deals less damage while held) and Feeding Time eats the captive.

characters.name: Ripper
characters.title: Creator of Clowns
characters.passive: A small, pale, stitched-together figure under a curtain of long black hair, one eye solid black and one glowing red, a mouth sewn shut with the stitches half popped, in a patched olive sweater and dark trousers. He made every Clown in Clown's Massacre, and he is FORCED into that side quest: they are his creations, so being near them is his torment, and every Clown goes for him first. Madness (max 5, resets each wave): +1 at the start of every turn and +1 every time he is hit; each Madness is +5% damage and mends him 1% max HP at the start of his turn, because he rebuilds himself. Dismember takes a limb (the enemy deals 15% less and is Slowed, and Ripper hits it 15% harder). Rebuild stitches an ally back together. Creator's Fit spends the Madness to hit the whole line, Dismember it, and make the Clowns flinch from their maker (cooldown 3).
characters.ident: The man who built every Clown. Forced on you in Clown's Massacre, hunted by his own creations, and he stitches himself back together faster than they can take him apart.

skills.name: Dismember
skills.desc: Takes a limb. 1.0x, Dismembers the target for 3 turns (it deals 15% less damage and is Slowed). A target that is already Dismembered takes 1.3x and Ripper keeps the spare part: he heals 8% max HP.

skills.name: Rebuild
skills.desc: Needle, thread and a lot of practice. Heals one ally 22% max HP (Ripper himself 30%), cleanses Slow, Mark, Burning, Venom and Soak, and gives them +20% DEF for 2 turns.

skills.name: Creator's Fit
skills.desc: Needs 3 Madness, spends all of it. He screams in the voice that made them. Hits EVERY enemy for (0.6x + 0.15x per Madness) ignoring DEF and Dismembers them for 2 turns. Clowns flinch from their maker and are Stunned for 1 turn (bosses are Slowed). It costs him 10% max HP.

archive: Item FAL-0091 is held at Containment Level: Extreme. The subject asks for tools every morning. The answer is always no. Ability: ???.

Description: a small, pale, stitched-together figure with long black hair hanging over its face, one black eye and one red eye, a mouth sewn mostly shut, and a patched olive sweater. The patches do not match the sweater.
null
null
The subject is the origin of every Clown on record. The Clowns know it. None of them will stay in the same room with him quietly.
null

book.abilityPlus: Dismember, Rebuild, Creator's Fit
book.notes: Was the Prototype 'Genie' (Creator of Clowns), renamed Ripper in v185. Made every Clown in Clown's Massacre, and is FORCED into that side quest: they are his creations, so being near them is his torment, and every Clown targets him first. Tank (Bruiser): Madness meter, dismembers enemies, rebuilds allies and himself. Kit, stats and lore text are my draft, review them.

characters.name: Clown.x2
characters.title: The Understudy
characters.passive: A grinning white-faced jester crouched low in a red and charcoal striped hat and diamond patchwork, a round red nose, dark red ringed eyes and a ruff of red hair. A rare version of Clown.x2 from Clown's Massacre: it fought you as a boss, lost, and now works for you. Free alternate skin: Candy Cane. Clawmark rakes and Marks an enemy. Temporary Duplication strikes, then splits him in two: a real copy of him (half HP, 75% ATK) fights on your side for 3 turns before it fades. False Finale hits every enemy and heals him a little, because somebody has to clap.
characters.ident: A rare jester Clown.x2 that fought you as a boss and joined up after losing: rakes and Marks, splits into a real copy that fights beside him for 3 turns, then takes a bow that hits the whole room.

skills.name: Clawmark
skills.desc: Rakes the target. 1.0x and Marks it for 2 turns (Marked enemies take extra damage).

skills.name: Temporary Duplication
skills.desc: Strikes for 0.8x, then splits in two. A real copy of Clown.x2 (half his HP, 75% of his ATK) joins your side and fights on its own for 3 turns, then fades. Enemies can hit it. Only one copy at a time.

skills.name: False Finale
skills.desc: Takes a bow. Hits every enemy for 0.55x and heals Clown.x2 for 6% max HP. Nobody is clapping, so he claps for himself.

archive: Item FAL-0092 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject is a Clown of an unusual design. It appears only on rare occasions. Ability: Temporary Duplication.
Description: a white-faced jester in a striped red and charcoal hat and diamond patchwork, ringed red eyes and a red nose, crouched low like it is about to spring.
null
null
The subject is thought to be an understudy: a spare copy of Clown.x2 kept in case the first one does not last. The first one never lasts.
null

book.abilityPlus: Clawmark, False Finale
book.notes: Rare special version of the Clown.x2 boss (red and charcoal jester art) in Clown's Massacre (10% of the time the Clown.x2 floor boss is this one). Beat him in Story and he joins your roster; in Freeplay he is open from the start. Damage (Duelist): Clawmark rakes and Marks, Temporary Duplication makes a real copy of him that fights beside him for 3 turns, False Finale hits everyone and heals him. Game ID 0092, key clownx2. Kit, stats and lore text are my draft, review them. Free alternate skin: Candy Cane (white and red).

characters.name: Clown.x33
characters.title: Blood Patches
characters.passive: The bandaged clown from Clown's Massacre, now on your side: a round white face with red tufts of hair, black-ringed eyes, a huge blood-streaked grin full of teeth, a body wrapped in stained bandages, clawed hands and a wooden peg for one leg. Ability: Blood Patches. Patches (max 5, resets each wave): every move adds one, and each Patch makes its heals 4% stronger. Rend claws an enemy, leaves it Bleeding and drips the damage back into the most wounded ally. Blood Patch bandages one ally: heal, cleanse and +25% DEF. Wrapped Up spends 3 Patches to wrap the whole team in a heal and Guard while every Bleeding enemy is torn open.
characters.ident: A bandaged clown who claws enemies open and stitches its friends up with the same blood: heals through every wound it causes.

skills.name: Rend
skills.desc: Claws the target for 1.0x and leaves it Bleeding for 2 turns (3% max HP a turn). The wound drips onto the most wounded ally: they heal for 60% of the damage dealt. +1 Patch.

skills.name: Blood Patch
skills.desc: You pick the ally. A bloody bandage goes on: they heal 20% max HP (+4% per Patch), lose Slow, Mark, Burning, Venom, Soak, Blur and Frostbite, and gain +25% DEF for 2 turns. +1 Patch.

skills.name: Wrapped Up
skills.desc: Needs 3 Patches, spends all of them. Everyone gets wrapped: the whole party heals (9% + 3% per Patch) max HP and gains Guard for 1 turn. Every Bleeding enemy is torn open for (0.6x + 0.1x per Patch) ignoring DEF.

archive: Item FAL-0093 is held at Containment Level: Medium. The subject is bandaged from the neck down and does not say why. Staff who have been treated by it report that the wound closed faster than it should have and that they are not sure whose blood did it.

Description: a clown with a round white face, red tufts of hair, a wide blood-streaked grin full of teeth, a body wrapped in stained bandages, clawed hands and a wooden peg for one leg. Taken from Clown's Massacre.
null
Rend: the claws are not for attacking, the subject says. They are for finding where it hurts. The wound it opens always bleeds toward someone who needs it more.
Blood Patch: a strip of bandage is pressed on and the pain moves out of it. The subject does not wash the bandages. The subject says that would waste them.
Wrapped Up: after enough patches the subject wraps everyone in the room. Anyone still bleeding at the end of it is Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
null

book.abilityPlus: Rend, Blood Patch, Wrapped Up
book.notes: The bandaged Clown.x33 from Clown's Massacre, playable from the start (art cut from that mode, sprites/clownx33.png). Healer (Leech): Patches meter, claws and bleeds enemies and drips the damage back into the team, bandages one ally, then wraps the whole party. Kit, stats and lore text are my draft, review them.

characters.name: Devourer
characters.title: Hunger
characters.passive: Meal to Heal. A pink-haired kid with spiral eyes, claws, and a face that opens. She heals her team by eating flesh: whatever she swallows comes back out as healing for her allies. Flesh (max 5, resets each wave): every move adds one, and each Flesh makes her heals 4% stronger. Gorge (mouth open) tears a chunk off an enemy, leaves it Bleeding, heals her and the most wounded ally (50% more off an enemy that is already Bleeding), and makes her Fed (heals 25% stronger for 2 turns, Mask 1 on). Share the Meal feeds a piece to one ally to heal, cleanse and shield them. Devour spends 3 Flesh on a huge bite that swallows weakened enemies whole, then heals and cleanses the whole party.
characters.ident: Meal to Heal: she eats the enemy and the flesh comes back out as healing. Bleeding prey heals more, and what she swallows whole feeds the whole team.

skills.name: Gorge
skills.desc: Mouth open. Tears a chunk out of the target for 0.9x and eats it, leaving it Bleeding for 2 turns (3% max HP a turn). Devourer heals 8% max HP and the most wounded ally 5% max HP, 50% more if the target was already Bleeding (fresh meat). She becomes Fed for 2 turns (heals 25% stronger, Mask 1 on). +1 Flesh.

skills.name: Share the Meal
skills.desc: Mask 1 on. You pick the ally. She tears off a piece of what she ate and feeds it to them: they heal 22% max HP (+4% per Flesh, +25% while Fed), lose one bad status and take less damage for 2 turns (+30% DEF). +1 Flesh.

skills.name: Devour
skills.desc: Needs 3 Flesh, spends all of it. Her face opens all the way: a huge bite for (1.2 + 0.15 per Flesh)x ignoring DEF. A non-boss left under 25% HP (40% if Bleeding) is swallowed whole. What she ate comes back as healing: the whole party heals (7% max HP, +7% if she ate something) and each ally loses one bad status.

archive: Item FAL-0094 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject is cooperative as long as it is fed, and generous with what it makes from the food. Staff are asked not to ask what is in the soup.

Description: a pink-haired child in a red coat, claws, and spiral eyes that weep. The face has three settings: calm, a horned grin (Mask 1), and a mouth the width of the head. Prototype entry from the Foundation's earliest Codex pages.
null

Gorge: the mouth opens, the subject takes a piece of whatever is nearest and eats it, then shares the warmth afterwards. A wound that is already open is eaten from first. The warmth is real. It is the only part that is.

Share the Meal: the subject puts the mask on, tears off a little of what she ate and puts it in a person's mouth. Everyone who has been fed describes it as the safest they have ever felt, and the taste as unforgivable.
Devour: what the subject swallows does not stay swallowed. It comes back out as a warm light and a very good mood. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
null

book.abilityPlus: Gorge, Share the Meal, Devour
book.notes: V227 rework from the user's drawing (calm face, Mask 1, Mouth Open). Healer (Leech): Flesh meter, eats enemy flesh and turns it into healing; Bleeding enemies heal her more. Art by the user. Kit and lore text are my draft, review them.

characters.name: Hush
characters.title: Quiet Angel
characters.passive: A tall, pale, eyeless angel that finds everyone by sound, and is extremely friendly about it. Echo (max 5, resets each wave): every move adds one, and each Echo makes her heals 4% stronger. Click heals one ally and the echo bounces to the most wounded other ally. Hold Still quiets the room and heals and shields the whole party. Shriek spends 3 Echo on a sound that hits an enemy, Slows it and heals the party. But when she is hurt badly (under 35% HP) she stops listening: she SPIRALS for 2 turns, +60% ATK and +30% DEF, three unaimed hits per turn that mend the party with the damage, then goes quiet and slow for a turn. She can only spiral again once she has been healed above 60% HP.
characters.ident: A blind, gentle angel that heals by echolocation. Keep her healthy: when she is hurt badly she stops listening.

skills.name: Click
skills.desc: A soft click. The sound comes back off the target: they heal 14% max HP (+4% per Echo), and the echo bounces to the most wounded OTHER ally for 7% max HP. +1 Echo.

skills.name: Hold Still
skills.desc: Everyone stops moving and the room goes quiet. The whole party heals (7% + 3% per Echo) max HP, gains +15% DEF for 2 turns and loses Slow, Mark and Blur. +1 Echo.

skills.name: Shriek
skills.desc: Needs 3 Echo, spends all of it. The echo comes back wrong. It hits the target for (1.0 + 0.2 per Echo)x ignoring DEF and Slows it 2 turns, then the whole party heals 8% max HP.

archive: Item FAL-0095 is held at Containment Level: Extreme. The subject is blind, gentle and extremely friendly. It must never be startled, and it must never be wounded where it can hear.
Description: a tall pale angel with no eyes, large listening ears and a mouth that rarely opens. It clicks softly to find people and thanks them for being there.
null
Click: a sound goes out, a sound comes back, and whoever it touched is a little better. The subject says it is only checking you are still there.
Hold Still: the subject asks the room to stop moving. The room does. Observers note that they could not have disobeyed if they had wanted to.
Shriek: kept sealed on request of the subject. If it is hurt badly enough the sound is no longer kind. Afterwards it apologises to everyone present. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
null

book.abilityPlus: Click, Hold Still, Shriek
book.notes: A blind, extremely friendly 'Death Angel from a quiet place'. Healer (Amplifier): Echo meter, heals by echolocation; when hurt below 35% HP she Spirals for 2 turns (unaimed rampage that mends the party), then goes quiet. Working name, sprite is a placeholder until the real art arrives. Kit, stats and lore text are my draft, review them. V240: real sprite (the author's Gemini art) replaces the placeholder. V272 buff (balance test: one of the weakest): HP and DEF raised, heals stronger.

characters.name: Clown.x25
characters.title: Two to One
characters.passive: A round, scarred, pale clown head with a stitched seam down one side, red tufts of hair, one red-ringed eye and one empty black socket, and a huge grin of needle teeth, on a small body in a patched red jacket with grey shoulder plates, dark trousers and red shoes, with black hooked claws held open at its sides. The armored half and the doll from Clown's Massacre, fused for good and now on your side. Ability: Two to One. Hands (max 5, resets each wave): every move adds one. Iron Fist swings the armored fist (+5% damage per Hand). Hold Hands takes an ally by the hand: they gain Guard and +DEF while Clown.x25 Taunts and takes the hits. Two Become One spends 3 Hands: it hits and Marks every enemy, Guards the whole party and mends Clown.x25. Come Apart: once per wave, when the armor would go down it breaks along the seam instead. The Armored Half stays up at 30% HP with +25% DEF and a Taunt, and the Doll climbs out as its own small ally for the rest of the wave, holding hands with whoever is hurting most (a Guard, a little healing, and a Hand for the armor). They never fuse back. If the armor falls for good, the doll sits down beside it.
characters.ident: Two clowns in one body: the armored half takes the hits and Taunts, the doll holds an ally's hand and shields them, when the Hands pile up the armor closes on the whole room, and if the armor would fall it comes apart and the doll walks out on its own.

skills.name: Iron Fist
skills.desc: Swings the armored fist for 1.1x (+0.05x per Hand). +1 Hand.

skills.name: Hold Hands
skills.desc: You pick the ally. The doll takes their hand and the armor steps in front: they gain Guard for 1 turn and +20% DEF for 2 turns (+3% per Hand), and Clown.x25 gains Taunt and +20% DEF for 2 turns. +1 Hand.

skills.name: Two Become One
skills.desc: Needs 3 Hands, spends all of them. The armor opens both arms and closes on the room: every enemy takes (0.6x + 0.1x per Hand) and is Marked for 2 turns, the whole party gains Guard for 1 turn, and Clown.x25 recovers 8% max HP (+2% per Hand).

archive: Item FAL-0096 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject is two subjects and must never be filed as one. Staff who have tried were corrected, politely, by both. Ability: Two to One.

Description: a pale, scarred clown head with a stitched seam, red tufts of hair, one red-ringed eye and one empty black socket, and a wide grin of needle teeth. A patched red jacket with grey shoulder plates, black hooked claws held open as if to hug. Taken from Clown's Massacre. Two smaller forms are also on file: the armored half, and the doll.
null
Iron Fist: the armored half does the swinging. The subject says the other half has never once needed to.
Hold Hands: something small reaches out of the chest and takes the nearest person by the hand. The armor then steps in front of that person. Neither has been asked to.
Two Become One: the arms open. Observers who were inside the room report that it was very quiet, and that someone was holding their hand. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
null

book.abilityPlus: Iron Fist, Hold Hands, Two Become One
book.notes: The fused Clown.x25 ('2 to 1') from Clown's Massacre, playable from the start (art from that mode, sprites/clownx25.png). Tank (Protector): Hands meter, Taunts and holds an ally's hand so the armor takes the hits, then closes on the whole room. Kit, stats and lore text are my draft, review them.

characters.name: The Vendor
characters.title: Shopkeeper
characters.passive: Containment Level: None. The shopkeeper from every shop stop, finally on your side of the counter. His healing is bought and sold: every move stocks the shelves (Stock, max 5, resets each wave). Free Sample heals one ally, Buy One Get One heals a second ally for free, and Clearance Sale spends all Stock for a party heal with a random 0-60% markdown bonus. CREDIT RATING: every 100 coins you are holding adds +2% to his healing (max +20%), so he rewards a saved-up wallet. Unlocked by beating him in a shop stop.
characters.ident: Sells you back to health: Stock builds a Clearance Sale with a random markdown, and a fat wallet makes every heal stronger.

skills.name: Free Sample
skills.desc: "First one's on the house." Heals one ally 20% max HP and gives them +15% DEF for 1 turn. +1 Stock.

skills.name: Buy One, Get One
skills.desc: Heals one ally 17% max HP, and the most hurt OTHER ally gets the very same heal free. +1 Stock.

skills.name: Clearance Sale
skills.desc: "Everything must go!" Spends all Stock. Heals the whole party (10% + 4% per Stock) max HP, boosted by today's random markdown (0-60% off becomes 0-60% more healing), cleanses Slow, Mark and Irradiated, and everyone leaves the sale excited: +15% ATK for 2 turns. At 5 Stock it is a Going Out Of Business sale: everyone also gets Guard for 1 turn. Needs 2 Stock.

archive: Item FAL-0097 is a shopkeeper. Containment Level: None.
The subject appears at every rest stop in the facility. No one has seen him arrive, and no one has seen him close.

Interviewer: Where do you get your stock?
{n}: Customers.
Interviewer: Customers sell to you?
{n}: Eventually.
The subject accepts coins and nothing else. Attempts to pay him in other currency have been returned with a receipt.
Containment Level: None. Sales records: sealed.
He heals better than he haggles. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.

V240: real sprite (the author's Gemini art) replaces the placeholder. V272 buff (balance test: one of the weakest): HP and DEF raised, heals stronger.

characters.name: Velara
characters.title: Blood Angel
characters.passive: Blood Warden: her healing is paid for in blood. Blood Orb costs her a little HP and shields and heals an ally. Her divine ultimate lets her fall into the Sinner Form, a Tank with a charge-up finisher. In Nuzlocke, when her body is destroyed the Sinner takes over for good.
characters.ident: Heals by bleeding, and when it is over she can fall into a Sinner Form that hits like a spiral.

skills.name: Blood Orb
skills.desc: Velara bleeds a little (5% of her max HP, never below 1) into a floating orb. The target heals 20% max HP and takes half damage for 2 turns.

skills.name: Halo Lash
skills.desc: Her halo whips out. 1.0x and Marks the target for 2 turns (+20% damage taken).

skills.name: Crimson Benediction
skills.desc: A prayer that stains the air. The whole party heals 12% max HP and gets +15% DEF for 2 turns.

book.abilityPlus: Blood Orb, Halo Lash, Crimson Benediction; divine ultimate Fall of the Sinner (Sinner Form: Tank)
book.notes: Blood Angel. ID 0098 is the next free number. Healer (Warden): heals by bleeding. Blood Orb costs her 5% max HP and heals an ally 20% with half damage for 2 turns; Halo Lash charges then unleashes 3.4x ignoring DEF; Crimson Benediction heals the party and raises DEF. Fall of the Sinner (Divine ultimate, once per 5 waves) turns her into the Sinner Form, a Tank with Golden Ratio (charge-up, 3.4x piercing), Angels Headshot and Blood Orbs (hits all enemies, bleed, heals her 25% of damage), until the wave ends. In Nuzlocke the Sinner can take over an ally and both die for good. Art: white-haired angel with red halo and blood orbs; Sinner Form is a winged red angel with a thorn halo and claws. Containment, Scent and Threat are my draft. V272 buff (balance test: one of the weakest): HP and DEF raised, heals stronger.

characters.name: Whiplash
characters.title: Wired Guardian
characters.passive: A brown, stitched, well-loved bunny plush with long floppy ears (one torn open to the grey wiring), a huge needle-toothed grin, one green eye and one yellow eye, and a bloody patch on its chest. One arm is striped blue and white, the other is grey metal, and wires and claws spill out of both hands. Drawn April 25th 2025. Ability: Whiplash. It sends wires out of its arms and ties enemies to itself. LEASH: a Leashed enemy can only single-target Whiplash, and every hit it lands on him is lashed back. He has no Taunt. He chooses who to tie: Wire Lash leashes its target (and yanks one that is already Leashed), Pull Them Behind guards an ally and leashes every enemy that has hurt them this wave, and Reel In drags every Leashed enemy into him at once, so they crash into each other. Death Rage: once per wave, when it would fall, it does not. For 2 turns it cannot be killed, hits 60% harder, every enemy is Leashed to it, and every turn is a rampage. If the rampage clears the wave it is left standing on 1 HP. If not, it drops. It died stabbed ten times through the heart protecting some kids, and it took the attackers with it.
characters.ident: A bunny plush with wires for arms that hauls its friends behind it, and when it should be dead it gets up in a rage.

skills.name: Wire Lash
skills.desc: Wires whip out of both arms: 1.0x, and the target is Leashed to him for 2 turns (its single-target attacks can only go at Whiplash, and every hit it lands on him is lashed back). If it was already Leashed, he yanks it: 0.5x more and it is Slowed for 1 turn.

skills.name: Pull Them Behind
skills.desc: You pick the ally. Wires slide around them and pull them behind him: Guard for 1 turn and +20% DEF for 2 turns. Then every enemy that has hurt that ally this wave is Leashed to Whiplash for 2 turns. If nobody has hurt them yet, the enemy with the highest ATK is Leashed instead.

skills.name: Reel In
skills.desc: Needs at least one Leashed enemy. He hauls on every wire at once and drags every Leashed enemy into him, where they crash into each other: each takes 0.7x plus 0.25x for every OTHER Leashed enemy, and is Slowed for 2 turns. With 3 or more Leashed they are also Stunned for 1 turn. Whiplash braces: Guard for 1 turn.

archive: Item FAL-0099 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject is gentle until a child is in the room, and then it is something else. Staff are asked to keep children out of sight of the subject's arms. Ability: Whiplash.

Description: a brown, stitched bunny plush with long floppy ears, one torn open to the grey wiring, a huge needle-toothed grin and mismatched green and yellow eyes. A bloody patch on the chest. One arm is striped blue and white, the other is grey metal, and wires and claws spill out of both hands. Recorded April 25th 2025.
null

Incident Report: the subject was stabbed ten times through the heart while shielding a group of children, and it did not stop. Witnesses describe a state they will not name. The wires went out, everything that had attacked the children was dealt with, and only then did the subject drop. The children were not harmed.

Personnel Note: staff who have been pulled behind the subject by the wires report no fear, and a strong reluctance to be put down. Once per interview the subject asks whether the children got home. The correct answer is yes. It does not always believe it.
Death Rage: if the subject falls in a room, it does not fall. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.

book.abilityPlus: Wire Lash, Pull Them Behind, Reel In; passive Death Rage; divine ultimate Wire Frenzy
book.notes: Wired Guardian. Drawn April 25th 2025. Tank (Protector): sends wires out of its arms. Wires (max 5, resets each wave): Wire Lash 1.0x (+6% per Wire) and Slows; Wire Weave gives an ally Guard and +DEF while Whiplash Taunts; Wire Storm spends 3 Wires, hits every enemy and Slows and Marks them. Death Rage: once per wave, when it would fall it stays up on 1 HP for 2 turns, +60% ATK, and each turn is an unaimed rampage of 3 hits. If the rampage clears the wave it survives; if not it drops (permanent in Nuzlocke). Lore: stabbed ten times through the heart protecting some kids, it went into a death state, killed the attackers, then dropped. Art: brown stitched bunny plush, mismatched green and yellow eyes, striped blue-white arm and grey metal arm with wires and claws. Containment and Threat are my draft. V239 REWORK: Leash replaces Wires. A Leashed enemy can only single-target Whiplash (beats Taunt) and is lashed back when it hits him. No Taunt. Wire Lash leashes (yanks if already Leashed); Pull Them Behind guards an ally and leashes every enemy that hurt them this wave; Reel In drags all Leashed enemies in, more Leashed = more damage each. Death Rage leashes every enemy to him.

characters.name: Crushdeath
characters.title: Scrap Heap
characters.passive: A round, dark, scribble-textured head with spiky red-brown hair, one pentagram eye and one blank white eye, and a huge bloody grin of needle teeth, on a small body wrapped in black thread and scrap. One arm is a heavy clawed gauntlet crawling with purple eyes, the other ends in a spiked horn drill with another eye. Drawn June 8th 2025. Ability: Thrasher. It manipulates scrap and trash. THE JUNK WALL: Crushdeath builds a wall of junk in front of the WHOLE team (up to 60% of his max HP, resets each wave). While it stands it soaks up half of every enemy hit on any hero, and when enemies knock it down the junk flies back at whoever did it. He has no Taunt; the wall is how he protects. Scrap Slam rips pieces off enemies onto the wall, Junk Wall piles more on, and Thrasher throws the whole wall: the bigger it is, the harder it hits. Keep it up to protect everyone, or throw it to end the fight.
characters.ident: A scrap-wrapped thread doll that builds a wall of junk in front of everyone, then picks the whole wall up and throws it.

skills.name: Scrap Slam
skills.desc: Swings the clawed gauntlet loaded with junk for 1.1x. What he rips off goes onto the Junk Wall: +40% of the damage dealt, +5% of his max HP.

skills.name: Junk Wall
skills.desc: Drags every piece of trash in reach into a wall in front of the whole team: +24% of his max HP to the Junk Wall (it holds up to 60%). The wall soaks up half of every enemy hit on ANY hero. He patches himself up for 5% max HP.

skills.name: Thrasher
skills.desc: Needs a Junk Wall of at least 20% of his max HP. He throws the whole wall: the target takes (0.8x + 2.0x times the wall as a share of his max HP) ignoring DEF, so a full wall is 2.0x, and is Marked for 2 turns. Every other enemy takes 40% of that. The wall is gone.

archive: Item FAL-0100 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject collects what is thrown away and does not give it back. Staff are asked not to leave bins unattended within sight of the subject. Ability: Thrasher.

Description: a round dark head scribbled with thread, spiked red-brown hair, one pentagram eye and one blank white eye, and a wide grin of needle teeth. The body is wrapped in black thread and scrap. One arm is a clawed gauntlet covered in purple eyes, the other ends in a spiked horn drill with one more eye. Recorded June 8th 2025.
null

Incident Report: during a routine waste clearance the subject was observed pulling the entire skip onto itself. Collection staff report it was in no hurry. The skip was returned later, in the shape of a wall.
Personnel Note: the eyes in the arm are not the subject's. Staff who have counted them get a different number every time, and all of them are watching the door.
Thrasher: the subject throws the heap. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.

book.abilityPlus: Scrap Slam, Junk Wall, Thrasher; divine ultimate Total Scrap
book.notes: Scrap Heap. Drawn June 8th 2025 (the sheet's ID reads 5519). Tank (Bruiser): scrap and trash manipulation. Scrap (max 5, resets each wave): Scrap Slam 1.1x (+4% per Scrap); Junk Plating gives Guard, +25% DEF (+3% per Scrap), Taunt and 5% healing; Thrasher spends 3 Scrap for a piercing (1.6x + 0.25x per Scrap) hit that Marks the target and splashes 0.5x on the rest. Art: round dark thread-scribbled head, spiky red-brown hair, pentagram eye and blank white eye, needle-tooth grin, thread-wrapped body, clawed gauntlet arm covered in purple eyes and a spiked horn-drill arm. Containment and Threat are my draft. V239 REWORK: the Junk Wall replaces Scrap. A shared pool of HP in front of the whole team (up to 60% of his max HP, resets each wave) that soaks half of every enemy hit on any hero; when knocked down the junk flies back at the attacker. No Taunt. Scrap Slam adds to it, Junk Wall builds it, Thrasher throws it (bigger wall = bigger hit).

characters.name: Flokelore
characters.title: The Second Santa
characters.passive: A pale, ice-blue demon in a red Santa hat with one antler, pointed ears, a skull-like face with burning red X and diamond eyes and a mouth full of red needle teeth, wrapped in a white fur coat with ice-blue frost and a red-eyed belt, with wings of long icicles. Drawn as the Christmas demon of folklore, the one who is always imagined as the second one: the companion who comes with the gift-giver, and who deals with the naughty. Ability: Naughty or Nice. PRESENTS: his heals are wrapped. A Present waits on an ally and opens at the start of their next turn for a big heal, or straight away if they drop below half HP. THE LIST: Naughty List checks what an enemy has done this wave. If it has hurt someone it is Naughty and gets Coal, which bursts on its next turn. If it has not, it is Nice, and an ally gets a Present instead. Silent Night opens every Present and bursts every Coal at once. Its alternate skin is the red-and-white Candy Cane look.
characters.ident: The Christmas demon of folklore, imagined as the second one: wraps gifts that open later, and gives coal to whoever has been naughty.

skills.name: Stocking Stuffer
skills.desc: Wraps a Present for an ally. It heals them 30% max HP, but not now: it opens at the start of their next turn, or straight away if they drop below half HP. Another Present on the same ally makes it bigger (+10%, up to 50%).

skills.name: Naughty List
skills.desc: An icicle wing lashes the target for 1.0x, and he checks the list. NAUGHTY (it has hurt a hero this wave): it gets Coal, which bursts at the start of its next turn for 1.5x and Slows it, and it is Marked for 2 turns. NICE (it has not hurt anyone yet): the most wounded ally gets a Present instead.

skills.name: Silent Night
skills.desc: Needs at least one Present or Coal out. Christmas morning comes early: every Present opens now and every Coal bursts now, all 25% stronger. The whole party loses Slow, Mark and Blur.

archive: Item FAL-0101 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject is known in the old stories as the one who walks beside the gift-giver, and it prefers not to be asked which of them is in charge. Staff are asked to behave. Ability: Naughty or Nice.

Description: a pale, ice-blue figure in a red Santa hat with a single antler, pointed ears, a skull-like face with burning red eyes and a mouth of red needle teeth. A white fur coat edged in frost, a belt with two red eyes, and wings made of long icicles. A second appearance exists in red and white, and the records call it Candy Cane.
null

Incident Report: during a midwinter exercise the subject was left alone with the roster. Every name on it was found marked, in the subject's hand, nice or naughty. Nobody has said which side of the list they ended up on.
Personnel Note: the subject heals the people it likes with small gifts, and the people it does not like with the same gifts. The difference is what is inside. Staff are asked not to open them early.
Silent Night: the subject folds in its wings and the room goes quiet. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.

characters.name: Gutter
characters.title: The Collector
characters.passive: A pale 19-year-old with messy black hair, one narrow, half-lidded eye with a small red pupil that bleeds down his cheek, and one big pink eye with a tumour in it, its red stain spreading across his face. Black jacket over a white shirt and dark tie, a brown belt, ragged fur cuffs on his sleeves, very wide black trousers and pale shoes. Hired by Fal-125 to hunt down entities and targets. Kills on record: 142 humans, 17 entities. He wears masks taken from the people he has killed, and he makes weapons out of the corpses of entities, and the weapons keep what the entity could do. Ability: Human Storage. He opens a pocket dimension with his hands whenever he likes: one portal puts things in, the other takes them out. THE ARSENAL: every enemy he kills goes into storage as a weapon made from it, and the weapon does what that enemy did (one target or all of them, and its Slow, Mark, Burn, Bleed, Venom, Blur, Stun or drain). Storage lasts the whole run; each weapon breaks after 2 uses. Put In finishes off and stores what is nearly dead. Take Out uses the newest weapon. Swallow and Spit opens the putting-in portal in front of the team: the next enemy hit on anyone is swallowed whole, and comes back out at whoever sent it on his next turn.
characters.ident: A hired hunter with a pocket dimension in his hands. Everything he kills becomes a weapon that does what it did.

skills.name: Put In
skills.desc: 1.1x. Anything that dies to Gutter goes into storage as a weapon made from it. A non-boss left under 25% HP is pulled into the portal alive and stored straight away.

skills.name: Take Out
skills.desc: Takes the newest weapon out of storage and uses it: it does what the enemy it was made from did (one target, or every enemy; and its Slow, Mark, Burn, Bleed, Venom, Blur, Stun or drain), at Gutter’s strength. Each weapon breaks after 2 uses.

skills.name: Swallow and Spit
skills.desc: Opens the putting-in portal in front of the whole team for 2 turns. The next enemy hit on ANY hero is swallowed whole and does no damage. At the start of his next turn, it comes out of the other portal at whoever sent it, at the strength it had, ignoring DEF.

archive: Item FAL-0102 is held at Containment Level: Contractor. He is not a subject. He was hired. Fal-125 paid him to hunt down entities and targets, and he is very good at it. Ability: Human Storage.

Description: a pale nineteen-year-old with messy black hair. His left eye is narrow and bleeds without reason. His right eye is pink and swollen with a tumour. He opens a pocket dimension with his hands: one portal puts things in, the other takes them out. Kills on record: humans 142, entities 17.
null

Incident Report: a recovery team reached a containment breach after the contractor had already been through it. They found no entities and no remains. Three weeks later he arrived at a briefing carrying a weapon that slowed whatever it touched. The breach had been a room full of things that slowed whatever they touched.

Personnel Note: he collects masks from the people he kills and keeps them in storage. Staff who have seen inside report a wall of faces, very neatly arranged. He has asked twice whether staff photographs are kept on file. Both times he said he was joking.
Human Storage: the dimension has no limit that anyone has found. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A man in a black jacket is sitting on an upturned crate in the middle of the corridor, eating, with a body at his feet that is slowly being pulled into the palm of his hand.
Something steps out of an empty patch of the tunnel wall, as if out of a coat pocket, and dusts itself off.

characters.name: Marrowline
characters.title: The Cannoneer's Pawn
characters.passive: 6'6, German, and he smells faintly burnt. His head is a cannon: a spiked barrel with slits along the side and a red eye under each slit, a grinning jaw full of teeth underneath it, and a rope fuse hanging down from the back. His right arm is a cannon too. His left arm ends in huge claws, and a red X sits on the star-shaped plate on his chest. Shaggy, dark fur everywhere else. Contained, high difficulty, aggressive. Very little else is known. Ability: Cannoneer's Pawn. The user's body is fused with a cannon for good. Which part depends on the user: some get only the hands, some only the head. At its strongest one blast can level several city blocks. THE FUSE: Powder builds every turn and every time an enemy hits him (each one: +5% damage dealt and +3% taken). Light the Fuse gives the shell 3 turns, and every enemy hit on him burns it down faster. When it runs out, it lands on the Red X target and splashes the rest, harder for every Powder. Use it again to set it off at once. If he falls while it burns, he goes off where he stands.
characters.ident: A man whose head is a cannon. He lights the fuse, waits, and the whole street goes.

skills.name: Light the Fuse
skills.desc: Lights the fuse on his head for 3 turns and puts the Red X on the target. It burns down at the start of his turns, and 1 turn faster for every enemy hit on him. When it runs out the shell lands on the Red X: (0.6 + 0.4 per Powder)x ignoring DEF, and 30% of that on every other enemy. Spends all Powder. Use it again while the fuse burns to SET IT OFF right now.

skills.name: Red X
skills.desc: 1.1x and Marks the target for 2 turns. The Red X moves to it, so a lit shell lands there instead.

skills.name: City Block
skills.desc: Only with 5 Powder. 1.5x to every enemy, ignoring DEF. Spends all Powder and puts out the fuse. The recoil burns him for 12% of his max HP (it never kills him), and he spends his next turn reloading.

archive: Item FAL-0103 is held at Containment Level: High Difficulty. He is aggressive, and the walls of his cell are replaced every month. Ability: Cannoneer's Pawn.

Description: six foot six, German, and he smells faintly burnt at all times. His head is a cannon barrel with slits along the side and eyes under them, and a jaw of teeth beneath it. A fuse hangs from the back of it. His right arm is a second cannon. A red X is set into the plate on his chest. Staff are told not to stand in front of him.
null

Incident Report: during transfer the subject was struck eleven times by the escort team. Each blow made the fuse on his head burn faster. Nobody had lit it. The transfer vehicle and the street it was parked on are listed as total losses. The subject walked back to his cell afterwards on his own.
Personnel Note: besides his ability and that he is aggressive, we know very little about him. He has never said where in Germany he is from. When asked, he points at the fuse.
Cannoneer's Pawn: the cannon fuses with a different part of every user. A full blast from this subject has been estimated at several city blocks. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A containment door at the end of the corridor has been blown off its hinges from the inside. Behind it, something very tall is sitting in the rubble, and the fuse on its head is still smoking.
A wall of the tunnel collapses outward. Something huge steps through the hole it made, brushing ash off its shoulders.

characters.name: Demure
characters.title: Nature's Call
characters.passive: 5'8, and he smells of grass and forest. A brown fur hood around messy brown hair, moss growing over half his face, tired half-closed eyes with red pupils, and a nose that will not stop bleeding. A pendant on a chain, a green jacket, very wide dark green trousers, long pale clawed fingers, and a knife that is never clean. Ability: Nature's Call. When he calls, the season answers. THE FOUR SEASONS: at the start of each of his turns the season moves on, Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter, and round again. Every wave starts in Spring. His Knife and Nature's Call do something different in each season (Spring heals him, Summer hits hardest, Autumn bleeds and rots, Winter slows), and Out of Season skips one. His card shows this season and the next.
characters.ident: A tired boy with moss on his face and a bloody knife. When he calls, the season answers, and it changes every turn.

skills.name: Knife
skills.desc: Changes with the season. Spring: 1.0x and he heals 30% of the damage. Summer: 1.45x. Autumn: 1.0x and Bleeding for 3 turns. Winter: 1.0x and Slowed for 2 turns.

skills.name: Nature’s Call
skills.desc: Brings the season down on every enemy. Spring: 0.6x and roots the strongest enemy (Stunned; a boss is Slowed). Summer: 0.9x and Burning for 2 turns. Autumn: 0.6x and Rotting for 2 turns (takes 25% more damage). Winter: 0.6x and Slowed for 2 turns.

skills.name: Out of Season
skills.desc: 0.8x, and the season jumps one step on right now (Winter to Spring, and so on). Next turn it moves on again as usual, so this skips a season.

archive: Item FAL-0104 is held at Containment Level: Moderate. He is quiet and does what he is told until the season turns. Ability: Nature's Call.

Description: five foot eight. He smells of grass and forest even after months underground. Moss grows over half his face and returns within a day of removal. His nose bleeds constantly. He keeps a knife; nobody can say where he gets them.
null

Incident Report: the climate control in his wing failed for one hour. In that hour it was Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter in the corridor outside his cell, in that order. Two guards were treated for frostbite, one for sunstroke. The cell itself was full of fresh grass.
Personnel Note: he asks the date every morning and does not believe the answer. Staff are told not to argue. He is usually right about the season, whatever the calendar says.
Nature's Call: what answers him is not weather. Weather does not follow anybody. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: Moss has grown over the floor of an empty observation cell, wall to wall, in a facility with no windows. In the middle of it a boy in a fur hood is sitting with his knees up, cleaning a knife.

characters.name: Caspic
characters.title: Ability Canceller
characters.passive: 17. Messy black hair with a torn blue cloth over one side of his face, one big eye with a blue pupil, and blood across his cheeks that is not always his. A blue scarf, a black jacket with blue armoured shoulders crossed with straps, a red shirt, a belt, light blue jeans and black-and-white sneakers. Six glowing purple disks are fixed to his shoulders: he took them from #4, and stole more ability disks from the corpses. His arms were reattached from #2 and partly #24, and they do not match: one is pale with long white claws, the other dark red and shaggy. Ability: Ability Canceller. Abilities used against him simply stop working. THE DISKS: any bad status an enemy tries to put on him is cancelled before it lands. He heals by undoing what the enemy did to his team: every bad status he removes or cancels heals and gives him a Disk (max 6), and Null Field spends them all to clean, heal and ward the whole team.
characters.ident: A 17-year-old with stolen ability disks and borrowed arms. Whatever the enemy puts on you, he takes off.

skills.name: Cancel Wounds
skills.desc: Heals one ally 20% max HP and removes every bad status on them (Slow, Marked, Irradiated, Burning, Stunned, Soaked, Blurred, Venom, Frostbite, Sporing, Bleeding). Each one removed heals them 5% max HP more and gives Caspic a Disk.

skills.name: Hard Cancel
skills.desc: 0.8x, and cancels that enemy’s abilities for its next turn: no bad status it tries to put on your team lands, and no buff it tries to give its own side lands. Every one it cancels gives Caspic a Disk.

skills.name: Null Field
skills.desc: Spends all Disks. Removes every bad status from the whole team (each one still heals and gives a Disk back), heals everyone 10% max HP plus 3% per Disk spent, and puts a Disk Ward on everyone: the next bad status an enemy tries to put on them is cancelled.

archive: Item FAL-0105 is held at Containment Level: High. He is seventeen, and every containment measure used on him so far has been switched off by his ability. The current measure is a locked door. Ability: Ability Canceller.

characters.name: Soundemon
characters.title: Sound Demon
characters.passive: The winner of Hide and Bleed, as Player 9. Long black hair, a white face with a black band across one eye and a red eye on the other, and blood that has dried in long runs down his face, his white hoodie and his long arms. A red tag on his chest says 9. A blue armband on his arm says 2: after the game ended he killed Player 2, his partner in the final, and kept it. Ability: Sound Demon. He can create anything out of sound (bursts, weapons, things that walk), and anything with sound is his to control. THINGS MADE OF SOUND: Sound Weapon makes a Noise Blade that cuts the weakest enemy, Sound Entity makes a Shrieker that Blurs every enemy. He can have 2 at once; they act at the start of each of his turns and last 3 of his turns. Burst makes them all fire again. Every enemy he or they kill keeps the noise going: everything he made lasts 1 turn longer.
characters.ident: The winner of Hide and Bleed. He makes weapons and things out of sound, and they keep fighting after he stops.

skills.desc: 0.8x now, and he makes a Noise Blade out of sound. It lasts 3 of his turns and, at the start of each of his turns, cuts the weakest enemy for 0.5x. He can have 2 things made of sound at once (a third replaces the oldest).

skills.name: Sound Entity

skills.name: Burst
skills.desc: 1.0x on the target, and every thing he has made of sound fires once more right now (they do not lose a turn).

characters.name: Slinder
characters.title: Bloodmaker
characters.passive: 19, five foot seven. A round white face like a mask, two empty black eyes and a stitched zigzag mouth, wild red hair all around his head, a red zip-up hoodie with a purple hood, dark trousers, and hands that drip into red blood claws. He won Mimic Ball, where seventeen died and one walked out. Ability: Bloodmaker. He makes weapons and items out of blood. His own blood makes the strongest ones, but anyone's will do. BLOOD: Blood Claws makes enemies Bleed. Blood Blade costs his own HP and hits harder the less he has left. Harvest pulls the blood back out of every Bleeding enemy, heals him, and makes his next Blade free. Bleeding enemies take +10% from him.
characters.ident: He makes weapons out of blood. His own makes the best ones, so he spends it.

skills.name: Blood Claws
skills.desc: 0.9x, and the target Bleeds for 3 turns. Bleeding enemies take +10% from him, and Harvest pulls the blood back out.

skills.name: Blood Blade
skills.desc: Costs 12% of his max HP (never below 1). (1.5 + 1.0 x the share of HP he is missing)x, ignoring DEF. If he has Harvested since his last Blade, it is made from their blood instead and costs nothing.

skills.name: Harvest
skills.desc: Pulls the blood out of every Bleeding enemy: 0.5x plus 0.1x for each Bleed turn left, and the Bleed ends. He heals 6% max HP for each one, and his next Blood Blade is free.

characters.name: Luckster
characters.title: Rabbit's Luck
characters.passive: 27, six foot three. A shaggy black head under a white fur hood with long floppy rabbit ears, red on the inside, one big round eye and one small red one, a wide grin full of teeth, and part of his chin missing: he lost it winning Fade Bite. A blue scarf, a bulky purple jacket, dark brown trousers, and pale clawed hands and feet. Ability: Rabbit's Luck. Somehow he always gets what he wants, in a way that is very random yet effective. LUCK: every move rolls, but the roll leans towards what the team needs right now: a big heal when someone is low, a cleanse when they are covered in statuses, a shield or more ATK when everyone is fine, and sometimes an enemy just trips. 15% of enemy hits aimed at him somehow miss.
characters.ident: Nothing he does should work. It always does.

skills.name: Lucky Break
skills.desc: One ally. Always heals 8% max HP, then rolls one more thing, and the roll leans towards what they need: a big heal, a cleanse, a shield, more ATK, or an enemy that just trips over its own feet.

skills.name: Rabbit’s Foot
skills.desc: The whole team. Everyone heals 5% max HP, then one roll for everyone, leaning towards what the team needs most: a heal, a cleanse, a shield, more ATK, or an enemy trips.

skills.name: Jackpot
skills.desc: Three Lucky Breaks on whoever needs them most. And a 12% chance of the JACKPOT: the whole team heals 30% max HP and every bad status is gone.

characters.name: Punchline
characters.title: Absolute Joke
characters.passive: 26, about five foot ten, nationality unknown. Wild teal hair, huge bloodshot eyes (one blue pupil, one red), a stitched grin with far too many teeth, a white straitjacket held shut with brown straps, long clawed fingers, blue jeans and black boots. Ability: Absolute Joke. Anything he finds funny happens. He does not know he has it: it works passively, and he never finds out, which is what keeps it hidden. THE JOKE: his moves are plain, but funny things keep happening to enemies near him: they slip, punch each other or take a pie to the face. When an enemy is Stunned, Slowed or Blurred he finds it funny, and something else might happen to it. The log always calls it a coincidence.
characters.ident: He tells terrible jokes. Somehow, the world always plays along.

skills.name: Tell a Joke
skills.desc: 0.95x. He laughs at his own joke half the time, and when he does, something funny tends to happen to the target: it slips (Stunned; a boss is Slowed), punches the enemy next to it, or gets a pie in the face (Blurred 2 turns). Pure coincidence, of course.

skills.name: Big Laugh
skills.desc: 0.5x to every enemy. He laughs at the whole room, and each enemy has a 35% chance of something funny happening to it.

skills.name: Slapstick
skills.desc: 1.2x, and 60% harder if something funny has already happened to the target this wave.

characters.passive: Eight foot two and 202 kg, age unknown. A hulking two-legged thing with a huge round white head like a bloodshot eye, red veins running across it, split by a grin of far too many teeth. Two long curved scythes, banded red and white, sweep down from the sides of its head. Its body is dark grey spiked armour with red chevrons, a ragged fur collar, heavy fists and clawed feet with a red mark on each knee. Ability: Absorb. characters.ident: Eight feet of mouths. Whatever hits it, it keeps.

characters.name: Tangler
characters.title: Stringy Body
characters.passive: A big, heavy red-and-white thing sewn together out of string: a round head split down the middle by a seam, half red and half white, with dark slit eyes and a wide grey mouth of square teeth. The body and two thick legs are wound in red and white stripes like rope, stitched everywhere, with grey patches, spikes of thread sticking out of its sides and long claws of loose string at the end of each arm. Drawn August 17th 2025; its old 2021 design was a smiling stickman. Ability: Stringy Body. Its body can be moulded into string, and it has full control over it. STRING: Stitch Up sews an ally's wounds shut (a heal and +DEF). Tether ties a string from Tangler to an ally: while they are tied, 30% of the damage they take runs down the string to Tangler instead. Tangle wraps an enemy and Slows it, and the loose thread patches up the most hurt ally. Its body comes apart into string: the first big hit it takes each wave only does half damage.
characters.ident: A body of red string. It ties itself to you and takes the hits.

skills.desc: One ally. Tangler sews their wounds shut with its own string: heals 25% max HP and +30% DEF for 2 turns.

skills.name: Tangle
skills.desc: 0.7x, and the enemy is wrapped in string and Slowed for 2 turns. The loose thread heals the most hurt ally 10% max HP.

characters.name: Bearable
characters.title: Ticking Clock
characters.passive: Five foot nine and 50.3 kg. A scruffy plush thing with a big mop of shaggy brown hair, one eye ringed in blue with a purple pupil and one yellow eye with a red ring, a stitched frown, and fur scribbled in orange, yellow and red that hangs off its arms like flames. It wears orange dungarees with a stitched X patch, has huge dark grey-green feet, a blue band on one arm, and a golden wind-up key sticking out of its back. Its signature item is a long red-and-white striped blade. Drawn June 19th 2025; its old 2021 design was a black, red-eyed face. Ability: Ticking Clock. Its mind is a ticking clock, and each tick is an increase in the amount of storage for an attack. The more it uses, the more gets taken off. THE CLOCK: it gains 1 tick at the start of every one of its turns (up to 12). Wind Down spends every tick on one big heal, Tick heals the team a little and winds the clock 2 more, and Alarm spends every tick on one big hit that ignores DEF, but costs Bearable 2% of its own max HP for each tick. At 12 ticks it is MIDNIGHT: Wind Down also cleans every bad status off the ally.
characters.ident: Every tick is stored. Every tick comes out.

skills.desc: One ally. Spends every tick on the clock: heals 18% max HP plus 4% for every tick, and +25% DEF for 2 turns. At 12 ticks it is MIDNIGHT, and it also cleans every bad status off them.

skills.name: Tick
skills.desc: The whole team heals 15% max HP, and the clock winds 2 more ticks (up to 12).

skills.desc: Spends every tick on one hit: (0.6 + 0.15 per tick)x, ignoring DEF. The more it uses, the more gets taken off: Bearable loses 2% of its max HP for each tick (never below 1).
