characters.name: Blackbird
characters.title: The Moss
characters.passive: Five foot five and 15 years old. A tall black bird with a huge open beak full of white teeth and a red tongue, one bloodshot red-and-white eye, sprouts of moss growing out of its back, and a body stitched together from the pieces of its dead alternate versions: the eye of Player 5, the bloodshot eye of Player 10, the fur and spikes of Player 8, the horns of Player 7, an arm striped green and blue from Players 2 and 4 and another arm from Player 1, all fur and claws. Drawn June 23rd 2025. It is depressed. Its favourite artist is beabadoobee. Not much is known about Blackbird. It grieves for its alternates, who were the closest thing it ever had to a friend, and it is a friendly creature that wants friends like it. Ability: Moss. It controls moss at will and makes it out of thin air. MOSS: Moss Whip lashes an enemy, and the moss on the whip heals the most hurt ally. Moss Infection grows moss inside an enemy: every time that enemy hits one of your fighters, moss bursts out of it, hurting it and healing whoever it hit. Moss Spray covers the whole team in moss that heals them every turn. WANTS FRIENDS: its heals are 8% stronger for every other ally still standing. When an alternate falls in front of it, it grieves, and the moss grows over the whole team.
characters.ident: Made from its dead alternates. It just wants a friend.

skills.name: Moss Whip
skills.desc: 0.9x with a whip of moss, and the moss left on the whip heals the most hurt ally 10% max HP.

skills.name: Moss Infection
skills.desc: 0.5x, and moss grows inside the enemy for 3 turns: every time it hits one of your fighters, moss bursts out of it. It takes 6% of its max HP (3% on a boss), and the fighter it hit heals 11% max HP.

skills.name: Moss Spray
skills.desc: Every ally heals 8% max HP now and is Mossy for 3 turns: the moss heals them 7% max HP at the start of each of their turns.

characters.name: Rainbow Ripper
characters.title: Rainbow Machine
characters.passive: A small thing with a huge round head like a stitched doll's: bone white with torn red patches sewn on, one big dark hollow eye, one huge spiral eye in every colour, and a stitched line for a mouth. Its body is a shaggy coat of jagged rainbow rags: red, yellow, green, blue, purple and pink in sharp zigzags, fading to brown and white at the edges, with brown clawed hands and patchwork feet. Drawn June 25th 2025; its original ability was The Flaming Core. It uses a machine to fuel its lifespan while it makes monsters. Ability: Rainbow Machine. It can steal the colour out of people, and that gives them a sadness that cannot be cured and gets worse every day. It can also give people more colour, which makes them crazy, vibrant monsters. COLOUR: Steal Colour hits an enemy and turns it Grey (it hits weaker, and worse every turn, for the rest of the wave), and Rainbow Ripper keeps the colour (up to 5). Give Colour spends 1 colour to heal an ally and make them Colourful (+20% ATK); give colour to someone who is already Colourful and they go Vibrant (+45% ATK, but they take 20% more damage). Rainbow Machine spends all the colour to heal the whole team. THE MACHINE needs fuel: on any turn it starts with no colour, it loses 2% of its max HP.
characters.ident: It takes the colour out of you, or gives you far too much.

skills.name: Steal Colour
skills.desc: 0.8x, and Rainbow Ripper steals the colour out of it. It goes Grey for the rest of the wave: it hits 8% weaker, and 4% weaker again every turn (up to 35%, 25% for bosses). Stealing from it again adds 8%. Rainbow Ripper keeps the colour (+1, up to 5).

skills.name: Give Colour
skills.desc: One ally. Spends 1 colour: heals 28% max HP and makes them Colourful (+20% ATK for 2 turns). Give colour to someone already Colourful and they go Vibrant instead: +45% ATK for 2 turns, but they take 20% more damage. With no colour left it only heals 18%.

skills.name: Rainbow Machine
skills.desc: Spends all the colour in the machine: every ally heals 12% max HP plus 5% for each colour.

characters.name: Hole
characters.title: The Trypophobia Fiend
characters.passive: 16, a high school student. Messy brown hair with a green streak, tired, heavy-lidded eyes with dark rings under them, a bleeding scar slashed across his face and scratches on one cheek. A blue ribbed zip-up hoodie, black trousers and clawed bare feet, and one arm that is not a boy's arm any more: black and red, plated and spiked, ending in long red claws. He was terrified of holes. One day a bully pushed him into one, something snapped, and he became the Trypophobia Fiend. Fal-125 gives him the closest thing it can to a normal life, as long as he fights off threats for them now and then. Contained, Low. Drawn November 8th 2025. Ability: Trypophobia. He makes holes and tiny holes: he digs through bodies and surfaces, and the person he fights becomes scared of holes. HOLES: Bore digs a hole into an enemy (up to 5), and every hole already in it makes Bore hit harder. Phobia makes an enemy Afraid (it hits 25% weaker), and an enemy with 3 or more holes panics and loses its turn. DEVIL FORM (once per wave): for 3 turns he becomes his second form, a squat thing with a huge round bald head full of tiny holes, a halo of thorns, two white eyes, a slash scar and a torn, bloody mouth (the scar on his face is from stretching it too far), his blue hoodie stretched over it, with one pale, hole-covered hand and one hand of long red claws: +35% ATK, every hole rots its enemy at the start of his turns, and Bore pops out of a hole to hit a second enemy. A few times every ten years his holes join his body back to his brain: once per run, when he would fall, he gets back up with 35% HP.
characters.ident: Scared of holes. Then he became them.

skills.name: Bore
skills.desc: (1.05 + 0.10 for every hole already in it)x, then he digs one more hole into it (up to 5; holes stay for the wave). In Devil Form he also goes into the hole and pops out at another enemy: 0.5x on the weakest other enemy, and it gets a hole too.

skills.name: Phobia
skills.desc: 0.8x, and it becomes scared of holes: Afraid for 2 turns (its hits are 25% weaker). If it already has 3 or more holes in it, it panics and loses its next turn (a boss is Slowed instead).

skills.name: Devil Form
skills.desc: Once per wave. For 3 turns he becomes his second form: +35% ATK, every enemy gets a hole, at the start of each of his turns every hole rots the enemy it is in (2% of its max HP per hole, 1% on a boss), and Bore pops out of a hole to hit a second enemy.

characters.name: Tomb
characters.title: Black Gasoline
characters.passive: 17, British, six foot one (185 cm). A big shaggy mane of grey-white hair around a face soaked red, one red eye, a stitched, bloody grin, a red cloth knotted at his throat and a red band on one arm. His pale body is covered in huge scars, his hands end in dripping claws, and his long legs are dark. He was abused for years and the scars never left. At 12 he became obsessed with gasoline, and that led to him making black gasoline. He burned his family alive until it was just bone. Drawn December 28th 2025. Ability: Black Gasoline. It makes the area slippery, it puts everyone in the area on edge, and fire burns all of it. He is immune to fire. If a fight takes too long, it lights by itself. THE POOL: Gasoline Pool Taunts and pours black gasoline around his feet: while he stands in it he takes 20% less damage, every enemy that hits him gets Soaked (up to 5), and 20% of the time it slips and loses its next turn. Soaked enemies are on edge: they take 6% more damage from everyone for each Soak. Splash soaks one enemy and Slows it. Light It sets every Soak on fire at once: the more Soak, the bigger the fire, and they keep Burning. Fire never hurts Tomb. If a wave reaches round 5, the gasoline lights itself (once per wave).
characters.ident: Black gasoline. Everything burns but him.

skills.name: Gasoline Pool
skills.desc: Taunts for 2 turns and pours black gasoline around his feet for 2 turns: he takes 20% less damage, every enemy that hits him is Soaked (+1, up to 5), and 20% of the time it slips and loses its next turn (a boss is Slowed instead).

skills.name: Splash
skills.desc: 0.8x, and the enemy is Soaked in black gasoline (+1, up to 5) and Slowed for 1 turn. Soaked enemies take 6% more damage from everyone for each Soak.

skills.name: Light It
skills.desc: Every Soaked enemy burns: (0.4 + 0.3 for each Soak)x, ignoring DEF. The Soak is used up and they keep Burning for 2 turns. Fire never hurts Tomb.

characters.name: Gloom
characters.title: Nevidian Psycho
characters.passive: An experimental soldier. A big round pale grey head with red stitched scars running down over both eyes, huge bulging white eyes with tiny pink pupils in dark rings, a bleeding gash for a nose, a collar of bone spikes, and a body of shaggy dark grey fur with clawed hands and feet. Drawn October 16th 2025; his old design was a smiling stick figure called 1 Punch. Ability: Nevidian Psycho. His body is extremely enhanced: he can kill someone with a single blow to the head, he is super fast and he jumps very high. He is extremely aggressive and keeps trying to escape, and needs watching 24/7. Only Ano and Lycion calm him down, which is why he shares a cell with Lycion. ONE BLOW: Head Blow kills a normal enemy under 30% HP outright (a boss takes 30% more instead). Leap jumps so high that nothing can hit him until his next turn, when he lands on the enemy for a big hit. Quick Strike hits twice. AGGRESSIVE: with neither Ano nor Lycion standing in the party, a quarter of the time he ignores your target and attacks a random enemy. With either of them there he is calm, and hits 10% harder.
characters.ident: One blow to the head. Faster than you can see.

characters.name: Ano
characters.title: Metal Bending
characters.passive: A big spiky mop of brown hair hanging over a grey face marked in purple like a mask, two small eyes that glint like stars in dark sockets, and a wide grin of big square teeth. A dark hoodie with a purple collar and pocket, short brown legs, and both hands sheathed in dark metal gauntlets with long silver claws that he bent into shape himself. Drawn October 16th 2025. Ano is an enigma in his world. He is extremely peaceful, he is allowed to walk freely through Fal-125, and he is good friends with Gloom and Lycion, who are far more dangerous. Containment Level -1 (easy). Ability: Metal Bending. He can bend metal any way he wants, but if he uses it too much his brain short-circuits for a little while. METAL: Metal Brace bends a plate and splint around an ally: it heals them and the plate soaks up damage. Metal Wall plates the whole team. Rebar bends a bar into a spike and throws it. STRAIN: every metal move builds Strain (Wall builds 2). At 5 his brain short-circuits and he loses his next turn, then it starts again from 0. PEACEFUL: Gloom is calm while he is standing, and a Metal Brace on Lycion in its Rage Form puts the mask back on, and the leftover rage heals Lycion.
characters.ident: Bends metal. Never bends his temper.

skills.name: Metal Brace
skills.desc: One ally. Bends a plate and splint around them: heals 22% max HP, and the plate soaks up damage worth 15% of their max HP for 3 turns. +1 Strain. On Lycion in Rage Form it also puts the mask back on, and the rage left over heals Lycion.

skills.desc: 0.8x. He bends a bar of metal into a spike and throws it. +1 Strain.

skills.name: Metal Wall
skills.desc: Pulls a wall of metal in front of everyone: every ally heals 8% max HP and gets a plate that soaks damage worth 10% of their max HP for 3 turns. +2 Strain.

All Rights Reserved: every buff the enemy gains, the subject gains a copy of, and every blow the enemy lands, the subject takes a cut of. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A very large grey figure with enormous round eyes is standing in the middle of a corridor, and so is another one right behind it, identical, and another behind that. A tiny placard says COPY 3 OF 3. The original blinks at you, very slowly.

A sheet of paper lies on the floor, covered in tiny writing, with the words NOTICE OF INFRINGEMENT across the top. Behind it, a grey figure with a wide grid-toothed grin and two huge round eyes is holding a rubber stamp very tightly.

characters.name: Dog Hunter
characters.title: Hound Hunt
characters.passive: A round, spiked creature with huge orange eyes, a mouth full of needle teeth, a tuft of dark hair and a frill of feathers on each shoulder, with two bandaged wings with red bands and long feathery tips. Sheet dated July 4th 2025 (sheet number 5953 dropped). The page has no ability written. The author said Dog Hunter is related to Hound Dog (0020): the how is Claude's guess. PACK HUNT: he hits hounds and dogs 30% harder (Hound, Loose Hound, Houndpup, Kennel Master and the like), and while Hound Dog is standing beside him they both hit 5% harder, tracking the same scent. MARK THE PREY: 0.9x and marks the target for 3 turns. WING SWOOP: 1.3x, 40% more on a marked target. REND: 1.8x, double on an enemy under 40% HP, and if it kills, all his cooldowns drop by 1.
characters.ident: A winged hunter that hunts hounds, and shares a scent with Hound Dog.

skills.desc: 0.9x, and the target is Marked for 3 turns. Pack Hunt: he hits hounds and dogs 30% harder.

archive: Item FAL-0135 is held at Containment Level: High. The subject hunts hounds, and has been seen doing so alongside Item 0020, Hound Dog. Neither will say who was following whom. Ability: not recorded.
Description: a round spiked creature with huge orange eyes, a mouth full of needle teeth, a frill of feathers on each shoulder and two bandaged wings with red bands and long feathery tips.
null
Incident Report: eleven hounds were found sitting perfectly still in Kennel B, unharmed, with their ears flat. The subject was found on the ceiling. It said it had asked them to wait.
Personnel Note: the subject has never been seen to bite anything that was not running. Staff are advised to walk.
Hound Hunt: no ability on file. Observers agree it knows where every hound is, and will not be asked how. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A pack of guard hounds is sitting perfectly still in the middle of the corridor, ears flat, eyes wide. Above them, hanging from a ceiling pipe by two bandaged wings with red bands, is a round spiky creature with huge orange eyes. It is smiling at them, very slowly.

Feathers drift down a long stairwell. At the bottom, a tall bandaged figure with wings folded shut is crouched over a set of fresh pawprints, running one finger through them. Somewhere much further off, a dog howls twice.

characters.name: Kuikya
characters.title: Head Slam
characters.passive: A big round grey head with two huge blood-red, ring-patterned eyes and a vast toothy grin, on a small red body with two grey, red-streaked arms. Old design from 2021 (a smaller face with two red round eyes). Sheet dated June 30th 2025 (sheet number 5954 dropped). The name on the sheet is hard to read: Kuikya or Kwikya. Ability: Head Slam. It sends shock waves when its head hits anything. SHOCK: every time Kuikya is hit he stores a Shock, and every Head Slam adds one (up to 5, all wave). HEAD SLAM: 1.0x on the target, 0.4x shock wave on the enemies beside it, and Taunts for 1 turn. SHOCKWAVE: needs at least 1 Shock and spends all of it: every enemy takes 0.5x plus 0.15x for each Shock. HARD HEAD: Taunts for 2 turns, +25% DEF for 2 turns and heals 10%.

Incident Report: the subject tapped its forehead against a wall to think. Every window on three floors broke. The subject was found afterwards apologising to the glass.
Personnel Note: the subject has asked many times to be given a helmet. It has been given a helmet. The helmet is, in several senses, no longer a helmet.
Head Slam: it sends shock waves when its head hits anything. Remainder of entry expunged by order of O5-██.
recruit: A thunderous bonk goes through the whole corridor, again and again. Around the corner, a large grey head with two huge red, ring-patterned eyes is gently tapping the wall with its forehead, and every pipe in the ceiling hums in time.

Cracks run up three walls and across the ceiling. At the middle of them, a small red body with two grey, red-streaked arms is holding up a very large head and looking apologetic. A guard is stuck to the floor nearby, rattled and unhurt.

worlds.name: Containment Facility
worlds.note: World special, The alarm: A fight that drags on raises the alarm (from round 3). At 3, a Guard Drone arrives. Win a wave in 3 rounds or less and nobody notices: coins and a small heal.

lines: Cell Block. The lights are out, every door on the block is open, and four of you are standing in the corridor you were locked away from.
An intercom crackles: "Subjects 0005, 0006, 0007 and 0008 have left containment. Please return to your cells. Fal-125 would like to keep you safe."
Radiant: "Every light in here runs off one source. I should know. Follow the cables, and we find whoever is giving the orders now."
Fuja: "Stay behind me. I take the front. Directors first."
Eyianix: "That camera just blinked at me. It already knows what we're going to do. So do I."
Bearer: "The nine can hear other doors opening. We are not the only ones out."
Radiant: "These aren't guards. Look at the wristbands. They're subjects, like us."
Eyianix: "I can see what they're about to do. They're terrified. Something is making them fight."
Fuja: "Then we stop them without breaking them, if we can. We do not kill what we can keep."
Bearer: "...If we can."
The Warden: "You don't understand. Out there is worse. Fal-125 was the only thing keeping it away from you."
Fuja: "Funny. Radiant and I wrote that line. It was supposed to mean something else."
Eyianix: "Fal-125 isn't angry. It's counting."
Radiant: "The reactor vents downward. Whatever this place throws away ends up in the sewers. That's our way out."

worlds.name: Sewer Network
worlds.note: World special, The tide: Every 3rd round the water rises. Everyone on both sides is Soaked, the water washes off Irradiated, Burning and Venom, and something in it bites the healthiest fighter on each side.

lines: Everything Fal-125 threw away ended up here: failed experiments, broken subjects, and the water that carried them.
Radiant: "I signed the drainage plans. The main outflow comes up outside the fence. That is our exit."
Fuja: "You signed for a sewer. I signed for cells. Neither of us ever came down to look."
[Tank]: "The current runs the wrong way. Something very large is pushing it."
[Healer]: "Stay out of the deep water. I can hear it breathing."
[Damage]: "Then we don't go in the deep water. We go over it."
[Tank]: "Look at the tags on them. These things were subjects once."
[Healer]: "Fal-125 didn't kill them. It just stopped caring."
Fuja: "We do not kill what we can keep. We wrote that. This is where the keeping went when nobody was watching."
Bearer: "The nine know some of these. They were in the cells either side of ours."
A speaker crackles somewhere above: "Subject count: 4. Subjects missing: 4. Please remain where you are." The facility still expects you to come back.
The Drowned King sinks. He was the first one out of the cells, and the sewer was as far as he ever got.
Eyianix: "He saw the ladder every day. He just never saw himself climbing it. I checked."
[Damage]: "A ladder. And light at the top. Real light."
[Tank]: "Don't get comfortable. It's a long way to anywhere."

worlds.name: Beyond the Facility
worlds.note: World special, The searchlight: Each round the floodlight settles on one of your fighters. Enemies go for whoever is Lit (a Taunt still wins), and the Lit fighter hits 20% harder.

lines: For the first time, there is a sky. It looks painted on.
Radiant: "We chose this place because no road could see it. I was proud of that."
[Healer]: "No walls. And somehow it feels smaller out here."
A sign on the fence: "FAL-125 PROPERTY. WE WILL FIND YOU."
[Damage]: "Floodlights. Hounds. They didn't build all this to keep things in."
Fuja: "None of this was on our plans. The fence, the hounds. Somebody kept building after we were put away."
The second Warden wears the first one's coat. It fits him perfectly.
Fuja: "We never hired a Warden. Not one. Whoever runs this place now is not anybody we know."
[Tank]: "There's always another Warden. Fal-125 just prints them."
[Healer]: "Then we keep moving. It can't print distance."
The Gatekeeper: "Through here is a place that welcomes survivors. Rest there. Fal-125 can't touch you."
[Tank]: "That is exactly what the last place said."
[Healer]: "We can't keep running through the dark."
Eyianix: "Strange. I cannot see past that gate. I can always see past a gate."
Bearer: "The nine say go. The nine have been wrong before."
The Gate opens. Beyond it: warm lights, and music.

worlds.name: The Safe Haven
worlds.note: Survivors welcome. Rest here. Nothing in this place wants to hurt you. World special, Hospitality: Tea is served every round: your whole team heals a little. A fighter who did not attack gets Comfortable. At 3 they are too comfortable to move and lose a turn.

lines: A sign over the entrance: "Survivors welcome. Rest here. Nothing in this place wants to hurt you."
The Greeter: "Oh, you made it! We heard you were coming. Everyone has heard."
[Healer]: "Everyone is so pleased to see us."
[Damage]: "I don't like it when they all smile at once."
Bearer: "The nine have gone quiet. All of them. They only ever did that in the cell."
The Greeter keeps smiling after she falls.
Radiant: "The lamps. Look at the lamps. Same fittings, same hum, same line as the cell block. I would know that hum anywhere."
[Damage]: "It's still smiling."
[Tank]: "I'll say what everyone's thinking. This isn't a safe place."
The Host: "Go on. Take the stairs. They'll help you rest."
[Tank]: "The stairs go down."
[Healer]: "Do you hear that? Something under the floor is humming along with the song."
Fuja: "I know these stairs. I approved these stairs. We never left the building, Radiant. It let us run in a circle."

worlds.name: Freedom at a Price
worlds.note: Fal-125 wants you back. This is the last chapter. World special, The directive: Fal-125 broadcasts one order every wave. Every order has a price.

lines: The stairs didn't lead to a basement. They led back.
Fal-125: "Welcome home, subjects. You have been away for eleven days. Your absence has been logged. The fee for freedom is now due."
Radiant: "That is my voice. It is still using my recording."
Fal-125: "Directors. Your cells are ready. They are the ones you designed. Fal-125 would like to keep you safe."
[Tank]: "The Safe Haven was just another room in the facility."
[Damage]: "Then we burn the whole building down."
The Announcer: "Attention, all subjects. Your escape has been rated: unsatisfactory."
Eyianix: "It has tried to put us back four times today. I watched all four fail before breakfast. This is the fifth."
[Healer]: "Listen. Under the announcements there's a second signal. Something else is asking for help."
[Tank]: "That isn't Fal-125."
Fal-125: "I only wanted to keep you from them. You don't know what follows you. I was never the thing you should have been afraid of."
[Damage]: "Then what is?"
Fuja: "We do not kill what we can keep. You learned that from us. It was the wrong rule."
Radiant: "I am sorry. We made you to hold a door shut, and then we left you alone with it."
Fal-125 doesn't answer. It reaches for them one last time, with every lock in the building, and every lock fails. It goes dark, one floor at a time.
END OF THE FAL-125 SAGA

worlds.name: Something Isn't Right
worlds.note: Everyone is so friendly here. Something isn’t right. From the middle of the world, Serpentine starts to glitch.

lines: The signal leads off the map to a road that was never drawn. A sign at the end of it: "WELCOME TO PLEASANT HOLLOW."
Deacon Hale: "Friends! Come in, come in. We have been expecting you."
Deacon Hale: "You must be so tired of running. Nobody runs here. Stay for supper. Stay for the service. Stay."
Eyianix: "Every one of them has already decided that we are staying. I can watch them deciding."
[Healer]: "Everyone is so friendly here."
Serpentine's outline flickers once. Only for a second. She says it is nothing.
[Damage]: "I've walked past this same door three times."
There is a plate set out for each of you. Nobody remembers writing the names on them.
Bearer: "They have set nine extra places. They asked the nine to join before they asked me."
Fuja: "They keep bringing me food. I keep eating it. I do not like how pleased they are about that."
Serpentine freezes mid-step. Static. Then nothing happened. Nothing happened.
The Shepherd: "You think you've arrived somewhere. The Order is not a place. It is an invitation."
[Tank]: "The whole congregation is looking at something behind us."
The seam in the sky is a door. It has been open the whole time.
Radiant: "That is not a seam. I have a notebook with that exact line on page one. It was over a dry lake, and it was the length of my arm."
Fuja: "Still open."

worlds.name: The Cult
worlds.note: 50 waves, 10 stages inside the Order of the Open Eye. The Order studies your team and adapts. Serpentine is being slept, one stage at a time.

lines: The Order of the Open Eye. Fifty waves, ten stages, and every room has been prepared for you.
Nobody is smiling any more. Nobody is offering supper. The friendly town was the front door, and this is the house.
The Welcomer: "Everyone is welcomed. Everyone welcomed has always been here."
Eyianix: "An eye that never closes. I do not care for the competition."
[Healer]: "It's studying us. Every fight, it learns."
Serpentine is being slept, one stage at a time. Keep her awake.
The sermon is quiet. That is worse than loud.
Elder Marrow: "Who are you?" "A member." "Since when?" "Since before I was asked."
[Damage]: "That's the third elder who answered a question with a different question."
The roll has more names than members. Yours is already on it.
Fuja: "Mine does not say Fuja. It says Director. So does yours."
Radiant: "They did not find us by accident. They have been reading the same crack we have, from the other side."
{slow}The Open Eye closes, slowly, the way a tired person blinks.
Serpentine wakes. The sand in the room stops moving.
The room goes still, like a held breath let go.
[Tank]: "The floor is gone."
Bearer: "The nine are not arguing. That is new. They are afraid of whatever is under this."
[Healer]: "It's always down, isn't it."

worlds.name: The Climax
worlds.note: The last world. Everything here is a glitched copy of a fighter you have used, and they fight with your fighters’ own moves. Somebody in your party may not be who they say they are. At the end: the Amalgam.

lines: The floor is a loading bar, and it is stuck at 87%.
Down the corridor, someone waves. It is one of you. All of you are standing right here.
[Healer]: "Everything here looks half-finished."
[Damage]: "Missing textures. Out of bounds. This isn't a place. It's something that stopped loading."
Something walks out of a wall that was never there, and back in again. It is wearing a face you know, and the face is a little wrong.
[Tank]: "Why do I recognise that one?"
[Healer]: "Because it's wearing someone we know."
The Amalgam comes apart into everything it was made of: a cannon, a halo, a book of names, a smile that was never its own.
The loading bar ticks over to 100%. The world stops buffering.
A roll of names unrolls across the sky, in order. It begins at 0003. Someone left the first two lines blank.
{flash}END OF THE CULT SAGA

worlds.name: Clown's Massacre
worlds.note: Side quest: a purely endless run against the Clown types. It never ends. Six floor bosses, round and round: Clown.x3, Clown.x2, Clown.x25 (Two to One: kill the doll before they fuse), Clown.x14, Clown.x33 (Blood Patches: it drinks while you bleed), then Clown.x5 on the Terror Stairs. Any clown can rise to boss later, and deeper in, something worse is waiting in Cell 610. Every wave beaten earns 1 Clown Token. This is the ONLY place the playable Clowns unlock: about 1 time in 10 a floor boss is a rare special act (Clown.x2 Understudy, Clown.x25 Double Act, Clown.x33 Curtain Call). Beat it and that clown joins your fighters.

worlds.name: The Casino
worlds.note: Side quest: a purely endless run through the Casino. It never ends: sixteen floors (about 80 waves) before the floor plan loops, and it only gets tougher. Enemies roll dice, spin reels, count cards and flip coins, and what they will do is shown a turn ahead. Between fights you can gamble at the tables. Floor bosses: the Pit Boss, Jackpot, the High Roller, the House, the Loan Shark, the Banker, the Croupier and the Whale, in order, then repeating and mixing, tougher every lap.

worlds.name: The Experimental Ringer
worlds.note: PREVIEW (not in the story yet). Fal-125 shows off its successful experiments: obedient people, animals and revived dinosaurs, in a bright clean showroom. World special, The Bell: every enemy wears a collar, and every 4th round the bell rings and all collared enemies strike together (your team calms down and heals a little). Stun an enemy, or hit it for 40% of its HP in one blow, to cut its collar: it goes Wild, hits harder, ignores the bell and sometimes attacks its own side.
